# Sr Digital Marketing Specialist

Full-time

Progressive Dental LLC

[Clearwater, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Clearwater%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3565692738430718113?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9885&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3707862179411635948&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Progressive Dental Marketing**

Progressive Dental Marketing is a full-service dental marketing and growth agency specializing in helping dental practices across the country attract new patients, increase case acceptance, and grow their businesses. Our services include paid digital advertising, search engine optimization, website development, video production, and comprehensive marketing strategy.

We work with hundreds of dental practices nationwide, with a particular focus on high-value procedures such as dental implants, full-mouth rehabilitation, and cosmetic dentistry. Our approach goes beyond generating clicks and leads. We focus on connecting marketing performance to actual patient acquisition and practice revenue.

As our organization continues to grow, we're looking for experienced digital marketing professionals who bring technical expertise, accountability, and a genuine interest in developing high-performing teams.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Digital Marketing Specialist to help lead our paid digital advertising department while maintaining direct responsibility for a select portfolio of Platinum-tier client accounts.

This is a player-coach role designed for someone who is exceptionally knowledgeable in both Google Ads and Meta Ads, understands the complexities of local lead generation, and can confidently build, manage, and optimize campaigns from start to finish. Working alongside an existing Team Lead, this individual will help oversee our Digital Marketing Specialists, providing technical guidance, reviewing campaign performance, improving execution standards, and supporting professional development.

In addition to these leadership responsibilities, the Senior Specialist will personally manage a smaller book of our highest-tier clients, developing advanced advertising strategies and ensuring strong, measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities**

Team Leadership & Development

- Share responsibility for the day-to-day leadership, development, and performance of Digital Marketing Specialists alongside another Team Lead.
- Provide ongoing coaching, technical training, and mentorship in Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, OpenAI ads, campaign strategy, and optimization.
- Conduct regular account audits and quality assurance reviews to ensure campaigns meet company performance and execution standards.
- Assist specialists in troubleshooting underperforming campaigns, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective strategies.
- Establish consistent best practices for campaign structure, budget management, bidding, targeting, conversion tracking, and creative execution.
- Support the onboarding and training of new specialists, helping them develop the technical skills necessary to independently manage client accounts.
- Collaborate with department leadership to identify opportunities for operational improvements, workflow efficiencies, and stronger campaign performance.

Client Marketing Management

- Independently manage a select portfolio of dental practice accounts, maintaining responsibility for strategy, execution, optimization, and results.
- Develop comprehensive advertising strategies based on each practice's geographic market, competitive landscape, treatment offerings, and patient acquisition objectives.
- Build and execute sophisticated campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads, ensuring budgets are allocated effectively to maximize qualified lead generation.
- Regularly evaluate campaign performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and proactively implement changes.
- Collaborate with Account Executives and other internal stakeholders to align advertising strategies with client goals, lead quality feedback, and business outcomes.

Paid Advertising Strategy & Execution

- Develop and launch complete advertising campaigns, including keyword selection, audience targeting, campaign structure, ad copy, creative production, conversion tracking, and ongoing optimization.
- Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Google Ads bidding strategies, including Maximize Conversions, Portfolio Bidding, Target CPA, Maximize Conversions, and other applicable bidding approaches.
- Understand when and how to apply bid adjustments, geographic targeting, device targeting, scheduling, exclusions, and other optimization controls based on campaign objectives and bidding strategy compatibility.
- Develop effective local advertising strategies utilizing geographic targeting, radius targeting, location exclusions, and market-specific budget allocation.
- Manage Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram, including audience targeting, campaign objectives, creative testing, retargeting, and lead generation optimization.
- Analyze performance metrics such as cost per lead (CPL), click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate (CVR), cost per click (CPC), and qualified lead volume to guide strategic decisions.
- Develop static and video advertising creative using Canva, including ad variations, promotional messaging, and platform-specific creative formats.

**Required Qualifications**

- Minimum of 5 years of hands-on paid digital advertising experience, with demonstrated expertise in both Google Ads and Meta Ads.
- Advanced knowledge of Google Ads bidding strategies, bid adjustments, geographic targeting, and campaign optimization.
- Demonstrated success managing local lead generation campaigns with a focus on generating qualified inquiries, appointments, or sales opportunities.
- Proven ability to independently build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across both Google and Meta.
- Experience developing static and video-based advertising creative using Canva.
- Strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, campaign reporting, and lead generation performance metrics.
- Experience managing multiple advertising accounts and budgets simultaneously.
- Demonstrated ability to mentor, train, or provide technical guidance to other marketing professionals.
- Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and call tracking or attribution platforms.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose underperforming campaigns and implement effective solutions.
- Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills.

**What Success Looks Like**

- Client accounts consistently meet established lead generation and performance objectives.
- Digital Specialists demonstrate measurable improvements in technical proficiency, campaign execution, and independent problem-solving.
- Campaigns are consistently structured, tracked, and optimized according to established company standards.
- Underperforming accounts are identified early and addressed through proactive, data-driven optimization.
- Preventable campaign errors, budget discrepancies, and tracking issues are minimized through effective quality control.
- Team performance improves through consistent coaching, accountability, and the implementation of advertising best practices.
- Client retention and satisfaction are supported through strong advertising performance and proactive account management.

# Senior PPC Manager

$120k - $160k

Power Brands

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7266948716588774796?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4571308650059364713&crId=US_0US_0)

We're hiring a paid-ads machine.

Power Brands has built 3,000+ beverage brands over 20 years for Coca-Cola, PepsiCo, Nestlé, Keurig Dr Pepper and hundreds of startups. Now we want one person who lives inside our ad accounts and fills our pipeline with qualified leads.

This is not a strategy job.
If your plan is to come in, talk frameworks and \\"build a roadmap,\\" don't apply. You'll be wasting your time and ours.

If you're the person who logs in first, finds the leak, fixes it and has better numbers by Friday, keep reading.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Run Google Ads, Microsoft (Bing) Ads, ChatGPT Ads and LinkedIn Ads, hands-on, every day
• Build, test and kill campaigns fast
• Drive more qualified leads at a lower cost per lead
• Own the numbers. No team to hide behind, nobody to delegate to.

WHAT YOU BRING
• 5+ years hands-on in Google Ads, with campaigns you personally built and ran

Turn Data Into Strategy at UVA Health

UVA Health is seeking a Senior Marketing Analyst to join the Office of Strategic Marketing and Communications and help shape a more data-driven approach to marketing across the Health System. This role will transform complex marketing, digital, customer, and web data into meaningful insights that inform strategy, improve performance, and support smarter investment decisions.

As a strategic analytics partner, the Senior Marketing Analyst will work across marketing channels—including search, social media, display advertising, email, content, and web to understand how audiences engage with UVA Health and what drives meaningful action. This position will play a key role in developing measurement strategies, advancing attribution and predictive analytics, identifying opportunities for optimization, and translating findings into clear recommendations for colleagues and senior leadership.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical capabilities with business acumen, curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex findings in a clear and actionable way.

What You’ll Do
Marketing Analytics & Measurement

Lead reporting and analytics efforts across marketing initiatives and channels supporting acquisition, engagement, awareness, and growth strategies.

Establish comprehensive measurement strategies, including learning agendas, KPIs, benchmarks, reporting methodologies, and data sources.

Develop measurement frameworks that connect marketing activity to meaningful business and customer outcomes.

Analyze customer, campaign, web, and behavioral data across complex and disparate data sources.

Conduct advanced analyses, including channel attribution, predictive modeling, ROI analysis, and performance forecasting.

Develop analytics strategies that map customer journeys from initial engagement through conversion and downstream outcomes.

Insights & Optimization

Identify trends, opportunities, and performance gaps and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

Develop and implement testing and optimization strategies to improve marketing effectiveness.

Evaluate campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve audience engagement, conversion, and return on investment.

Monitor emerging digital marketing, analytics, measurement, and attribution trends and recommend opportunities for innovation.

Lead annual benchmarking efforts and identify industry best practices to inform continuous improvement.

Data Visualization & Reporting

Create intuitive dashboards, data visualizations, executive reports, and campaign performance analyses.

Integrate data from multiple marketing and digital sources to provide a holistic view of performance.

Establish consistent reporting methodologies and ensure insights are accurate, meaningful, and actionable.

Evaluate UTM strategies and tracking practices to strengthen campaign measurement and attribution.

Develop reporting that clearly communicates performance, trends, opportunities, and recommended actions.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Performance Marketing to leverage CRM and downstream data to evaluate marketing effectiveness, patient engagement, and return on investment.

Collaborate with Health Information Technology (HIT) and other subject matter experts to ensure marketing technologies, data connections, and infrastructure support analytics requirements.

Work closely with marketing strategists, channel owners, content teams, and other stakeholders to develop meaningful measurement plans.

Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to marketing teams and health system leadership.

Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Strategic Leadership

Help advance a culture of data-informed decision-making across the Office of Strategic Marketing and Communications.

Translate sophisticated analytics into clear business and marketing recommendations.

Influence marketing strategy by connecting data, customer behavior, channel performance, and organizational objectives.

Identify opportunities to improve analytics capabilities, processes, technologies, and measurement practices.

Lead and contribute to strategic projects that advance UVA Health's marketing analytics maturity.

Why UVA Health?
At UVA Health, marketing plays an important role in connecting patients and communities with the care, services, and expertise they need. As a Senior Marketing Analyst, you'll have the opportunity to influence how one of the nation's leading academic health systems uses data to understand its audiences, improve digital experiences, and make smarter marketing decisions.

You’ll work alongside talented marketing, technology, clinical, and operational professionals in an environment that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What We’re Looking For

Advanced analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to work with complex, disparate data sets.

Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEM, SEO, social media, display advertising, email, content marketing, and web analytics.

Experience with marketing attribution, predictive modeling, customer journey analysis, and ROI measurement.

Strong knowledge of digital measurement and campaign tracking, including UTM strategy and best practices.

Experience developing dashboards, data visualizations, and executive-level reporting.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify meaningful insights within complex data.

Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

Ability to translate technical and analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective relationships with technical teams, marketing professionals, and senior leaders.

Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset with a passion for using data to influence strategy.

Minimum Requirements
Education: Bachelor's degree; Master’s preferred.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years of experience in a role that focuses on leveraging analytical and reporting tools and advanced analytics methodologies, including but not limited to Tableau, Google Analytics, and Data Studio.

Licensure/Certification: None.

This is primarily a sedentary job involving extensive use of desktop computers. The job does occasionally require traveling some distance to attend meetings, and programs.

# Senior Performance Marketing Manager

$210k - $240k

Tines

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5358161733118819413?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7460240718404931980&crId=US_0US_0)

Founded in 2018 with co-headquarters in Dublin and Boston, Tines powers some of the world's most important workflows. Our intelligent workflow platform applies AI, automation, and integration with human ingenuity to drive real business results.

Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. And because Tines is secure and private by design, it’s popular with security, IT, engineering, finance, and other security-focused teams.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

The Role
We're hiring a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale paid acquisition at Tines.

This role will be responsible for developing and executing our global paid acquisition strategy, improving campaign performance, maximizing return on marketing investment, and driving measurable pipeline growth.

You'll partner cross-functionally with teams across Marketing, RevOps, Finance, and other key business stakeholders, as well as our agency partners, to ensure paid acquisition supports the highest-priority goals across Revenue Marketing.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working in-platform, understands how creative, messaging, targeting, and landing pages influence performance, and is excited by continuously improving outcomes through data, experimentation, AI, and optimization.

Location: US Eastern or Central Time Zones (Remote) and Dublin, Ireland (Remote)

What You'll Do

Own the strategy, execution, and performance of paid acquisition across search (Google Ads, Bing) , paid social (incl. LinkedIn, Meta, X), display (Google Ads, Influ2) , review sites (G2, GDN), communities (Reddit), retargeting, and emerging channels like CTV.

Manage and optimize campaigns across targeting, audience segmentation, bidding strategies, messaging, creative, landing pages, and conversion paths to maximize pipeline growth and return on investment.

Serve as the strategic paid acquisition partner for Demand Generation, Growth Marketing, ABM, and Web Marketing, translating marketing objectives into high-performing paid acquisition strategies.

Partner with Regional Field Marketing teams to develop paid acquisition strategies that support regional pipeline goals across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

Support Revenue Marketing's acquisition goals by developing paid acquisition strategies that drive qualified pipeline, product adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

Partner with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, and Web Marketing to improve campaign messaging, creative performance, and post-click conversion.

Own paid media reporting, performance analysis, budget recommendations, and investment planning, partnering closely with RevOps and Finance to improve attribution, visibility, and return on investment.

Manage agency partners while maintaining accountability for campaign performance and business outcomes.

Continuously evaluate new channels, technologies, AI-enabled workflows, and best practices to improve campaign performance and execution efficiency.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS performance marketing, growth marketing, or paid acquisition.

Proven experience owning and scaling paid acquisition programs across multiple digital channels.

Deep hands-on expertise with platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, and other B2B acquisition channels.

Strong understanding of paid search, paid social, audience targeting, bidding strategies, campaign optimization, landing page optimization, and conversion rate optimization.

Experience managing significant paid media budgets and making investment decisions based on business outcomes.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable insights.

Experience partnering with agencies while maintaining accountability for campaign performance.

Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, RevOps, Sales, and other key business stakeholders.

Strong creative judgment, with the ability to connect messaging, creative, offers, and landing page experience to campaign performance.

Curiosity about AI and modern marketing technology, with a desire to continuously improve execution, experimentation, and productivity.

Success in This Role
You will establish clear ownership of paid acquisition across Tines, improve pipeline contribution and marketing efficiency across our paid channels, build a culture of experimentation and continuous optimization, and become a trusted strategic partner to teams across Revenue Marketing.

You'll help establish paid acquisition as a scalable, data-driven growth engine that enables the business to acquire customers more efficiently and accelerate pipeline growth.

**Compensation:**
US - $210,000 - $240,000 OTE (base + bonus + equity)

Ireland - €125,000 - €145,000 (base + bonus + equity)

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.

# Sr. Marketing Analyst

Full-time

Niche

[Ohio](https://jooble.org/jobs/Ohio)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6336487570988164126?p=1&pos=0&rgn=36&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8751679274926801996&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Niche**

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

**About The Role**

We are looking for an experienced, analytically rigorous, and collaborative Senior Marketing Analyst to own how Niche measures and improves the performance of its marketing engine, on both sides of the marketplace. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded day to day with the marketing and growth teams and reporting to the Manager of Operational Analytics.

The Senior Marketing Analyst is the analytical owner of two connected domains:

- **B2B marketing and pipeline analytics:** how marketing-sourced demand becomes qualified leads, opportunities, and closed business.
- **B2C growth and registration analytics:** how students and parents find Niche across acquisition channels, register, and convert into engaged users.

This is a deeply embedded role. You will sit in marketing, B2B, SEO, and lifecycle meetings and workflows, develop first-hand awareness of how data is actually being used, where the gaps are, and what's needed before it becomes a problem. You will be a strategic partner to marketing leadership rather than a reporting function: proactively surfacing insights, pairing them with recommendations and clear next steps, and staying with the work through the decision it informs.

**What You Will Do**

B2B Marketing & Pipeine Analytics

- Build the measurement foundation for how Niche markets to schools and districts: define which metrics matter, how they are calculated, and where the reporting lives, so the business can see what is actually working
- Bring rigor to questions such as which channels and campaigns produce pipeline that closes, what a marketing-sourced lead is actually worth, and where demand generation investment should go next
- Develop leading-indicator reporting that gives marketing and sales leadership early signal on pipeline health rather than a retrospective read
- Own the B2B attribution model in Marketo Measure, including touchpoint and channel definitions and the data flow between Marketo, Salesforce, and Snowflake. Partner with Marketing and Sales to keep campaign tracking and lead and opportunity attribution reliable over time
- Support new business forecasting and pipeline reviews with clear, documented methodology and honest confidence levels

B2C Growth & Registration Analytics

- Own registration and acquisition measurement end to end: registration funnel performance, campaign and channel attribution, and the connection between how a user arrived and what they went on to do on the platform
- Measure paid acquisition efficiency: cost per registration, cost per qualified lead, and how spend translates into users who actually convert. Partner with Growth Marketing on media mix and budget decisions, and build the forecasts behind them
- Serve as the analytical partner to Growth Marketing and Lifecycle: size opportunities, design and read out growth tests, troubleshoot tracking, and maintain the reporting the team runs on day to day
- Build and maintain the marketing dashboards and self-serve views that let growth, lifecycle, and leadership answer their own recurring questions
- Own organic search analytics: measure performance by page type, path, and traffic source (profiles, rankings, entity search), and quantify the impact of product decisions and algorithm updates
- Build the monitoring and daily reporting that surfaces organic traffic shifts before they become surprises, and keep traffic definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer
- Partner with Product and Data Engineering to define the event tracking and data models this measurement depends on

Analytical Rigor & Influence

- Model analytical rigor on marketing data: reproducible SQL, documented methodology, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation
- Review and pressure-test analyses from across the analytics team and from business partners, and sharpen how findings are framed and communicated
- Act as the subject matter expert on acquisition-funnel data sources and methodology: when analyses from Business or Product Analytics start at the top of the funnel, make sure they start from the right source, the right definition, and a method that will hold
- Mentor analysts informally and share techniques across the analytics team
- Partner with Data Engineering as the voice of the business: write clear measurement requirements, contribute directly to dbt models and the company-wide self-serve semantic layer, and QA what gets shipped
- Champion AI-assisted analytics in your own work and help colleagues adopt it by building and maintaining the skills, workflows, and context that make these tools reliable on Niche's data
- Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership with clear insight and a clear "so what"

**What We Are Looking For**

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus
- 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data function.
- Demonstrated experience owning marketing measurement end to end, from tracking implementation through to reporting and recommendation.
- Hands-on experience with consumer acquisition data: web analytics and paid media platforms (GA4, Meta, Google Ads, or equivalent), including campaign and channel attribution and its limitations.
- Direct experience with B2B marketing and pipeline analytics: lead and MQL lifecycle, multi-touch attribution, campaign and channel contribution to pipeline, and conversion through to closed business.
- Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and attribution data (e.g., Marketo, Marketo Measure, Salesforce) and diagnosing problems in how they connect.
- Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insight for non-technical stakeholders, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question.
- Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities, and resilience in the face of ambiguity and change.
- Senior proficiency in SQL; comfortable writing, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex queries independently.
- Strong proficiency in data visualization and dashboarding platforms such as Streamlit, Tableau, Looker, or similar.
- Working knowledge of a modern data stack: Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work.
- Comfortable with experimentation and quantitative methods: designing and reading out A/B and growth tests, sizing effects honestly, and knowing when a result is signal and when it isn't.
- A genuine practitioner of AI-assisted analytics: comfortable using tools like Claude Code in your own work, and rigorous about validating what comes back.
- Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority, working self-directed on complex and ambiguous problems, and mentoring peers.

**Nice to Have**

- Experience with Python or R.
- Direct experience with SEO analytics: indexation, page-level organic performance, and technical SEO measurement.
- Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer.
- Background in SaaS, education technology, or marketplace analytics environments.
- Experience in the education sector or working with schools and colleges.

**Compensation**

Our national target base salary range is $93,760 - $117,200, plus participation in our Annual Bonus and Stock Option Program. Base compensation will be commensurate with experience and skills.

At Niche, our Total Rewards Philosophy is centered around creating a workplace environment that attracts, motivates, and retains top talent by providing a comprehensive and competitive rewards package. This philosophy is built on the principles of performance-based compensation, best-in-class benefits and work-life balance, and employee well-being.

**Interview Process**

Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams. We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience. The interview process is outlined here:

- **Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Partner** \- 30 Minutes

- **Video Interview with Hiring Manager** \- 30 Minutes

- **Team Interview** \- 3 separate 30 Minute Interviews

- **Case Study & Presentation**
- **Hiring Manager follow-up** \- 30 Minutes


**Why** **Niche**?

- We are a fully flexible workforce empowering our employees to choose to work remotely, in our Pittsburgh office or whatever combination suits you
- Full time, salaried position with competitive compensation in a fast-growing company
- Best-in-class 100% paid employee health plan, including vision and dental and supplemental coverage
- Flexible Paid Time Off Policy
- Stipend that allows you to build your work from home office in a style and function that suits your personal preferences
- Parental leave for all employees (12 weeks fully paid) in addition to short term disability for birthing parents
- Meaningful 401(k) with employer match
- Your ideas and work will make an immediate impact on our company and millions of users
- You will join a team that cares about you, our mission, our work - and celebrates our wins together!

# Senior Digital Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing & SEO (Spanish Speaker)

Full-time

GEDU Services

[Tampa, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Tampa%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5096256739991044760?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9438&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5791804928649252389&crId=US_0US_0)

**Senior Digital Marketing Manager - Performance Marketing & SEO (Spanish Speaker)**

**Tampa, USA (Onsite)** \| **Global Higher Education**

**This isn’t just another digital marketing role.**

We’re looking for a **senior digital marketing leader** who wants to **own growth—not simply manage campaigns.** You’ll lead the digital acquisition and organic growth strategy across Spanish-speaking markets, connecting **Performance Marketing, SEO, AI-powered search, analytics and conversion optimization** to one clear goal:

**Drive more qualified student enquiries, enrolments and sustainable growth.**

You’ll have the autonomy to **build the strategy, challenge the status quo, test new ideas and turn insights into action.**

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**

**Performance Marketing**

- Lead end-to-end campaigns across: **Google Ads • Meta • LinkedIn • TikTok • Bing**
- Own **strategy, budgets, forecasting, audience targeting, creative testing, bidding, optimization and ROI** across the full student acquisition funnel.
- From **awareness → consideration → conversion → remarketing → lead nurturing** , you’ll continuously identify opportunities to improve performance and lead quality.

**SEO & Organic Growth**

- Own the SEO strategy across: **Technical SEO • On-Page SEO • Content • Keywords • Link Building • Organic Acquisition**
- Drive improvements across programme pages, landing pages, blogs and evergreen content while working closely with content, web and marketing teams.

**The Next Generation of Search**

Help shape how our organization is discovered in the evolving search landscape through:

**GEO • AEO • LLM Optimization • AI Search Visibility**

**Analytics, Conversion & Growth**

- Turn data into decisions through: **GA4 • Google Tag Manager • Search Console • Attribution • Conversion Tracking • Meta Pixel/CAPI**
- Monitor **CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, Conversion Rate, ROAS, CAC and LTV** and translate performance insights into meaningful growth.

**WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY DIFFERENT?**

- **You’ll have real ownership.** You won’t simply be handed a playbook and asked to follow it.
- **You’ll be expected to create the playbook.** You’ll work across Marketing, Admissions, Content, Creative, CRM, Web Development and Regional Teams to connect digital performance with the outcome that matters:
- **More qualified students. Better conversion. Sustainable growth.** And because this is higher education, the numbers have meaning.

Behind every enquiry is someone making an important decision about their **education, career and future.**

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

You’ll be expected to deliver measurable growth, including targets such as:

- **+20–30% Organic Traffic**
- **+15–20% Qualified Organic Enquiries**
- **+20–30% Growth in Target Keywords Reaching Google’s Top 10**
- **15–20 High-Quality Backlinks / Month**
- **10–15 New Referring Domains / Month**
- **+15–20% AI Search Visibility**

While continuously improving **ROAS, CPA, conversion rates and lead quality** across paid channels.

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

- **Seasoned professional with strong expertise in Digital Marketing is a must**
- Strong expertise across **Performance Marketing + SEO**
- Hands-on experience with **Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok & Bing**
- Strong knowledge of **GA4, GTM, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs & Screaming Frog** or equivalent tools
- Practical experience with **GEO, AEO and/or LLM Optimisation**
- Strong analytical, commercial and strategic mindset
- Experience with **conversion tracking, attribution, audience segmentation and marketing analytics**
- Excellent stakeholder and communication skills
- **Spanish fluency — essential**
- **Professional English — essential** for internal communication and collaboration
- Comfortable working in a **fast-paced, target-driven environment**
- Higher Education, EdTech or lead-generation experience is an advantage
- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline is preferred

**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**

Join a **fast-growing global higher education organization** where digital is a key driver of international growth.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

✨ Shape international student acquisition strategy

Work at the forefront of **AI and next-generation search**

Directly influence measurable business performance

Build growth across Spanish-speaking markets

Collaborate with talented teams across marketing, admissions and technology

Help more students discover opportunities that can shape their future

$80k - $100k

Acquisition Services Inc

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8761413928357684193?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7649668867693227623&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Paid Media Manager

We're seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager for our Portfolio company to turn paid media investment into profitable growth. You will own campaign performance from strategy and setup through optimization, measurement, and reporting.

The role begins with Meta across Facebook and Instagram, then expands into channels such as Google, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Spotify, and Amazon when performance data and business needs support the investment. Success is measured through qualified demand, sales, acquisition efficiency, and profitability.

This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will work directly in the accounts, interpret performance daily, manage budgets, strengthen tracking, and build a disciplined testing practice.

You will partner closely with the Meta, Funnels & AI Performance Coach, Brand & Creative Director, Messaging & Copy Strategist, and teams across marketing and sales.

##### Responsibilities

- Own paid media campaigns from planning and launch through daily optimization, beginning with Meta and expanding to additional channels based on performance and business needs.
- Analyze channel and blended performance to improve CAC, ROAS, lead quality, revenue, and profitability while keeping spend on pace.
- Maintain reliable measurement across pixels, tags, UTMs, conversion events, conversion APIs, server-side tracking, dashboards, and attribution analysis.
- Run a documented testing roadmap across creative, audiences, bidding, offers, landing pages, and funnels in partnership with creative, copy, and performance stakeholders.
- Deliver clear performance reporting, surface risks and opportunities early, monitor platform changes, and use AI tools where they measurably improve speed or quality.

##### Requirements

- 5+ hands-on paid media experience owning Meta campaigns and at least one additional major platform, with accountability for meaningful budgets and business results.
- Advanced analytical ability across advertising platforms, GA4, dashboards, and business data, with a record of turning performance signals into timely decisions.
- Hands-on experience implementing and auditing pixels, conversion APIs, UTM structures, conversion events, and server-side tracking, plus a practical understanding of attribution limits.
- Demonstrated discipline in designing, running, and documenting experiments, with the judgment to turn findings into stronger creative, messaging, offers, and funnels.
- Clear, leadership-ready communication skills, current knowledge of paid platform changes, and practical experience using AI to improve repeatable workflows.

##### Results

- Meta campaigns are fully owned and consistently optimized against agreed CAC, ROAS, lead-quality, revenue, and profitability targets.
- Monthly spend remains within 5% of plan, with material pacing risks identified and addressed early.
- Tracking and conversion measurement are audited regularly, with major gaps identified, communicated, and resolved promptly.
- At least two structured tests per active platform are completed each month, with hypotheses, outcomes, and next actions documented.
- Weekly reports arrive on time, monthly reviews are delivered by the fifth business day, and quarterly channel-expansion recommendations include audience, budget, and test design.

##### Schedule

- Full-time, with working hours aligned to U.S.-based team collaboration and campaign needs.
- No travel is required.

##### Location

- Remote, USA

##### Compensation

- $80,000 - $100,000 base salary
- The salary range may include multiple levels applicable to the position. Final compensation will be based on relevant experience, skills, expertise, and the level at which the candidate is hired. This range includes base salary only and does not include benefits.

##### Benefits

- Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off after six months, plus company-wide holidays.
- Retirement Plan: 401(k) with a 3% company match after six months of continuous employment.
- Profit-Sharing 401(k): Employer-funded contributions based on tenure and other plan factors, with a three-year vesting schedule.
- Home Office Stipend: One-time stipend to establish a comfortable and productive remote workspace.
- Annual Incentive Trip: Fully paid team trip to a bucket-list destination.
- Private Wellness Center: Monthly access to a gym, sauna, and cold plunge for Georgia-based employees.
- Parental Leave: Twelve weeks fully paid for the primary provider and four weeks fully paid for the secondary provider, subject to length-of-service eligibility.

##### ACQ Core Values

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

##### Competitive Greatness

Be at your best when your best is needed. Enjoyment of a hard challenge. Those who have the drive to constantly improve, the superior intellect and long term commitment to see incremental improvements become compounding returns.

##### Sincere Candor

Have the self awareness to accurately perceive and communicate hard truths that improve others and self, the courage to do so, and the humility to accept them, even when it hurts. Nothing great can be built without feedback: internally or externally.

##### Unimpeachable Character

Be the type of person with whom people are always proud to associate, personally and professionally. We look for true alignment of thoughts, words, and actions towards a goal worth pursuing.

# Senior Paid Media Manager

$120k - $140k

Sunco

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2292737926206992468?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6657&pageType=7&jobAge=18&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4104538995057173573&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Paid Media Manager

This role is based at our headquarters in Valencia, California, and requires an on-site schedule Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Sunco is one of the largest and fastest-growing online lighting retailers in the U.S.—and we're just getting started. Headquartered in sunny Valencia, CA, we're powered by an amazing team of people who bring passion, purpose, and innovation to everything they do.

We light up the world—literally

Millions of customers have trusted Sunco for our energy-efficient LED lighting and our commitment to quality, value, and customer care. Whether it's a home renovation or a large-scale commercial project, our mission is to deliver top-tier lighting solutions with unbeatable service and eco-conscious impact.

At Sunco, we don't just sell lights—we help our customers see things in a whole new light.

##### About the Role

The Senior Paid Media Manager will own the strategy, hands-on execution, and optimization of Sunco.com's full-funnel paid acquisition program across Google, Meta, TikTok, Reddit, and other emerging channels. This role will manage campaign strategy, budgets, audience segmentation, creative testing, measurement, and experimentation to drive profitable e-commerce growth. Working closely with Marketing, Creative, E-commerce, Analytics, Web, and Lifecycle teams, this individual will translate complex performance data into clear recommendations, improve customer acquisition and retention, and identify scalable opportunities that strengthen revenue, ROAS, and long-term customer value.

What You'll Do:

- Own the strategy, hands-on execution, and daily optimization of Sunco.com's full-funnel paid acquisition program.
- Manage campaigns across Google Shopping, Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Reddit, Meta, TikTok, and emerging channels.
- Build campaigns across the customer journey, from awareness and consideration through purchase, remarketing, and retention.
- Manage campaign structure, targeting, bidding, budgets, creative testing, product feeds, and performance reporting.
- Develop channel and audience strategies based on customer intent, product category, buyer behavior, and funnel stage.
- Recommend budget allocations based on performance, marginal return, growth potential, and customer-acquisition efficiency.
- Optimize performance against ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, customer lifetime value, revenue contribution, and other business targets.
- Evaluate performance beyond platform-reported and last-click attribution using incrementality testing, holdouts, and other measurement methods.
- Monitor spend, pacing, conversion quality, and performance risks, taking timely corrective action when needed.
- Partner with Analytics and Web teams to ensure campaign tracking, attribution, reporting, and product feeds are reliable.
- Translate complex performance data into clear recommendations about what is working, what should change, and where Sunco should invest next.
- Build and manage a structured experimentation program across audiences, creative, messaging, ad formats, landing pages, bidding strategies, and funnel stages.
- Develop customer, product, behavioral, and audience segmentation strategies to improve relevance, efficiency, and scale.
- Partner with Creative to develop and test product messaging, video, static creative, ad formats, and audience-specific concepts.
- Identify successful campaigns and creative concepts and scale them responsibly across relevant channels.
- Evaluate emerging advertising channels and opportunities.
- Develop clear business cases, measurement plans, and success criteria before recommending investment in new channels or larger media buys.
- Collaborate with the Channel Marketing Manager to establish acquisition strategy, channel priorities, budgets, and growth targets.
- Coordinate with the Senior Ads Manager to maintain a cohesive, measurable, and scalable paid-media program.
- Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to connect acquisition and retention strategies through remarketing, customer-value insights, and lifecycle-informed growth opportunities.
- Work closely with Creative, E-commerce, Analytics, and Web teams to improve advertising performance and the post-click customer experience.
- Serve as Sunco's paid-media subject-matter expert by providing guidance on platform changes, growth opportunities, performance risks, and testing priorities.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in paid media, performance marketing, or growth marketing for an e-commerce business.

• Proven success owning paid-media strategy and execution across multiple customer-acquisition channels.

• Deep expertise in Google Ads, including Google Shopping, Search, Performance Max, YouTube, and Demand Gen.

• Hands-on experience managing Meta and TikTok advertising campaigns.

• Experience with Reddit advertising is strongly preferred; familiarity with other emerging advertising opportunities is a plus.

• Experience managing significant paid-media budgets and making evidence-based allocation decisions.

• Strong analytical judgment across ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, customer lifetime value, attribution, and incrementality—not solely platform-reported or last-click results.

• Demonstrated ability to design, execute, document, and act on structured experiments.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce acquisition, product feeds, conversion optimization, customer value, and the relationship between acquisition and retention.

• Technical proficiency with advertising platforms, analytics tools, campaign tracking, product feeds, attribution, and performance measurement.

• A creative, growth-oriented mindset with the ability to develop innovative segmentation and implementation strategies while maintaining financial discipline.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear, actionable business recommendations.

Benefits & Perks

At Sunco, we pride ourselves on offering a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our team members, our offering include:

- Comprehensive Health and Wellness Coverage : Enjoy peace of mind with our extensive health insurance plans, which include medical, dental, and vision coverage.
- 401(k) with Company Match : Secure your financial future with our 401(k) plan, featuring a competitive company match to help you save for retirement.
- Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): Take advantage of FSAs to manage out-of-pocket healthcare and dependent care expenses efficiently.
- Time Off Policy : We believe in the importance of work-life balance and provide a generous time off policy, including paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access confidential counseling and support services for personal and professional challenges.
- Team Building Activities: Engage in weekly challenges, weekly Wellness Walks, regular team-building activities, and quarterly company outings to foster a strong sense of community.

Job Type: Full-time, Exempt

Compensation: $120,000 - $140,000

Overview
Prime Group Holdings , LLC, a vertically-integrated private equity real estate firm specializing in self storage and other alternative real estate asset classes, has an exciting opportunity for a talented Senior Paid Media Manager in its headquarters in Saratoga Springs, NY.

With$6.7billion in assets under management, Prime Group is among thelargest private owners and operators of self-storage properties globally, with a portfolio of320+ self-storage assetsacross28 U.S. states,three Canadian provinces, and theU.S. Virgin Islands, totaling24+ million rentable square feet. The firm managesthree flagship fundson behalf of a global investor base, includingPrime Storage Fund III, the largest self-storage dedicated fund ever raised.

Headquartered inSaratoga Springs, NY, Prime Group employs700+ professionalsand maintains a regional office inJupiter, FL and Manhattan, NYalong with investment originations offices inDenver, CO; Hackensack, NJ; Yorktown, VA; and Calgary, Alberta. The firm’s21-person senior leadership teamis supported by specialized teams across sourcing and acquisitions, asset and portfolio management, compliance and legal, property management, information technology, transactions and financing, marketing, accounting, training, and other core functions.

Prime Group’s performance is rooted in a culture of respect, teamwork, ethical business practices, accountability, and persistence. The firm places significant value on the relationships it has built with customers, employees, investors, and stakeholders. PitchBook has recognized Prime Group as one of the top 10 real estate value-add fund managers in its 2023 Global Manager Performance Score League Tables.

Role Prime Storage is one of the fastest-growing self-storage operators in North America, with a portfolio of facilities across the United States and Canada. We are focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences while leveraging data-driven marketing strategies to drive occupancy, revenue growth, and market share across our expanding portfolio.

We are seeking an analytical, results-oriented Senior Paid Media Manager to lead our digital acquisition programs. You will manage multi-million-dollar media investments, drive qualified leads and rentals, and identify new ways to improve marketing efficiency. You will work closely with the EVP of Marketing, manage all paid media campaigns, drive innovative media capabilities, and serve as the central point of contact for external agencies and media partners.

Search Engine Marketing (SEM)

Lead SEM strategy, execution, and optimization across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads to drive qualified leads, reservations, and rentals, spanning brand, non-brand, competitor, local, and storage-specific keyword initiatives.

Own geo-targeted SEM, building and optimizing location-specific and multi-market campaign structures across individual facilities.

Conduct keyword research, search query analysis, and negative keyword management to improve traffic quality and efficiency.

Refine bidding strategies, audience targeting, ad extensions, and campaign structures to maximize conversions; test ad copy, landing pages, and messaging.

Monitor impression share, quality score, CTR, CVR, CPL, and CPR to identify optimization opportunities.

Analyze local market trends, competitor activity, and search demand to find growth opportunities by facility and region.

Partner with SEO and Web Development to align paid and organic strategies and improve landing page performance to drive leads and rental/reservation conversion.

Manage budgets and forecasting to allocate spend efficiently against lead, reservation, rental, occupancy and overall revenue goals.

Stay current on platform updates, AI-powered bidding, media innovation, and industry trends.

Campaign Management

Own paid media across Google, Microsoft, Meta, LinkedIn, Apple Search Ads, ChatGPT, programmatic networks, and emerging AI-powered ad environments where commercially available.

Manage strategy and buying on Sparefoot.com.

Set campaign goals, KPIs, and success measures; allocate budget to maximize leads, rentals, and return on ad spend.

Develop creative strategy in partnership with design and content teams.

Manage campaigns end to end, including KPI tracking, post-campaign analysis, and implementation of adjustments to continuously improve.

Analytics & Reporting

Define, track, and report on key customer acquisition KPIs across platforms.

Build dashboards and reporting frameworks for real-time visibility into channel performance.

Blend a daily performance summary, paid platform data, and web analytics into a unified weekly reporting suite that surfaces cross-channel insights.

Deliver actionable insights and continuously test channel mix, targeting, messaging, and creative.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Marketing, Content, Creative, agency partners, the Operations and Asset Management team to align on strategy, objectives, and project plans.

Translate business objectives into integrated marketing strategies in partnership with key stakeholders.

Communicate performance and strategic recommendations clearly to leadership, and stay ahead of industry trends, platform changes, and competitor strategies.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, economics, or a related field.

8+ years in performance, user acquisition, or growth marketing, with a proven track record of scaling paid acquisition campaigns with measurable ROAS.

Deep familiarity with ad and web analytics platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity, and Crazy Egg or Hotjar.

Proficiency in reporting tools (Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau) and Excel or Google Sheets; SQL or Python is a plus.

Strong analytical ability to turn data into insights, plus excellent stakeholder communication and presentation skills.

Familiarity with conversational AI, AI-assisted search, and generative-AI advertising preferred; experience with ChatGPT Ads, MS Copilot advertising, Google AI Max, or Performance Max is a plus. ChatGPT Ads is an emerging environment this role will evaluate and pilot where available.

Experience with call tracking and attribution tools is a plus.

Experience in commercial real estate or multi-location businesses.

Work location: Saratoga Springs, NY-based candidates strongly preferred; the role requires regular on-site collaboration at Prime Storage’s home office. Candidates willing to relocate or commute regularly will be considered.

Who You Are

Data-driven: you live in dashboards and spreadsheets, and ground your decisions and recommendations in data and customer insights.

You distill complex performance data into clear narratives for any audience.

You prioritize rapidly and respond to changing business needs and market dynamics.

Self-motivated, confident, detail-oriented, and intentional; comfortable in a fast-moving start-up environment managing multiple priorities.

Benefits

Competitive rate of pay and a generous benefits program

Salary commensurate with experience

Medical, Dental, life, vision, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance program

Paid vacation time; paid sick time; paid holidays

# Senior Programmatic Trader

$100k - $115k

MOGL

[Denver, CO](https://jooble.org/jobs/Denver%2C-CO)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-6949915167860421839?p=1&pos=0&rgn=321&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1040043709845266135&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Programmatic Trader

Mogl is looking for a high-performing Senior Programmatic Trader to own client relationships and manage a growing book of business.

In this role, you will work closely with the client services team to ensure campaigns are executed efficiently, optimized for performance, and delivered seamlessly from start to finish. As a Mogl trader, you will play a key role in building and deepening relationships with our clients—bringing a local presence to a team known for high-touch service.

This role is ideal for a proactive, relationship-driven individual who thrives on collaboration, problem-solving, and helping clients achieve measurable success.

Mogl is the only purpose-built Certified Service Partner (reseller) for The Trade Desk. One of the fastest-growing companies in North America, Mogl delivers performance-driven consulting across the world's leading media and data platforms. We are guided by a values-driven culture and powered by a team of curious, persistent, and selfless professionals who collaborate to achieve ambitious, measurable outcomes. Based in Denver, CO and consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, Mogl provides meaningful opportunities where team members thrive through challenging and rewarding work.

##### Who You Are

- 5–7 years of experience in programmatic advertising, preferably at a DSP (e.g., The Trade Desk, DV360, Basis, StackAdapt) or within a performance-focused agency or brand.
- Deep familiarity with The Trade Desk platform, including campaign architecture, audience strategy, and optimization levers.
- Experience running retail media campaigns across major platforms (Amazon, Walmart, Target, etc.) with fluency in retail-specific metrics: ROAS, TACoS, NTB, and retail attribution.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate performance data into actionable strategy; proficient in Excel and comfortable building dashboards and custom reports.
- Confident, polished communicator—equally at ease in executive client conversations as in internal strategy sessions.
- Collaborative by nature, with a track record of working cross-functionally with sales, account management, and media teams to drive client growth.
- Self-directed and detail-oriented, able to manage a high-volume book of business without sacrificing quality or strategic thinking.

##### What You Will Do In This Role

Campaign Management

- Lead campaign strategy, launch, optimization, and performance monitoring, ensuring pacing, budget allocation, and KPI alignment at all times.
- Proactively identify and surface performance opportunities and troubleshoot issues before they impact client results.

Client Partnership & Strategy

- Serve as a senior strategic partner to retail accounts, owning the relationship and driving long-term growth.
- Deliver clear, insight-driven performance narratives in client calls, QBRs, and strategic reviews.
- Partner with Sales on upsell, expansion, and new business opportunities.
- Available to travel and meet with clients in person to provide education and support as needed, with a minimum of one trip per quarter.

Performance & Reporting

- Build and maintain custom dashboards and reporting frameworks tailored to each client's KPIs.
- Analyze performance data and translate findings into media strategy and budget recommendations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with internal traders, programmatic specialists, and account managers to align on strategy and execution.
- Contribute to the development of client services playbooks, best practices, and process documentation that elevate the broader team.

##### Why You Want To Work At Mogl

- Build Something Meaningful – Be part of a fast-growing company where your work directly shapes our growth, culture, and impact.
- Founder Access & Real Influence – Work closely with engaged founders and leaders who value ideas, initiative, and thoughtful decision-making.
- High Ownership, High Trust – You will have autonomy to own your role, make decisions, and see your work make a quick impact.
- People-First Culture – We invest in our people through learning & development, recognition, and experiences.

Please note this role is only open to Denver-based employees. The role will involve working from the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays in our Mogl office located in downtown Denver. We are not providing a relocation stipend and will only be reviewing candidates currently in the Denver area.

The estimated Colorado-based pay range for this role is a base salary of $100,000-$115,000, depending on experience, plus a quarterly incentive bonus.

All roles are eligible for the following benefits:

- Health Care Insurance
- Company stipends for specific perks – Health & Wellness, Education, Home Office and support with your commute
- 401(k) match after 1 year of employment with Mogl
- Flexible time off—we encourage at least three weeks a year
- Paid parental leave
- Flex time between Christmas and New Year's Day
- 12 Paid Company Holidays

At Mogl, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), gender identity, or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

If you have a disability or particular need that requires accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please let our Director of People know.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

# Senior Media Buyer

$52k - $82k

Full-time

Butler/Till

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4101440163724537822?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=5317345430888327630&crId=US_0US_0)

Butler/Till is a results-driven marketing agency offering deeply collaborative client experiences, proprietary technology, and world-class partnerships. At Butler/Till, we take immense pride in our independent, women-owned and led status, our unwavering commitment to a purpose-driven approach, and our unique structure as a 100% employee-owned company (ESOP).

**SUMMARY**

The Senior Publisher Direct Specialist is responsible for autonomously developing and executing effective media strategies rooted in endemic environments that align closely to client audiences and goals. They bring expertise across a variety of digital, offline, and emerging formats, collaborating with partners to deliver high-quality, brand-safe, and innovation-driven media solutions.

**KEY OUTCOMES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Key Outcome:** Develop comprehensive media recommendations rooted in endemic environments, aligned to client objectives and strategic priorities

_Key Responsibilities:_

- Lead holistic media consideration across endemic partners and channels, utilizing both direct and programmatic buying methods
- Collaborate with Integrated Planning, Account Management, and Programmatic teams to develop cohesive, synergistic cross-channel media recommendations
- Demonstrate understanding of media partner capabilities and integrations; delineation between direct IO and programmatic activation opportunities where applicable
- Lead, and train others on, the end-to-end RFP process, including vendor outreach, proposal evaluation, negotiations, and securing added value
- Leverage expertise in, and train others on, targeting strategies, inventory offerings, placement options, buying methodologies, and performance insights to build well-informed, high-quality recommendations
- Research, propose, and champion test & learn opportunities; collaborate with cross-functional teams on viability for execution and measurement
- Clearly articulate asset and tagging requirements, and provide creative best practices for campaign success

**Key Outcome:** Lead the successful activation and ongoing stewardship of media campaigns, ensuring seamless execution from planning to implementation

_Key Responsibilities:_

- Manage, and train others on, all aspects of order creation and partner acceptance, aligned to Agency processes
- Lead timely launch and stewardship of multiple client campaigns, each with its unique set of channels and targeting strategies
- Facilitate partner development of custom creative assets, acting as a conduit between internal and external stakeholders, managing timelines and expectations
- Send tracking tags, manage trafficking deliverables, and troubleshoot any launch or performance issues across partners
- Lead and train others on recurring pacing, invoicing, and reconciliation tasks across all applicable channels

**Key Outcome:** Manage campaign performance and reporting with informed decision-making and optimizations

_Key Responsibilities:_

- Collaborate with Analytics team on recommended KPIs for channel activation strategies and ensure accurate data tracking for all channels in dashboards
- Ensure partner reporting and data transfers are timely, accurate, and actionable
- Lead, and train others on, QA of campaign dashboards and reporting deliverables; strengthen data analysis skills to surface meaningful insights that drive optimizations
- Analyze and report on campaign effectiveness to maximize results across endemic environments
- Apply understanding of available optimization levers and collaborate with Activation team and partners on in-flight optimizations to enhance results
- Negotiate makegoods for under - performance or mismanagement of client investments
- Support troubleshooting of reporting issues, trafficking mapping, and site tagging to assist with campaign measurement
- Collaborate with junior team members to share campaign learnings with direct and cross-functional peers, informing broader strategies and future planning efforts

**Key Outcome:** Partner engagement and management maximize strategic and business impact

_Key Responsibilities:_

- Build and maintain strong relationships with partners, actively sharing information with cross functional teams and supporting development of innovative client opportunities
- Act as the primary day-to-day liaison between media partners and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and information sharing
- Support the development and optimization of endemic supply strategies, identifying and curating high-value inventory sources that maximize audience quality, drive measurable outcomes, and push the boundaries of available opportunities
- Evaluate new partners, tools, or technologies and integrate them into tactical planning when appropriate
- Demonstrate growing understanding of direct and programmatic buying nuances, including supply accessibility, rates, inventory quality, and targeting strategies within DSP environments

**Key Outcome:** Support of enterprise-level initiatives and thought leadership advance our endemic offering

_Key Responsibilities:_

- Recommend and develop best practices, guidelines, and process improvement initiatives that support planning, activation, stewardship, and reporting
- Maintain pulse and report on industry trends and marketplace conditions impacting endemic environments. Provide actionable insights relevant to our client portfolio
- Produce insights, case studies, and thought leadership to elevate the agency’s profile in the industry and enhance internal knowledge-sharing efforts (e.g., blog posts, white papers, speaking opportunities)
- Participate in internal and external learning and development opportunities. Develop and share educational materials
- Actively adopt new buying methodologies and experiment with automation, advanced targeting, and supply optimization within Publisher Direct channels
- Support onboarding and mentorship of junior team members, offering training and guidance on the full workflow, enterprise initiatives, and partner management
- Proactively surface strategic refinements and solutions to campaign or process challenges, applying critical thinking, initiative, and a focus on client goals, partner capabilities, and marketplace trends
- Additional accountabilities and tasks may be assigned by leader/management, to contribute to overall team and agency success

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**REQUIRED**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or equivalent work experience
- 5+ years of experience managing direct-to-publisher digital campaigns across display, custom digital programs, and/or online video
- Familiarity working in MediaOcean (Prisma) or comparable media buying software
- Proficient in Microsoft Office programs, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
- Self-starter able to seek new opportunities or projects, and lead from start to finish
- Ability to autonomously think around problems and identify potential solutions
- Ability to grasp new technology and product changes, and identify application to current work
- Strong written & verbal communication skills
- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment with rapidly changing priorities
- Demonstrated comprehension and application of basic media math and analytical skills
- Ability to mentor and coach junior team members by providing guidance and training that strengthens team capability

**PREFERRED**

- Experience working in highly regulated industry (e.g. pharma, healthcare, finance)
- Familiarity with Google Campaign Manager or comparable
- Familiarity with DoubleVerify or comparable

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

- CUSTOMER FOCUS/CLIENT INTIMACY: Seeking to understand client business challenges/needs and delivering continuous value to our clients
- COLLABORATIVE: Working with teams and across the organization with ease
- OWNER AGILITY: Able to continuously learn and quickly adapt to changing circumstance
- RESULTS DRIVEN: Accepts accountability to deliver business outcomes, even under changing circumstances. Delivers on commitments
- DISCIPLINED: Thinks, plans, and prioritizes work on an ongoing basis, plans and aligns with key team members before acting

**WORK ENVIORNMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

The work environment and physical demands characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, typically in an office setting or in a home office. An employee in this role may be in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods and using office equipment and computers. The noise level in the office environment is usually moderate (i.e., business office with computers and printers, light foot traffic, etc.). Reasonable accommodation may be requested to enable individuals to perform the essential functions.

Our dedication to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB) is a cornerstone of our culture. We believe that the diversity and inclusivity of our workforce are sources of strength. As you become part of our community, you'll discover that we are dedicated to creating a positive impact, not only for our clients but also for the communities where we live and work.

McNeil , Inc.

Job Title: MVA Lead Generation Senior Media Buyer

I want to hire you… and pay you a lot of money.

But this role isn't for most media buyers.

If you’re a senior media buyer based in the U.S. who is already actively managing accounts spending 7 figures per month on Meta and/or Google , keep reading.

Because if you're genuinely elite at media buying, obsessed with performance, and want to operate at a scale where small improvements can have massive impact, this could be the opportunity you're looking for.

We operate at serious scale.

You'll be working across 7-figure monthly advertising budgets , multiple platforms, multiple states and markets, and a creative operation capable of producing and testing a massive volume of new ads.

We don't need someone to simply maintain what we've built.

We want someone who can help us make it significantly better.

The Role
This is not a traditional media buyer role.

We don't need someone who waits for instructions, adjusts budgets, turns off bad ads, and calls it media buying.

And we definitely don't need someone who requires leadership to constantly tell them where the next opportunity is.

We're looking for someone who can take real ownership over performance.

Someone who can look across Meta, Google, states, campaigns, and hundreds of creatives and quickly determine:

Where should we spend more?

Where should we spend less?

What's starting to work that we haven't fully capitalized on yet?

Why is this state underperforming?

What winning ads haven't we expanded yet?

What creative are we missing?

What should we test next?

Then actually execute.

You won't just optimize campaigns.

You'll help determine where the next level of growth comes from.

What You’ll Actually Own
1\. Performance & Scaling

You’ll help manage and optimize high-spend campaigns across Meta and Google , including YouTube, Search, and Performance Max.

You'll continuously look across platforms and states to identify:

Scaling opportunities

Budget reallocation opportunities

Performance inefficiencies

Underperforming markets

Testing gaps

New strategies worth implementing

We expect you to understand where our money is going, what it's producing, and where the next dollar should be spent.

You'll work with other media buyers and leadership on cross-platform and state-level budget strategy to hit our volume and profitability goals.

2\. Creative Expansion
At our scale, media buying and creative strategy cannot operate separately.

You’ll know our best-performing ads.

You'll know our best-performing angles.

You'll know which concepts are starting to gain traction.

And you'll make sure we capitalize on them.

That means constantly thinking:

“This is working here → why aren't we running it here, here, and here?”

“This angle is crushing on Meta → let's test it on YouTube.”

“This state-specific concept is working → let's build it for every relevant market.”

“We're relying too heavily on UGC here → let's expand our creative diversity.”

“This angle is starting to work → creative team needs to build 10 more variations before everyone else catches it.”

You’ll bridge the gap between performance data and the creative team.

The creative team should always know what’s working, what’s starting to work, what’s getting fatigued, and what we need more of.

3\. Underperforming Markets
When a state isn't producing enough volume, your job isn't simply to say:

"Performance is bad."

Your job is to figure out why.

Is it creative?

Campaign structure?

Budget allocation?

Lack of creative diversity?

A winning angle we haven't brought over from another market?

Platform mix?

Audience?

Offer?

Landing page?

Then build and execute a plan to improve it.

We want problem solvers, not reporters.

4\. Media Buying Operations
You'll help own the operational side of running advertising at scale.

That includes:

Weekly and monthly spend planning

# Senior Legal Media Buyer - Google Search & YouTube

Duke Digital Group

[Glendale, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Glendale%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3890696089403215890?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6493&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5133806242973033993&crId=US_0US_0)

We’re looking for a Senior Legal Media Buyer who has a proven track record of scaling performance-driven campaigns in the legal space using Google Search and YouTube . This role is ideal for someone who understands how to turn high-intent traffic into qualified legal leads while navigating the compliance and competitive challenges of legal advertising.

You will own campaign strategy end-to-end — from setup and optimization to scaling and reporting — with a strong emphasis on lead quality, efficiency, and sustainable growth .

## WHAT YOU’LL DO

Plan, launch, and manage high-volume Google Search and YouTube campaigns for legal lead generation.

Own the full media buying lifecycle, including account structure, keyword strategy, bidding, budgets, and optimization .

Partner with creative and landing page teams to develop and refine ad copy, video concepts, and conversion-focused messaging .

Manage and scale media spend while maintaining efficiency across key performance indicators such as CPA, conversion rate, CTR, and CPC .

Continuously test and iterate on keywords, audiences, creatives, formats, and bidding strategies to improve performance.

Analyze performance trends to identify opportunities for scaling winners and eliminating inefficiencies .

Produce clear, actionable reporting that communicates results, insights, and next steps to internal stakeholders.

Stay current on Google Ads updates, policy changes, and legal advertising best practices .

Proactively identify performance risks and implement optimizations to maintain campaign stability at scale.

## WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

3+ years of direct response paid media experience , with hands‑on ownership of Google Search and YouTube campaigns.

Demonstrated experience running legal advertising campaigns (motor vehicle accidents, personal injury, mass tort, or similar verticals strongly preferred).

Strong understanding of Google Ads mechanics , including Quality Score, match types, bidding models, and conversion tracking.

Experience managing larger budgets and high lead volume campaigns.

Highly analytical with the ability to turn data into clear optimization actions .

Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally and contributing strategic input on creative and messaging direction .

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Proficient in Google Ads, Google Analytics, and reporting tools , with solid Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

## BONUS POINTS

Experience with call-based lead generation and call tracking platforms.

Familiarity with YouTube direct response and performance video campaigns .

Background working at a legal lead generation company or performance agency .

Experience optimizing toward lead quality and downstream performance , not just front-end metrics.
