# Senior Media Buyer

Easy Street Brands

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1456307907508284796?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1452675218409079924&crId=US_0US_0)

You know how to scale paid media aggressively without losing efficiency. You understand how creative, offers, landing pages, and customer behavior work together—and you know how to turn those insights into better performance.

You’re comfortable moving quickly, making decisions with imperfect information, and taking ownership of both campaign execution and the systems behind it.

If we’re scaling spend profitably, improving acquisition efficiency, and learning faster because of the decisions you’re driving, you’re doing your job.

About the Job
TL;DR - We’ll know you’re the one if…
You know how to scale paid media aggressively without losing efficiency. You understand how creative, offers, landing pages, and customer behavior work together—and you know how to turn those insights into better performance.

You’re comfortable moving quickly, making decisions with imperfect information, and taking ownership of both campaign execution and the systems behind it.

If we’re scaling spend profitably, improving acquisition efficiency, and learning faster because of the decisions you’re driving, you’re doing your job.

About the Job
We’re looking for a Senior Media Buyer to help scale an early-stage, high-growth wellness brand.

This role sits at the center of our paid acquisition engine, with a heavy emphasis on Meta. You’ll own day-to-day campaign execution and optimization while partnering closely with Growth and Creative leadership to shape testing priorities, allocate budgets, and identify opportunities for profitable scale.

You’ll join at a stage where your work can meaningfully influence how the brand grows. We’re looking for someone who enjoys being deep in ad accounts, troubleshooting performance, and building repeatable systems as the business evolves.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong performance marketing instincts with operational discipline and wants hands‑on ownership in a fast-moving consumer business.

**What You’ll Do:**

Own day-to-day management and optimization of Meta campaigns across acquisition, retargeting, scaling, and creative testing

Support paid media efforts across additional channels, including Google, podcast, and linear/TV, as the media mix expands

Scale spend profitably against agreed MER, CAC, and contribution margin targets

Analyze performance daily, identify the drivers behind changes, and make timely optimization decisions

Build, launch, and iterate campaigns, audiences, offers, and creative tests at high velocity

Partner closely with the Creative team to develop testing priorities, share actionable feedback, and turn winning concepts into scalable campaigns

Collaborate with Growth leadership on forecasting, budget allocation, and channel planning

Monitor acquisition and funnel performance, including CAC, CVR, AOV, MER, and contribution margin, while incorporating retention insights into acquisition decisions

Identify opportunities to improve landing pages, offers, and the customer journey

Build reporting, testing, and campaign management systems that help the team move faster

Use AI tools to improve analysis, workflows, creative iteration, and operational efficiency

Stay current on platform changes, creative trends, and emerging DTC acquisition strategies

You’ll Love This Role If…

You enjoy being deep in ad accounts and making optimization decisions daily

You thrive in an early-stage environment where you can help build the systems and playbooks

You combine analytical thinking with strong creative instincts

You want meaningful ownership over performance outcomes and budget decisions

You enjoy collaborating with creatives and translating performance data into useful direction

You like testing quickly, learning from results, and finding new opportunities to scale

You’ll Hate This Role If…

You prefer slow-moving environments with multiple approval layers

You want a purely strategic role with limited hands‑on execution

You struggle to make decisions with imperfect information

You dislike accountability tied directly to business performance

You need established playbooks for every situation

You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities as a young brand grows

Must-Have Requirements

5+ years of experience managing paid social campaigns for DTC, eCommerce, or high-growth consumer brands

Deep expertise in Meta Ads Manager and performance-focused campaign scaling

Experience with Triple Whale, Northbeam, Shopify, or similar DTC analytics tools

Experience managing significant monthly budgets and making disciplined scaling decisions

Proven ability to grow spend profitably while maintaining efficiency targets

Strong understanding of MER, CAC, contribution margin, attribution, and DTC economics

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail

Experience collaborating with creative teams to improve testing and performance

Strong understanding of acquisition funnels, landing pages, offer strategy, and conversion optimization

Ability to manage multiple campaigns, priorities, and testing initiatives simultaneously

Comfort working autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment

Fluency with AI tools and practical experience using them to improve workflows, analysis, and execution

Nice to Have

Experience scaling an early-stage wellness, supplement, or consumer health brand

Familiarity with Google, podcast, or linear/TV media buying

Familiarity with advertising policies and claims considerations for wellness products

What You Can Expect

Remote Work Opportunity - Work remotely while collaborating closely with Growth and Creative teams

Autonomy & Ownership - Take meaningful responsibility for campaign performance, testing priorities, and media decisions

Direct Impact - Help shape the acquisition engine of a brand in its early stages

Fast Feedback & Execution - Work with a team that values clear communication, quick decisions, and continuous learning

Room to Grow - Expand your impact as the brand, budgets, and team scale

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to help build a high-growth wellness brand at a formative stage.

You’ll have hands‑on ownership of paid acquisition, close collaboration with Growth and Creative leadership, and the opportunity to build systems that support the brand’s next phase of growth.

If you enjoy the pace of an early-stage business and want to turn strong creative, disciplined testing, and smart media decisions into profitable scale, we’d love to hear from you.

improveit 360 is looking for a **Senior Growth Marketing Manager – ABM** to build and scale our account-based marketing strategy for a focused market of high-value remodeling businesses.

This is a strategic, hands-on role for an experienced ABM marketer who can bring Marketing and Sales together around a shared target-account strategy and turn account intelligence into programs that drive engagement, pipeline and revenue.

You’ll own the ABM motion across target account strategy, account tiering, buying committee engagement, intent, coordinated Sales and Marketing plays, Marketing Qualified Accounts (MQAs), and measurement. Because we serve a relatively small, high-value market, you’ll help us determine where highly personalized 1:1 and 1:few approaches matter most and where broader account-based programs can create leverage.

Most importantly, you’ll build a strong partnership with Sales and create a repeatable ABM operating model that both teams can use to identify, engage and progress the accounts that matter most.

**Responsibilities:**

Own the ABM Strategy

- Own and continuously refine improveit 360’s Target Account List (TAL), account tiers and prioritization criteria in partnership with Sales.
- Define priority personas and buying committees and improve contact coverage across target accounts.
- Develop the right mix of 1:1, 1:few and 1:many strategies based on account value, ICP fit, intent and engagement.
- Build and maintain a prioritized roadmap for evolving the ABM program as our capabilities mature.

Build and Activate Account-Based Programs

- Develop integrated account-based plays across priority accounts and segments.
- Translate account tiers, buying committees and customer needs into differentiated engagement strategies.
- Partner with Paid Media, Product Marketing, Content, Events and other teams to activate coordinated account experiences.
- Identify messaging, content and personalization needs and partner with channel owners to bring them to market.
- Test and optimize channels, audiences, messaging and plays based on account engagement and progression.

Lead Sales + Marketing Alignment

- Serve as the primary Marketing partner to Sales leadership for the ABM motion.
- Establish recurring account reviews focused on priority accounts, intent, engagement and next actions.
- Translate Marketing and account intelligence into actionable recommendations for AEs and SDRs.
- Develop Sales plays and enablement tied to account tier, persona and buying signals.
- Build feedback loops so Sales insights continually improve targeting, messaging and qualification.

Own Account Progression + Measurement

- Own the account funnel from target account → engaged account → MQA → Sales-accepted account → opportunity → pipeline/revenue.
- Define and continuously improve MQA criteria and Sales handoffs in partnership with Sales and RevOps.
- Use account fit, intent, buying committee engagement and Marketing activity to identify accounts showing meaningful buying signals.
- Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps on ZoomInfo MarketingOS, Salesforce integrations, data quality, workflows and reporting.
- Measure account coverage, engagement, MQAs, Sales acceptance, opportunities, pipeline and revenue.
- Use performance data and Sales feedback to identify where accounts are stalling and continually improve the program.

**Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:**

You enjoy building, not simply inheriting a mature ABM program. You’re comfortable walking into ambiguity, assessing what exists and creating structure without overengineering it.

You know successful ABM starts with Sales and Marketing agreeing on who matters, how to engage them and what happens when an account shows interest. You bring a strong point of view while remaining collaborative enough to adapt based on Sales feedback, customer insights and performance.

Ultimately, you’re focused on building the right ABM program for the market — one that is actionable for Sales and creates measurable account progression, pipeline and revenue.

- Significant experience building or leading B2B account-based marketing programs, ideally in SaaS or another complex B2B environment.

- Hands-on experience with target account strategy, account tiering, buying committees, intent, personalization and ABM measurement.

- Strong understanding of 1:1, 1:few and 1:many ABM models and when to use each.

- Demonstrated ability to partner with Sales leadership, AEs and SDRs to build shared account strategies and coordinated plays.

- Experience with ABM and intent platforms such as ZoomInfo MarketingOS, 6sense, Demandbase, Propensity or similar.

- Strong understanding of Salesforce and experience partnering with Marketing Ops and RevOps on data, integrations and reporting.

- Analytical mindset with the ability to translate account data into clear actions and business decisions.

- Ability to move comfortably between strategy and execution and work cross-functionally across Marketing.

- Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.

**Where:**

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States– if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

**Benefits and Perks**

- Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
- Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
- 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
- Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
- Employee Stock Purchase Program

# Senior Marketing Manager, Technology

$96k

Full-time

Innovatis Group

[Nashville, TN](https://jooble.org/jobs/Nashville%2C-TN)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1096994673553796678?p=1&pos=0&rgn=44757&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1865451142368408261&crId=US_0US_0)

Innovatis Group is hiring a **Senior Marketing Manager** to lead marketing for our technology client portfolio, a group of associations and user communities that serve IT and technology professionals. You will own marketing strategy and results across these clients, manage a small team of marketers, and act as a strategic advisor to client leadership. This role reports to the Senior Director of Marketing and works closely with our creative, events, and client services teams. If you like solving problems, developing people, and turning client goals into plans that achieve them, we would love to talk with you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Lead marketing strategy and annual plans for a portfolio of technology association and user community clients, tying marketing goals to each client's membership, event, and revenue objectives.
- Serve as the senior marketing contact for client leadership. Bring recommendations, challenge assumptions with data, and translate client goals into clear, actionable plans.
- Oversee campaigns across email, social, web, SEO, content, and paid media that drive member acquisition and retention, conference registration, and sponsor and partner engagement.
- Own results for your portfolio. Set KPIs, track performance, report outcomes to clients and Innovatis leadership, and adjust quickly when something isn't working.
- Build and manage marketing budgets for your clients, including forecasting, tracking spend, and explaining financial tradeoffs to clients and internal stakeholders.
- Plan and balance workload across your team. Scope projects, estimate resources, clarify roles, flag risks early, and keep work on time and on budget.
- Manage and develop a handful of direct reports. Set SMART goals, give regular and specific feedback, hold career development conversations, and delegate meaningful work.
- Address performance issues promptly and fairly, and partner with HR and leadership when needed.
- Hold yourself and your team to Innovatis quality standards: accurate, error-free work that fits each client's brand and voice.
- Collaborate across the marketing department and with creative, events, IT, and client services teams. Share knowledge and help build a cooperative team culture.
- Address conflict and difficult conversations directly and constructively with clients and team members, explain the reasoning behind decisions, and involve senior leadership when needed.
- Stay current on technology communities, digital marketing practices, and AI tools, and bring new ideas to clients and the team.

**Basic Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, public relations, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- Minimum 6 years of progressive marketing experience, including at least 2 years directly managing and developing employees. Demonstrated experience leading marketing strategy, managing budgets, and delivering measurable results across multiple clients or complex marketing programs.
- Ability to travel up to 15% for client conferences, events, and meetings.
- Comfortable working a hybrid schedule with 3 days per week in our Nashville office.
- Experience marketing to technical or B2B audiences, experience with members of associations, user groups, or professional communities is a plus
- Proven ability to build and manage budgets, forecast spend, and explain financial decisions to clients and leadership.
- Track record of managing multiple clients or projects at once and keeping them on time and on budget.
- Strong critical thinking and sound business judgment, with the ability to act confidently in ambiguous situations.
- Flexible and steady under pressure. Able to balance competing priorities and personalities while keeping a positive, encouraging attitude.
- Takes ownership of outcomes and holds self and others accountable for high-quality work.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly, professionally, and effectively to diverse audiences.
- Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs and remain standing for extended periods as needed
- Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Innovatis Group is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- 8 or more years of relevant marketing experience, ideally within an agency, association management company, or organization serving technical or B2B audiences.
- Agency experience serving multiple clients at once.
- Experience with technology user groups, IT communities, or tech partner and sponsor programs.
- Experience marketing conferences and events, including registration and sponsorship campaigns.
- Hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM, and other key marketing tools (HubSpot experience is a plus)
- Experience with SEO and content optimization, including video and webinar libraries.
- Experience using AI tools to improve marketing workflows and output.

**Salary** :

The base salary for this position starts at $96k annually, with final compensation based on experience and qualifications.

**Location** :

Nashville, TN (Capitol View area)

Hybrid work schedule (3 days in-office, 2 days remote)

_This is not a fully remote role._

**Deadline to Apply:**

We anticipate closing applications on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Applications will be reviewed, and candidates will be screened and interviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage interested candidates to apply early. The application period may close earlier or be extended based on hiring needs.

**Benefits:**

- Medical, dental & vision (plus medical plan perks like virtual care, nurse advocate, EAP, free access to Headspace, gym + wellness/beauty discounts, and alternative medicine discounts)
- UNUM voluntary benefits incl. short/long-term disability, AD&D, and additional coverage options
- Employer HSA contribution
- 401(k) with 5% match (Roth or Traditional) after 6 months
- PTO: generous upon start + unlimited PTO after 1 year; 10 paid company holidays
- Paid parental leave after 1 year: 12 weeks maternity / 4 weeks paternity
- Hybrid, flexible, and collaborative work environment
- Pre-tax commuter benefits (for public transit)
- Professional development stipend & support
- Company culture perks like frequent Lunch & Learns, quarterly social events, and holiday parties

**About Innovatis Group:**

At Innovatis Group, we’re not just one of the fastest-growing association management companies; we’re committed to redefining partnership and impact. We blend strategic innovation with execution, helping clients drive meaningful results while supporting their broader goals. If you thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and enjoy collaborating with industry-leading brands, Innovatis Group offers the tools, team, and environment to help you make a lasting impact.

**Our Values:**

At Innovatis Group, our values guide how we work, collaborate, and show up for one another every day. We believe in doing meaningful work with intention, integrity, and adaptability.

• Be deliberate & purposeful

• Be creative

• Be accountable

• Be honest & transparent

• Collaborate relentlessly

• Be agile

Benefits, perks, and work arrangements are subject to change and may vary based on role, location, or business needs.

Innovatis Group is an equal opportunity employer and aspires to be a leader in fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every individual is empowered to bring their whole self to work. We commit to embracing and promoting diversity in all its forms, ensuring equitable opportunities, and cultivating an inclusive culture that respects and values differences. Together, we will drive better outcomes for our employees, our clients, and our community.

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Responsibilities may evolve based on organizational and client needs.

# Senior Product Marketing Manager

$100k - $130k

Full-time

Reveal Technology

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7552527421780058852?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=378&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-7616268492837393125&crId=US_0US_0)

**About Reveal Technology**

Founded in 2019, Reveal is a dynamic startup revolutionizing field operations by delivering software tools and intelligence to operators in remote, disconnected, and extreme environments. Reveal is the Digital Arms Room for the Modern Warrior — providing the tactical intelligence and automation platform for physical, human, and digital terrain at the edge.

Our flagship products include Farsight, a 3D processing and mission planning platform that transforms complex terrain into operational advantage, and Identifi, a secure identity verification solution designed for rapid, trusted identification in dynamic environments. In 2026, Reveal expanded its software portfolio to include Chronos and Anomaly 6, further strengthening its capabilities across the modern battlefield.

Reveal exists to serve defense, security, and public safety missions where time is compressed, information is contested, and precision matters. We are scaling our team and technology to meet the accelerating demands of modern warfare and national security.

**About the Role**

Reveal is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead product marketing for Farsight and Emerging Products as we deliver on our mission to Modernize the Warrior.

Farsight is a 3D mapping and terrain intelligence platform that turns drone, satellite, and sensor imagery into a single operational interface, empowering frontline units to plan, rehearse, and execute missions at the tactical edge.

Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, you will partner with the GM of our Geospatial Business Unit who leads Farsight, our CTO who leads Emerging Products, and Sales leaders to develop positioning, market strategy, and build and execute the mission-focused campaigns supported by your product portfolio. You will become fluent in our markets, customers, and products and translate those insights into differentiated messaging, compelling customer evidence, and integrated marketing campaigns.

This is a hands-on role spanning research, strategy, writing, and execution. You should be equally comfortable developing a product narrative, designing a sales deck or slick sheet, editing a video demo, manning a tradeshow booth, driving content generation at tactical events, and measuring KPIs.

\\n **Responsibilities**

- **Lead Product Marketing for Farsight & Emerging Products:** Own product marketing for your portfolio. Use customer, market, and competitive research to shape positioning, inform pricing, and develop GTM strategy with the Director of Product Marketing and your Product and Sales partners.
- **Develop and Execute Strategic Campaigns:** Partner with BU and GTM leaders to develop and execute the Edge Mission Command, Agile Targeting, and Expeditionary Mobile Ops campaigns supported by Farsight and Emerging Products.
- **Build the GTM Kit & Sales Enablement Assets:** Own the writing, design, maintenance, and adoption of your portfolio’s GTM assets, including sales decks, slick sheets, competitive battlecards, customer case studies, product videos, demos, and white papers.
- **Execute Email Marketing:** Develop product-specific nurture content and sales outreach emails within Reveal’s centralized email marketing program, coordinating with Sales, Product, and Marketing Operations.
- **Drive Product Announcements:** Develop messaging, customer evidence, and supporting assets for product launches, contract awards, and fielding milestones, coordinating with the Director of Product Marketing, Communications, Social Media, Product, and GTM partners.
- **Support Tradeshows & Field Demos:** Own product messaging, content, and demo narratives for your portfolio at tradeshows, BattleLab, and field demonstrations. Partner with Events, Product, and Sales to engage priority customers, capture customer feedback, and advance opportunities.
- **Drive Lead Generation & Measure Success:** Maintain monthly and quarterly scorecards tracking qualified lead generation, target customer engagement, sales enablement adoption, and pipeline progression for your portfolio. Partner with Sales to convert engagement into qualified opportunities and use results to refine strategy and tactics.

**Requirements**

- An entrepreneurial mindset, mission-driven work ethic, and a high standard of excellence and culture.
- 5–7 years of experience in Product Marketing, GTM Marketing, or a similar role at a high-velocity defense tech company or startup.
- Experience in defense technology, national security, or government-facing technology markets, with an understanding of how user needs, technical evaluation, funding, and acquisition shape purchasing decisions.
- Demonstrated ability to develop product positioning and execute GTM campaigns in partnership with Product and Sales.
- Strong customer research and market analysis skills with the ability to turn insights into actionable recommendations re: pricing, positioning, and GTM tactics.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Ability to write compelling narratives, key messages, and sales materials (no AI-generated copy) that translate product capabilities into customer value.
- Demonstrated ability to create high-quality sales enablement assets, customer case studies, product videos, and demo content that support adoption and commercial growth.
- Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to track meaningful KPIs, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work.
- Demonstrated ability to roll up your sleeves to write, design, build, and edit digital and video assets using Adobe, Figma, Canva, and Google Slides; manage projects; and build trusted partnerships across Product, Sales, Engineering, and Marketing.

**Location**

- Remote
- Strong preference to those located in Bozeman, MT or Washington DC

**Compensation**

- Salary ($100,000 - $130,000) + Equity
- Salary is determined by the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

**Benefits**

- Medical, Dental, Vision coverage
- HSA/FSA options
- Parental Leave
- 401(k): 100% match for the first 6% contributed
- Unlimited Paid Time Off
- Home Office Stipend

Drata is building the trust layer between great companies - automating compliance, managing risk, and helping organizations prove trust continuously as they scale. We're Dratanauts: a global crew of 600+ professionals united by a culture that rewards integrity, ownership, and raising the bar, no matter where in the world we're working from.

Why Join the Drata Team?
At Drata, you're not maintaining legacy compliance software - you're building the agentic AI platform defining what trust looks like for the next generation of companies. Here's what makes the work itself worth showing up for:

Problems without a playbook: You'll work at the edge of AI and security, building agentic governance, continuous compliance, and real-time trust verification to solve problems that don't have an established answer yet. You're writing it as you go.

Real ownership, not just process: Our values center on owning outcomes and raising the bar, not checking boxes. You're expected to have opinions and back them.

A seat at the table: Your perspective is unique and valued. Open debate and diverse viewpoints are built into how decisions actually get made here, at every level.

Growth at rocketship speed: Drata is scaling fast, which means scope grows fast too. High performers get more ownership, visibility, and experience.

A crew, not just coworkers: Dratanauts consistently describe a "come as you are" culture with sharp, curious people—the kind of team that makes hard problems genuinely fun to solve. See what they say here and follow us on LinkedIn for company news, employee stories, and career updates.

**Job Summary:**
As Senior Marketing Operations Manager, you will lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of our marketing technology ecosystem. You will architect, implement, and manage the systems and integrations that power our go-to-market (GTM) engine, with a sharp focus on scalability, data integrity, automation, and lead orchestration.

This role is pivotal in ensuring that marketing, sales, customer success, business development and product teams are aligned and empowered to execute with speed and precision. You’re a Driver, you don’t just wait for projects and problems to come to you, but you identify them and execute without hesitation.

This role will report to the Director, Marketing Operations, a critical part of our connected GTM Operations team. You’ll bring a track record of proven success, preferably in a high-growth, fast-paced startup environment.

**What you’ll do:**

Own the marketing technology stack (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce integration, LeanData, Qualified, 6sense, attribution tooling, etc) — driving roadmap, implementation, integration, and performance.

Evaluate, recommend, and deploy new tools to enhance marketing execution and measurement.

Architect a scalable infrastructure that supports pipeline acceleration, attribution, scoring, and personalized engagement.

Translate lead management and routing requirements into system logic.

Own end-to-end implementation of lead assignment rules, SLAs, escalation flows, and scoring models.

Partner with Sales Ops and Marketing Ops to continuously optimize routing for speed, accuracy, and fairness.

Ensure data quality, enrichment, normalization, and compliance across platforms.

Monitor data pipelines and troubleshoot discrepancies across systems.

Establish governance frameworks for platform changes, including documentation, QA, and release management.

Serve as the technical lead for marketing in cross-functional projects, including GTM launches, sales handoff optimization, and analytics integration.

Identify automation opportunities to increase operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Leverage AI and machine learning capabilities in tools to enhance targeting, scoring, and predictive analytics.

Monitor and report on system health, performance metrics, and process efficiency.

**What you’ll bring:**

7+ years of experience with HubSpot, SFDC, 6sense, LeanData, Clay, Qualified, and other prospecting tools

Deep expertise with marketing automation, CRM systems, and data integration tools (Marketo, Salesforce, LeanData, Segment, Workato, or similar).

Strong understanding of lead lifecycle, funnel stages, routing logic, and attribution models.

Experience with API integrations, custom workflows, and marketing data schemas.

Strong organizational and project management skills.

An unmatched attention to detail, taking pride in everything you do and understanding that the little things matter

Ability to manage competing priorities in a results-driven environment

At Drata, our people are our strongest advantage—and we prove it with support that exceeds industry standards. Our total rewards package is designed to power your well-being, accelerate your growth, and keep your work-life balance thriving.

Financial Well-being: A comprehensive suite of financial benefits, including a 401(k) plan , company-paid life and disability insurance , tax-advantaged spending accounts , and a range of discounted voluntary offerings to help you customize and strengthen your overall financial position.

Family Support: We want to support you in life's most important moments, so we offer a paid Parental Leave policy, after six months of employment. Employees also receive access to Kindbody fertility and family-building benefits and dedicated leave specialists who help guide you through the entire process.

Illumio

### Onwards Together!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience.Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

### **Location: 4 on-site days a week in Sunnyvale, CA Headquarters.**

### **Our Team's Vision:**

Our Marketing team illuminates and evolves the global brand, driving revenue and empowering future success for our Sales team. As a leader in Zero Trust Segmentation, we are dedicated to helping organizations prevent cyberattacks and mitigate the impact of ransomware.

Renowned for our innovative solutions and collaborative spirit, we foster an inclusive environment within Marketing and across the company. Join one of the industry's most creative and dynamic teams, where you'll discover opportunities to excel, be empowered to set ambitious goals and define your path to success!

### **About the Role:**

We’re looking for a strategic, hands‑on technical leader to help shape how modern marketing works. As our Marketing Technology & AI Manager, you’ll own and evolve the architecture, integrations, and technical capabilities that power our marketing engine, from core platforms like Marketo, Salesforce, and 6sense to emerging AI tools and automation. You’ll work hands‑on to solve complex problems, connect systems, experiment with new technologies, and help Marketing move faster and generate more pipeline.

AI will be a major part of how we scale. You’ll help identify where it can create the most value, rapidly test new ideas, and turn successful experiments into scalable capabilities.

### **Your Impact:**

- Own and evolve the architecture, integrations, and technical capabilities of our marketing technology ecosystem, including Marketo, Salesforce, 6sense, Qualified, and emerging AI platforms.

- Help define the Mar Tech roadmap, identifying where new platforms, AI, automation, and architecture changes can improve marketing performance and scale.

- Build integrations, workflows, and automations that connect systems and improve marketing execution.

- Identify and implement AI-powered workflows, agents, and automation that improve speed, productivity, and customer engagement.

- Rapidly prototype and test new technologies, then scale the ideas that create meaningful business value.

- Improve lead and account processes including segmentation, scoring, routing, enrichment, and intent.

- Partner with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, IT, and Data teams to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

- Manage contractors and technical resources as needed.


### **Your Toolkit:**

- 5+ years of experience in Marketing Technology, Marketing Operations, Marketing Automation, Revenue Operations, or a similar technical role, or equivalent demonstrated technical depth.

- Deep hands‑on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms, especially Marketo and Salesforce.

- Experience with platforms such as 6sense, Qualified, or similar marketing and revenue technologies.

- Experience designing system architecture, integrations, automated workflows, and solutions across multiple platforms.

- Hands‑on knowledge of APIs, webhooks, data flows, and system integrations.

- Practical experience with generative AI, AI agents, prompt engineering, or intelligent automation.

- Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business needs into working solutions.

- Working knowledge of SQL, JavaScript, HTML, or similar technologies is a plus.


### **What Success Looks Like:**

- Marketing launches campaigns faster because the underlying technology and integrations remove bottlenecks.

- AI and automation reduce manual work and help the team scale more efficiently.

- New ideas move quickly from concept to prototype to production.

- The Mar Tech ecosystem becomes more connected, scalable, and capable over time.

- Marketing technology contributes to stronger funnel performance and more pipeline.

# Sr Business Intelligence (BI) Marketing Analyst

$90k - $120k

Full-time

Grain Group

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7282079458272022475?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3575106938132798111&crId=US_0US_0)

**Overview**

Grain Group accelerates growth for ambitious consumer brands by aligning business insights with ROI-driven marketing. The team comprises strategic thinkers with backgrounds in business, media, technology, and finance.

**Position Summary**

Grain Group is seeking a Sr BI Analyst for hands-on, technical analytics and measurement work across our client portfolio. The role requires strong SQL skills, dashboard and database management, expertise in conversion tracking and measurement implementation, comfort building scripts and automations in Google Sheets and Apps Script, and experience using AI coding tools to build working analyses and internal tools.

You will connect paid media, retail, CRM, e-commerce, and sales data for CPG and product brands, build the measurement infrastructure required to accurately track performance, and turn that data into insights, performance forecasts, and recommendations that drive business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Write and maintain SQL in BigQuery that joins media platform, retail, e-commerce, and client-side sales data into clean, reusable tables
- Own data integrity across accounts: QA tracking, tagging, conversion events, and data feeds, and fix breaks before they reach client reporting
- Build and maintain Looker Studio dashboards aligned to client KPIs and business objectives
- Build and update monthly Impact Estimates using historical performance, benchmarks, and current results; compare against actuals and adjust the method when estimates drift
- Prepare data for and interpret marketing mix models (MMM), incrementality tests, and attribution analysis
- Analyze sales and sell-through data alongside media spend for CPG clients across Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, and DTC
- Write Google Apps Script and Sheets automations for pacing, QA, data pulls, and report prep
- Vibe code internal tools and scripts with AI coding assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar), then test and ship them
- Manage and implement conversion tracking across platforms, including Google Tag Manager, platform pixels/tags, and ad account conversion action settings
- Implement and troubleshoot server-side and advanced measurement solutions, including Conversion API and similar platform integrations
- Build offline and CRM-based conversion pipelines that send lead stage and downstream outcome data back to advertising platforms for reporting, attribution, and bid optimization
- Design funnel-based measurement frameworks that connect upper-funnel actions to qualified leads, opportunities, purchases, revenue, or other meaningful business outcomes
- Standardize recurring analytics workflows so they run the same way on every account

**Strategic & Cross-Functional Responsibilities**

- Serve as a subject matter expert for data, measurement, conversion tracking, and analytics tooling
- Partner with Strategy team on planning inputs and with Performance team on interpreting results and improving execution
- Turn analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for strategists and clients
- Develop measurement plans that define KPIs, conversion hierarchies, funnel stages, data sources, and optimization signals
- Advise teams on conversion architecture, including primary vs. secondary conversion actions, attribution considerations, offline conversion imports, enhanced/server-side measurement, and platform optimization signals
- Participate in client calls and presentations to walk through analysis and findings
- Contribute to new business efforts including performance projections, measurement plans, and MMM scoping
- Mentor junior analysts on SQL, data QA, and automation best practices

**Requirements**

- 5+ years hands-on experience in media analytics, BI, or marketing analytics at a CPG brand, product company, or agency serving them
- Proven experience analyzing sales and marketing data together: spend, impressions, and conversions alongside retail sales, sell-through, or e-commerce revenue
- Advanced SQL, including CTEs, window functions, and multi-source joins
- Strong Google Sheets and Apps Script skills: custom functions, triggers, API pulls, and automations
- Hands-on experience vibe coding with AI tools, including testing and debugging the output
- Working knowledge of paid media platforms (Google, Meta, Amazon Ads, programmatic) and metrics such as ROAS, CPA, NTB, and incrementality
- Experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, or similar
- Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting digital conversion tracking using tools such as Google Tag Manager, configuring ad platform (Meta/Google/etc) conversion actions, event mappings, optimization events, and attribution settings
- Experience with advanced or server-side measurement such as Meta Conversion API, Google Enhanced Conversions, server-side GTM, or similar solutions
- Understanding of conversion architecture, including event deduplication, identifiers, attribution, conversion hierarchies, and primary vs. secondary optimization events
- Clear communicator who can explain findings to non-technical partners and clients
- Self-starter thriving in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments
- Experience with MMM platforms such as Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, Recast, or Measured (strong plus)
- Familiarity with retail media data (Amazon Marketing Cloud, Walmart Connect, Instacart, Skai), Python or R, or ETL tools such as dbt, Fivetran, or Supermetrics (bonus)

**Education:** Bachelor's degree (required)

**Experience:**

- SQL: 3 years (required)
- Marketing or media analytics: 3 years (required)
- GTM conversion tracking / measurement implementation: 3 years (required)
- Excel + Google Sheets / Apps Script: 3 years (required)
- Marketing mix modeling: 1 year (preferred)

**Language:** English (required)

**Location: Hybrid.** Must commute to New York, NY 10018 (in person) currently 3-days a week.

**Benefits**

- Dental insurance
- Flexible spending account
- Health insurance
- Health savings account
- Paid time off
- Parental leave
- Vision insurance

At MGM Resorts, we seek individuals like YOU to create unique and show-stopping experiences for our guests.THE JOB:The Senior Manager of Digital Marketing & Customer Analytics is responsible for shaping how MGM Resorts International measures, understands, and optimizes the performance of its digital marketing ecosystem. This role leads complex, cross-functional analytics initiatives across all digital channels, with accountability for defining measurement strategies, interpreting customer data, and delivering insights that directly influence enterprise marketing decisions. This position serves as a senior analytics leader within the digital marketing function, independently owning large-scale initiatives and translating data into actionable strategies that drive business performance.THE DAY-TO-DAY:Define and evolve advanced measurement strategies across the full digital marketing ecosystem, including paid media, SEO/AEO, organic social, email, onsite, and by translating complex analyses into clear insights, implications, and recommendations that inform strategy and investment decisions.Lead advanced test-and-learn and causal measurement approaches, including A/B testing, geo-based experimentation, incrementality analysis, and other experimental methods, to quantify true marketing and experience impact.Provide analytical leadership and partnership on Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), including shaping measurement questions, creating and interpreting model results, and guiding stakeholders on how to apply insights in planning and optimization decisions.Guide attribution and performance measurement frameworks across channels, helping stakeholders understand media effectiveness, contribution, trade-offs, and opportunities for optimization across the customer journey.Deliver executive-ready narratives and insights by synthesizing data across channels, experiments, and time horizons, proactively identifying trends, risks, and opportunities that influence short- and mid-term strategy.Provide senior-level oversight and influence on digital analytics data quality, governance, tagging, and reporting solutions in partnership with MarTech, Data, and Platform teams, driving standardization and scalability across brands and business units.THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:Holds a Bachelor's DegreeHas 5+ Years of prior relevant experience in the relevant subject area expertise (e.g. industry or function) with experience in driving business performance through operational insights and analyticsExperience in writing and executing SQL, Python, and working with databases such as Databricks.Experience with data visualization tools (PowerBI, Databricks, etc.)Experience with Digital Analytics tools (Adobe Analytics, media partner platforms, Adobe Mix Modeler)Strong analytical skills, including ability to identify and quantify financial impactDeep hands-on experience across digital channels (paid media, SEO, organic social, onsite engagement, CRM)Strong expertise in experimental design, incrementality measurement, geo testing, or marketing mix modelingMaster's Degree in Finance, Business Management, Analytics or a related field - PreferredTHE PERKS & BENEFITS:Wellness incentive programs to help you stay healthy physically and mentallyAccess to company hotel, food and beverage, retail, and entertainment discounts as well as discounts with company partners on things like travel, electronics, online shopping, and moreFree parking on and off shiftHealth & Income Protection benefits (for eligible employees)Professional and personal development through programs and networking opportunities as well as volunteer opportunities in the communityVIEW JOB DESCRIPTION:Are you ready to JOIN THE SHOW? # Senior Marketing Manager

Full-time

Marcal Paper

[Saddle Brook, NJ](https://jooble.org/jobs/Saddle-Brook%2C-NJ)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-326357376113649550?p=1&pos=0&rgn=30066&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2765953875400992041&crId=US_0US_0)

**SUMMARY:**

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on **Senior Marketing Manager** to lead brand development and growth marketing initiatives across our expanding janitorial/sanitary product portfolio. Backed by private equity and positioned for continued growth through potential acquisitions and capacity expansion, we are looking for a dynamic marketing leader to elevate our multi-brand presence, drive awareness, and execute integrated campaigns that fuel scalable business growth.

This role will oversee marketing efforts across all product lines, with a strong focus on increasing visibility and market leadership of our **proprietary offerings** (e.g., Transcend). The ideal candidate will bring deep brand strategy expertise, full-funnel growth marketing experience, and preferably familiarity with the Away-From-Home (AFH) market, including paper products, janitorial/sanitation supplies, chemicals, liners, or dispensers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**• Brand Strategy & Positioning**

- Develop and execute holistic brand strategies for the entire product portfolio, with targeted campaigns for proprietary lines.
- Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all customer touchpoints and channels.
- Benchmark performance against industry competitors to identify gaps and position both proprietary and distributed products effectively.

**• Growth Marketing**

- Lead integrated marketing programs that drive demand, sales enablement, and market expansion across product lines.
- Manage digital initiatives including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and paid media to accelerate pipeline and revenue growth.
- Implement content-driven strategies to engage key stakeholders within janitorial distributors and end-use facilities.

**• Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Collaborate with Sales, Product Development, and Executive Leadership to align marketing strategies with business objectives.
- Support M&A integration and capacity expansion initiatives with strategic marketing plans and market readiness activities.

**• Team Leadership & Vendor Management**

- Lead and mentor internal marketing talent and manage relationships with external creative, media, and technology partners.
- Assess team capabilities and scale marketing operations to support the company’s accelerated growth trajectory.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications, or related field; MBA preferred.
- 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong track record in brand development and digital growth.
- Background in the AFH sector strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated success in driving measurable brand awareness and sales growth through comprehensive marketing strategies.
- Ability to operate both strategically and tactically, with a hands-on approach to implementation.
- Experience in fast-paced, growth-oriented, or PE-backed environments is highly desirable.
- Proficiency in modern marketing tools including CRM, marketing automation, analytics platforms, and CMS.

**Ideal Candidate Traits:**

- Visionary execution-oriented marketing leader.
- Customer-centric and data-driven, with a creative edge.
- Strong communicator and collaborator across functions.
- Adaptable, entrepreneurial, and thrive in dynamic environments.

**Why Join Us:**

- Join a financially strong, private equity-backed company with aggressive growth plans.
- Make a direct impact by shaping and executing the company’s marketing strategy.
- Work in a collaborative and results-driven culture that values leadership, innovation, and accountability.

# Senior Partner Marketing Manager, Sage Intacct

Sage Intacct

[Atlanta, GA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Atlanta%2C-GA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5188223002842769282?p=1&pos=0&rgn=10460&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4556844736141607554&crId=US_0US_0)

Job TitleSenior Partner Marketing Manager, Sage Intacct
Job DescriptionWe’re looking for a Senior Partner Marketing Manager with Demand Gen experience to lead our North American marketing efforts targeting (Certified Public Accountant) CPA firms—a critical growth channel for Sage Intacct, the only financial management solution endorsed by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA).

In this role, you'll develop and deliver the marketing strategy that engages leaders (Firm Partners) at CPA firms, to generate referrals for Sage Intacct. Your focus will be on helping them fully realize the value of Sage Intacct in scaling their practice, enhancing client service and driving awareness within these firms so they position Sage Intacct as the solution they trust and recommend to their clients.

You’ll bring together strategic planning and hands-on execution—partnering closely with internal teams and practice leads to deliver compelling campaigns, targeted messaging, and meaningful engagement across the full partner journey.

A background marketing/selling accounting and financial management software solutions to CPA firms or a background in marketing at CPA firms—or direct experience as an accountant or CPA turned marketer—is essential to understanding this target audience and building credibility in the market.

Why Sage? What's In it for you?
Sage helps small to medium-sized businesses to succeed with AI-powered Accounting & ERP software. Knowing that over 6M of our global customers depend on our solutions motivates us to keep innovating so they keep growing with confidence. Sage Copilot for Sage Intacct:

You'll have the opportunity to grow and develop your career at a stable, global SaaS company with products voted #1 in customer satisfaction for 10 consecutive years. Collaborate with globally diverse, customer-focused teams that embrace innovation, bold thinking, and impactful work. Our culture is guided by our mantra and values: We Do the Right Thing: We are Human, We are Bold, We create Trust & We Simplify. We support flexible working and encourage giving back globally by offering every employee 40 paid volunteer hours per year to make a difference in our communities through Sage Foundation.

**What we're looking for? Qualifications:**

- 5 years of experience marketing accounting and financial management software or ERP solutions
- A background as an accountant or experience marketing at or to CPA firms.
- Demand gen marketing experience including lead flow, campaign strategies and tactics preferred.
- Experience tracking integrated campaign and funnel performance—from MQL through SQL—and using analysis to identify gaps, measure results, and optimize co-marketing programs
- Ability to build trusted, consultative partner relationships and influence adoption of marketing programs to deliver measurable results.
- Excellent cross-functional collaboration and effective communication skills.
- Creative problem-solving abilities and a bias for action.
- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.

Key Responsibilities• Collaborate with CPA firms that run a digital practice and are Sage Intacct value added resellers, to plan and execute co-marketing campaigns that drive demand and generate sales qualified opportunities (SQOs).

- Serve as the primary marketing contact for assigned VAR (value-added reseller) partners, fostering strong relationships and ensuring alignment with Sage’s strategic goals.
- Build referral programs to activate CPA firm referrals.
- Collaborate with Partner Sales, Product Marketing, and internal Performance Marketing teams to support partner marketing initiatives and campaigns.
- Provide strategic and consultative guidance to partners on marketing best practices, campaign execution, and performance optimization.
- Track, measure, and report on partner campaign performance and planned activities, including insights into what’s working well and where improvements are needed.
- Manage partner MDF (Market Development Funds) and ensure effective utilization and ROI.
- Support partner enablement through marketing content, tools, and training.
- Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with partners and Sage Partner Sales Leadership to assess marketing impact and identify growth opportunities.
- Stay current on industry trends and competitor activities to inform partner strategies.

Benefits? We have plenty.

- Competitive annual bonuses
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
- 401(k) retirement match (100% matching up to 4%)
- 32 days paid time off (22 personal days & 10 national holidays)
- 18 weeks of paid parental leave (offered 1 year after the start date)
- Work Away Program: Opportunity to work & play for 10 weeks from another country (Sage-approved list)
- Sage Foundation: 5 days paid yearly to volunteer
- $5,250 tuition reimbursement per calendar year starting 6 months after the hire date
- Sage Wellness Rewards Program ($600 wellness credit and $360 fitness reimbursement annually)

# Senior Partner Marketing Manager

INTEGRATION APPLIANCE, INC.

[Massachusetts](https://jooble.org/jobs/Massachusetts)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1573825564049441552?p=1&pos=0&rgn=22&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3418397036559950181&crId=US_0US_0)

Senior Partner Marketing Manager Partner marketing is one of Intapp's biggest levers for growth, and this role owns a significant share of how that motion comes to life.

As Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you'll define the co-marketing strategy for Intapp's highest-tier partnerships, build the programs, and measure the impact alongside the partners reimagining how professional firms work. AI and innovation partnerships are the ecosystem's fastest-growing segment, and you'll lead the marketing behind them — co-marketing with applied-AI leaders and the emerging agentic partners reshaping professional services. This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role with real budget responsibility. You'll own Intapp's partner sponsorship program end to end, serve as the senior partner marketing contact across the ecosystem and internally, and bring an AI-native operating model to how the team works. Success is measured in pipeline sourced, partners activated, and revenue influenced. Candidates with B2B partner or alliance marketing experience and genuine fluency in the AI landscape are encouraged to apply.

### What you will do

- Own and evolve Intapp's partner marketing strategy across the full ecosystem — turning it into a measurable pipeline and co-sell engine — and lead the marketing behind Intapp's AI and innovation partnerships, including foundation model, applied-AI, and agentic technology partners.
- Serve as the primary marketing point of contact for key partners and represent Intapp at partner events and executive briefings.
- Own the Advantage sponsorship program end to end: position opportunities to partners, track sponsorship dollars against plan, manage invoicing, and hold each activation accountable to the pipeline and revenue it returns.
- Plan and orchestrate the full co-marketing mix — joint go-to-markets, co-sell campaigns, event and partner sponsorships, digital campaigns, content syndication, webinars, and co-branded content — that sources and influences pipeline with senior decision-makers at target firms.
- Set strategy and direct delivery across the marketing and partner teams.
- Shape the category narrative for Firm AI in the partner ecosystem: the positioning, messaging, and thought leadership that make Intapp the reference point for how professional firms adopt AI through partners.
- Ensure partners are accurately represented across Intapp web properties, collateral, and other marketing assets.
- Build the frameworks and playbooks that scale the program — partner activation briefs, campaign activation plans, and measurement models — and bring an AI-native operating model to the team, setting the standard for using AI tools to accelerate content production, research, and campaign development.
- Own the partner marketing roadmap and annual plan: assess the partner tier structure, identify gaps by partner type and segment, scope investment, set measurable targets, and translate priorities into a quarterly plan leadership can act on.
- Define and track partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, revenue, and activation rates, and maintain the reporting cadence that keeps marketing and alliance leadership informed.

### What you will need

- 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant time in partner, channel, or alliance marketing and a track record of owning strategy, not just execution — including demonstrated ability to build co-marketing programs that generate measurable pipeline.
- Experience owning a partner marketing or sponsorship budget: positioning opportunities, tracking spend against plan, managing invoicing, and holding programs accountable to performance.
- Genuine fluency in the AI landscape — how LLMs, applied AI, and agentic technology are changing enterprise software and professional services — and an AI-native way of working: you use AI tools actively across content, research, and campaigns and can raise a team's standard for how AI scales the work.
- Excellent writing and editing skills with the ability to distill complex product value into clear messaging for different partner audiences, strong program and stakeholder leadership across multiple simultaneous workstreams, and fluency with the modern B2B martech stack (CRM, marketing automation, ABM/intent, analytics, and event platforms).
- Familiarity with the professional services or legal, financial, or accounting technology market, or a track record of getting up to speed quickly in a new vertical.
- A bias toward outcomes over activity: you measure your work by what it produces.
- Preferred qualifications:
- Experience marketing with and through technology alliances, AI partners, or professional services channel partners.
- Experience managing partner sponsorship, MDF, or co-op programs — covering positioning, tracking, invoicing, and performance.
- Experience shaping category or thought-leadership narratives in a fast-moving technology space.
- Background working alongside a professional services or consulting go-to-market motion.
- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 15% of the time.

### What you will gain at Intapp

- Expand Your Skills: Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
- Enjoy Where You Work: Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
- Support What Matters Most: Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most.
- We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.
- Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority.
- Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

# Senior Partner Programs Marketing Manager

Sage Intacct

[Atlanta, GA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Atlanta%2C-GA)

Job TitleSenior Partner Programs Marketing Manager
Job DescriptionClient Advisory Services are changing how CPA firms, outsourced accounting providers, BPOs, and fractional CFO firms support their clients. These firms are building higher-value advisory practices that depend on stronger financial management technology, scalable processes, and better client insights.

Sage Intacct Advisory Practice sits directly in that shift. Sage Intacct is the only software solution endorsed by the AICPA, giving Sage a strong credibility point with the accounting profession and a clear opportunity to help advisory firms build, scale, and grow with Sage Intacct.

The Sage Intacct Advisory Practice supports this ecosystem by helping advisory firms understand, adopt, and grow with Sage Intacct as a platform for modern finance and accounting services. As Senior Partner Programs Manager, Sage Intacct Advisory Practice, you will build and manage the programs that help bring this strategy to life across North America.

This is primarily an internal-facing partner programs role. You will create and manage the program frameworks, onboarding experiences, communications, partner portal resources, MDF-related activity, vendor support, reporting, and operating processes that help Partner Marketing Managers and partner-facing teams activate the Sage Intacct Advisory community at scale.

While the role may support partner-facing activity through program rollout, communications, events, or feedback gathering, the core focus is not owning individual partner relationships. The focus is building the repeatable program engine that helps Sage engage CPA firms, BPOs, fractional CFO firms, and Client Advisory Services practices more consistently and effectively.

This is a hands-on programs role for someone who understands B2B SaaS partner ecosystems, indirect channels, marketing programs, program operations, and how partner engagement connects to pipeline, revenue, and long-term partner growth.

This role is a strong fit for someone who likes building structure around a high-potential partner ecosystem: turning ideas into programs, programs into measurable engagement, and engagement into stronger partner participation, pipeline, and revenue impact.

Location Requirement: Hybrid - 3 days per week from our Atlanta or Austin office.
Key ResponsibilitiesPartner Program Strategy & Execution

- Develop, manage, and continuously improve Sage Intacct Advisory Practice programs for CPA firms, BPOs, fractional CFO firms, and Client Advisory Services practices.
- Build repeatable programs that help advisory partners understand, adopt, use, and recommend Sage Intacct as part of their practice growth strategy.
- Oversee partner entry, onboarding, participation, communications, and program engagement to create a clear and consistent partner experience.
- Support the creation, launch, and measurement of industry-led partner programs and campaigns across partner portal, email, webinar, event, and communication channels.

Partner Marketing & MDF Program Support

- Manage and optimize partner marketing programs, including MDF-related activity, program requirements, reporting, and reconciliation.
- Partner with Partner Marketing Managers, campaign teams, content teams, and partner-facing stakeholders to support with- and through-partner execution for advisory-focused programs.
- Create scalable program materials, campaign toolkits, communications, and enablement resources that Partner Marketing Managers and partner-facing teams can use with the advisory partner community.
- Ensure programs are aligned to partner engagement, pipeline development, revenue objectives, and Sage Intacct Advisory business priorities.

Program Operations & Vendor Management

- Manage program operations, including budgets, contracts, timelines, vendors, agencies, communications, reporting, and program reconciliation.
- Identify, negotiate with, and manage external vendors supporting Sage Intacct Advisory Practice programs.
- Coordinate internal stakeholders, vendors, agencies, and partner-facing teams to ensure programs are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned to Sage standards.
- Establish scalable processes, governance, and best practices that improve operational efficiency while maintaining a high-quality partner experience.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Track program performance, partner participation, campaign effectiveness, MDF activity, and partner engagement.
- Gather feedback from internal teams, partner-facing stakeholders, vendors, and program participants to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders on program performance, risks, learnings, and recommendations.
- Use data and feedback to refine programs, improve the partner experience, and increase program impact over time.

Minimum Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS partner programs, channel marketing, partner marketing, marketing programs, or indirect channel programs.
- Background supporting software partners, value-added resellers, CPA firms, accounting firms, advisory firms, BPOs, fractional CFO firms, or similar partner ecosystems.
- Strong program management skills, including budget management, vendor management, timelines, stakeholder coordination, and program reporting.
- Understanding of with- and through-partner marketing, MDF, partner communications, campaign execution, lead flow, and partner engagement.
- Strong business acumen with the ability to connect program strategy to pipeline development, partner participation, revenue objectives, and partner growth.
- Ability to work cross-functionally with Partner Marketing, Partner Sales, content, campaigns, operations, vendors, agencies, and external partner stakeholders.
- Clear communicator who can turn ambiguous business objectives into structured programs, repeatable processes, and measurable outcomes.
- Knowledge of accounting, financial management software, ERP, CPA firms, or Client Advisory Services is strongly preferred.

Who is Sage and Why Join?
Sage helps small to medium-sized businesses to succeed with AI-powered Accounting and Financial Management Software. Knowing that over 6M of our global customers depend on our solutions, motivates us to keep innovating so they keep growing with confidence.

- Build the program engine behind Sage Intacct Advisory Practice, helping CPA firms, BPOs, fractional CFO firms, and Client Advisory Services practices grow with Sage Intacct.
- Work at the intersection of B2B SaaS, accounting technology, partner ecosystems, and practice growth.
- Move beyond one-off partner campaigns by creating scalable programs, toolkits, processes, and partner experiences that can be used across North America.
- Partner closely with Partner Marketing, Partner Sales, campaigns, content, vendors, and advisory practice leaders in a role with visibility across the Sage Intacct partner ecosystem.
- Help strengthen how Sage supports advisory partners, measures partner engagement, and connects partner programs to pipeline, revenue, and long-term partner growth.

Benefits? We have plenty.

- Competitive annual bonuses (20%)
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
- 401(k) retirement match (100% matching up to 4%)
- 32 days paid time off (22 personal days & 10 national holidays)
- 18 weeks of paid parental leave (offered 1 year after the start date)
- Work Away Program: Opportunity to work & play for 10 weeks from another country (Sage-approved list)
- Sage Foundation: 5 days paid yearly to volunteer
- $5,250 tuition reimbursement per calendar year starting 6 months after the hire date
- Sage Wellness Rewards Program ($600 wellness credit and $360 fitness reimbursement annually)
