# Senior Ecommerce & Marketing Manager

$100k - $120k

Greenwich St. Jewelers

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1023392448990706397?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=522&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8354991441044229021&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid, 3 Days On-Site / 2 Days Remote

\\n

\\n

**Position Summary**

\\n

We are seeking a highly organized, analytical, and hands-on **Senior Ecommerce & Marketing Manager** to own the day-to-day execution, management, and optimization of Greenwich St. Jewelers' digital commerce experience across Shopify Plus, Email, and SMS.

\\n

\\n

Reporting to the Ecommerce & Marketing Director, this individual contributor role will have significant ownership across ecommerce operations, site merchandising, lifecycle marketing, testing and optimization, performance reporting, and digital project management. The Senior Manager will be expected to proactively identify opportunities, make strategic recommendations, and independently lead ecommerce initiatives from concept through execution and optimization.

\\n

\\n

The ideal candidate combines strong ecommerce expertise, operational rigor, creative sensibility, and analytical thinking. They are proactive, highly detail-oriented, comfortable making data-informed recommendations, and capable of independently managing multiple initiatives in a fast-paced luxury retail environment.

\\n

\\n

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic thinking and execution and is comfortable taking ownership from concept and briefing through implementation, analysis, and optimization.

\\n

\\n

This is a hybrid role based in New York City. The position will require full-time onsite attendance during the initial 60–90 day onboarding and training period, after which the schedule will transition to three days per week in the office and two days working remotely.

\\n

\\n

**Core Responsibilities**

\\n

**Ecommerce Strategy & Site Experience**

\\n

\\n - Own the day-to-day ecommerce experience across Shopify Plus, ensuring the site is accurate, compelling, on-brand, and optimized for conversion across desktop and mobile.
\\n - Partner with the Ecommerce & Marketing Director to translate broader business and marketing strategy into ecommerce initiatives and site experiences, while proactively identifying opportunities and recommending priorities that support ecommerce growth, conversion, and customer experience.
\\n - Lead site merchandising and digital execution for key commercial moments, including Holiday, Sale, Collaborations, product launches, and other strategic initiatives.
\\n - Leverage site performance, customer behavior, and merchandising data to identify opportunities and make actionable recommendations.
\\n - Own weekly and monthly ecommerce performance and merchandising reporting, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas requiring optimization.
\\n - Develop and manage ongoing testing and optimization initiatives across merchandising, content, navigation, and site experience.
\\n - Ensure press, promotional mentions, campaigns, and other brand moments are appropriately reflected throughout the website.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Site Merchandising & Operations**

\\n

\\n - Own the creation, merchandising, optimization, and ongoing maintenance of collection pages.
\\n - Conduct regular audits of designer collections, Top Navigation, PDPs, and other key site areas to ensure accuracy, consistency, and relevance.
\\n - Drive ongoing PDP optimization ensuring content is both consistent and up to date, while looking for opportunities to further enhance storytelling, product education, cross-selling, and UX.
\\n - Manage product imagery updates, alternate metal photography, merchandising adjustments, and related site content.
\\n - Identify opportunities to improve navigation, product discovery, merchandising, and the overall customer journey.
\\n - Maintain a high standard of site accuracy and proactively troubleshoot ecommerce issues as they arise.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Email & SMS**

\\n

\\n - Own the monthly creative briefing process for Email Campaigns, Flows, and SMS.
\\n - Develop campaign briefs, write copy, select imagery, and coordinate creative asset requirements with internal partners.
\\n - Partner with the Ecommerce & Marketing Director and Graphic Designer to move campaigns from concept through final execution.
\\n - Manage segmentation, scheduling, send-time optimization, and A/B testing strategies.
\\n - Own Email and SMS performance reporting and provide recommendations based on campaign, flow, customer, and engagement data.
\\n - Identify opportunities to improve lifecycle marketing performance, customer engagement, and retention through ongoing testing and optimization.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Photography & Digital Asset Management**

\\n

\\n - Manage ecommerce photography requirements and digital asset workflows to ensure product and campaign imagery needs are identified and completed on schedule.
\\n - Maintain and prioritize photography shot lists based on ecommerce and marketing needs.
\\n - Coordinate product availability and organization for scheduled photography.
\\n - Partner with internal creative resources to ensure completed imagery is web-ready, appropriately organized, and implemented across PDPs and marketing channels.
\\n - Ensure product imagery and alternate views are properly ordered and optimized across the website.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Agency, Developer & Digital Project Management**

\\n

\\n - Serve as a senior day-to-day point of contact for external developers and digital agency partners, independently driving ecommerce projects, establishing priorities, and ensuring accountability against timelines and business objectives.
\\n - Create, prioritize, assign, and follow up on developer tickets covering feature requests, visual issues, promotions, site updates, new themes, and ongoing enhancements.
\\n - Attend digital agency meetings alongside the Ecommerce & Marketing Director and take ownership of follow-up, execution, and project coordination.
\\n - Manage digital project timelines and proactively identify risks, dependencies, or delays.
\\n - Critically evaluate agency and developer recommendations, provide informed input, and partner with the Ecommerce & Marketing Director on prioritization and implementation.
\\n - Own site updates supporting SEO and Paid Media initiatives, including collection creation, merchandising, landing destinations, and linking strategy.
\\n - Coordinate cross-agency initiatives to maintain alignment, accountability, and timely execution.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Analytics & Optimization**

\\n

\\n - Monitor ecommerce, Email, and SMS performance using Shopify Analytics, Klaviyo Analytics, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, and other available reporting tools.
\\n - Independently translate ecommerce and marketing performance data into clear insights, strategic recommendations, and prioritized opportunities for optimization.
\\n - Identify trends in site behavior, merchandising performance, campaign engagement, and conversion.
\\n - Establish and manage ongoing testing initiatives to improve customer experience and digital performance.
\\n - Proactively communicate key findings, opportunities, and recommendations to the Ecommerce & Marketing Director and relevant cross-functional partners.
\\n - Act as a senior ecommerce resource across the organization, partnering cross-functionally with Marketing, Creative, Sales, Inventory, and external partners to drive alignment and execution of digital initiatives.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Qualifications & Skill Summary**

\\n

\\n - 6+ years of professional ecommerce and/or digital marketing experience, preferably within luxury retail, fashion, fine jewelry, beauty, or another high-touch consumer brand.
\\n - Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor, independently identifying opportunities, making recommendations, and leading complex ecommerce initiatives with limited day-to-day direction.
\\n - Advanced hands-on Shopify Plus experience, including products, variants, collections, merchandising, navigation, PDP optimization, and site content management.
\\n - Advanced Klaviyo experience across campaigns, flows, segmentation, scheduling, testing, and reporting.
\\n - Strong understanding of ecommerce merchandising, conversion optimization, customer journey, and UX best practices.
\\n - Demonstrated experience managing Email and SMS campaigns and lifecycle marketing initiatives.
\\n - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret ecommerce and marketing performance data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
\\n - Working knowledge of SEO best practices for ecommerce content, merchandising, linking, and site structure.
\\n - Experience managing relationships and projects with developers, agencies, creative partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
\\n - Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple initiatives, priorities, and deadlines.
\\n - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
\\n - Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
\\n - Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and take ownership without requiring significant day-to-day direction.
\\n - Comfortable operating in a hands-on individual contributor capacity within a lean, collaborative team environment.
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Programs, Platforms & Technical Proficiency**

\\n

**Required**

\\n

\\n - Advanced Shopify Plus experience
\\n - Advanced Klaviyo experience
\\n

\\n

\\n

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

\\n

\\n - Strong proficiency with ecommerce and digital performance analytics, including Shopify Analytics and Google Analytics
\\n - Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
\\n - Experience with Microsoft Clarity or similar user behavior and website optimization tools
\\n - Experience with project management platforms such as Asana, Basecamp, or comparable tools
\\n - Experience with Adobe Photoshop or similar image-editing software
\\n - Familiarity with additional ecommerce, CRM, Email/SMS, SEO, or digital marketing platforms

# Senior Paid Media Strategist

Clarity LLC

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/123372097974995147?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3474255434804100709&crId=US_0US_0)

Clarity is for marketing and communications people at the top of their game , looking to grow in a global consultancy with deep experience helping B2B technology brands scale across markets.

We work with ambitious clients at the moments where reputation, visibility, policy, digital and commercial growth come together. That means the work is varied, often complex and shaped by more than one market, audience or channel.

Across London, Amsterdam, New York and Sydney, our teams work closely across disciplines and regions, giving our people the chance to build range, deepen their expertise and contribute to work with international reach.

Vice President, Communications (Integrated) — New York
We look for people who think clearly, care about the work and bring a point of view.

At Clarity, you will work alongside experienced specialists across communications, creative, digital marketing, digital experience, strategy, insights and policy. You will be trusted to contribute, encouraged to challenge well and supported by people who understand what great really looks like.

We also know Careers have to work around real life. Our benefits are designed with that in mind, supporting flexibility, family, wellbeing, development, financial planning and proper time away.

Our employee-led groups help drive progress across DEI, sustainability, wellbeing and CSR, giving people across the business a role in shaping how Clarity keeps improving.

We are proud of the external recognition, including Best Place to Work listings from PRWeek and Campaign, as well as a SABRE Award for PR Agency Citizenship. Day-to-day, though, it comes down to this: smart people, high standards, global opportunities, and enough personality to make the work truly enjoyable.

Connect with colleagues throughout EMEA, APAC and the US.

Company wide annual bonus program
Generous benefits as our company grows.

We're invested in you.

Generous paid family leave policies
Take time off to care for your loved ones.

Competitive salary and retirements plans
(Pension/401k) to set you up for the future.

An extended break after 5 years to travel the world, pursue a hobby, start your novel.

Employee led taskforces
Forums to shape our approach to the issues that matter most to our agency: DEI, Sustainability, Wellbeing and CSR.

Flexible working policies
Because we think work needs to work for you.

# Senior Manager, Digital Marketing (United States)

Location:USCompany:Head to Toe Brands

## Description:

The Digital Marketing Senior Manager will lead performance marketing efforts across the Head to Toe Brands portfolio, which currently includes four franchised beauty brands. This role will oversee digital advertising strategy and performance.

The ideal candidate enjoys leveraging emerging technologies, data, and consumer insights to drive measurable business results. They have significant experience managing digital advertising campaigns against cost-per-lead (CPL), cost-per-acquisition (CPA), and return-on-investment (ROI) goals. While the majority of day-to-day media placement and campaign management is executed by preferred agency partners, this person should have hands-on experience building, launching, and optimizing campaigns directly within major advertising platforms and be willing and able to execute campaigns internally when business needs or testing opportunities arise.

Success in this role also requires strong cross-functional collaboration. The Digital Marketing Senior Manager will work closely with internal marketing and operations teams, along with agency partners to develop digital strategies that improve conversion and maximize ROI.

This person must also be comfortable partnering directly with franchisees by helping them understand digital media performance, providing actionable recommendations, building confidence in our digital strategy, and driving buy-in and adoption of preferred agency partners.

This role goes beyond pulling reports and monitoring dashboards. The Digital Marketing Senior Manager must be highly comfortable interpreting complex performance data, identifying the story behind the numbers, and confidently presenting findings to audiences ranging from franchisees and cross-functional teams to senior leadership and executives. They should be able to distill detailed analysis into concise executive summaries that clearly communicate what happened, why it matters, and what actions should be taken next.

This position requires a multifaceted skill set: someone who can own digital initiatives from strategy and cross-functional alignment through project management, execution, optimization, reporting, and quality assurance. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, presentation skills, project management, communication, and relationship-building skills are essential.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Digital Advertising Strategy + Optimization**

- Develop, evaluate, and optimize digital advertising strategies, media mix, audience targeting, and campaign structures across all brands at both the national and local levels, with a heavy emphasis on paid search (PPC), display, and paid social platforms including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging channels.
- Lead and hold preferred agency partners accountable for campaign execution, optimization, testing, pacing, and performance against established KPIs and business goals.
- Maintain strong hands-on knowledge of major advertising platforms and, when needed, directly build, launch, manage, or optimize campaigns internally to support testing, special initiatives, or evolving business needs.
- Partner cross-functionally with internal marketing, creative, operations, and local marketing teams to develop culturally relevant, compelling advertising creative and landing page experiences informed by campaign performance and consumer behavior.
- Monitor and optimize media performance against established KPIs, historical performance, industry benchmarks, and business goals.
- Stay current on emerging technologies, platforms, advertising capabilities, AI applications, and evolving digital marketing best practices.
- Develop and manage A/B testing plans, document insights, and share relevant learnings across teams and brands to continuously improve performance.
- Evaluate franchisee digital advertising KPIs monthly in partnership with Operations, Local Marketing, and preferred agency partners to:
- Identify underperforming locations and provide strategic recommendations to improve campaign performance.
- Identify top-performing locations and document/share best practices across the system.
- Surface broader trends and opportunities that can improve digital media performance across brands.
- Meet regularly with franchisees to review media performance, present data in an approachable and actionable way, answer questions, and provide strategic guidance.
- Build franchisee confidence and buy-in around digital media strategy, clearly communicating the value and performance of recommended programs and working cross-functionally to drive systemwide adoption of preferred agency partners and digital marketing best practices.
- Serve as a collaborative digital media resource for franchisees and internal teams, helping connect national strategy with local market needs and opportunities.

**Performance Reporting + Data Storytelling**

- Own monthly digital performance reporting across brands, channels, campaigns, and local markets, ensuring reporting is accurate, consistent, and focused on the KPIs most relevant to business performance.
- Go beyond reporting the numbers to interpret performance, identify trends and opportunities, diagnose challenges, and translate data into clear recommendations and next steps.
- Develop concise executive summaries that distill complex performance data into the most important insights: what happened, why it happened, what it means for the business, and what we recommend doing next.
- Confidently present digital performance, insights, and recommendations to a variety of audiences, including franchisees, cross-functional partners, brand leadership, and executive stakeholders.
- Tailor the level of detail and communication style to the audience, with the ability to move comfortably between detailed campaign analysis and high-level executive storytelling.
- Partner with agency and internal teams to ensure reporting methodology, attrbution, and performance narratives are accurate and aligned.

**Social Media Data + Analytics**

- Partner with social/content team to create quarterly social media reports that provide both quantitative KPI analysis and qualitative evaluation of content performance.
- Translate social media insights into actionable recommendations that inform national paid social strategy, media spend, creative development, and organic content planning.

**Digital Team Support**

- Support email marketing initiatives, including the development and optimization of email templates and campaigns, audience segmentation, testing, deployment, and performance reporting to identify opportunities to improve engagement and conversion.
- Collaborate with Digital Marketing Senior Director to identify and prioritize opportunities to improve CRO and overall digital customer experience.
- Help manage SEO, AI, and digital discoverability initiatives designed to increase qualified website traffic, lead generation, and conversion across the portfolio.
- Support website enhancement and feature-release projects through testing, quality assurance, and launch.
- Use website, search, and campaign performance data to inform ongoing optimization opportunities.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

- Minimum of 8 years of digital performance marketing experience; franchise, multi-location, or agency experience strongly preferred.
- Bachelor’s degree required, ideally in marketing, business, information systems, data science, statistics, or related field.
- Demonstrated experience managing and optimizing paid digital media against CPL, CPA, conversion, and ROI goals.
- Hands-on experience building, launching, and optimizing campaigns directly within major paid media platforms, even when working in an agency-led media model.
- Ability and willingness to execute campaigns internally when needed while primarily serving as the strategic lead and internal owner of agency-managed media programs.
- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to move beyond data collection and translate complex performance data into meaningful insights, recommendations, and business decisions.
- Exceptional presentation and data storytelling skills, with confidence presenting digital performance to franchisees, cross-functional stakeholders, senior leadership, and executive audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to create clear, concise executive summaries that communicate key findings, business impact, and recommended next steps.
- Experience working cross-functionally across marketing, operations, creative, analytics, and/or technology teams.
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex digital performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for franchisees and internal stakeholders.
- Experience managing agency partners, setting performance expectations, and holding partners accountable for continuous optimization and results.

# Sr. Manager Paid Social (New York)

Location:Grand Central, NYCompany:phidel digital agency

## Description:

**Senior Manager, Paid Social**

**Location:** New York City (On-site/Hybrid)

**Department:** Paid Media

**Salary:** $100,000 – $125,000

We are seeking a Paid Social Lead who is a true Meta expert, someone who has spent their career living inside Ads Manager and knows how to turn a media budget into predictable, profitable growth. This person will own paid social buying and optimization across Meta and TikTok for a portfolio of DTC brands in the beauty, home decor, and lifestyle spaces, and will be the connective tissue between performance, creative, and AI driven efficiency.

This role is built for someone with an “art meets science” skillset, fluent in the mechanics of bidding, budgeting, and account structure, and equally sharp at briefing, testing, and optimizing creative, because on Meta, creative is the targeting. The ideal candidate has run paid social at an agency, has managed real budgets against real CAC and LTV targets, and has already started using AI tools to work faster and smarter, not just to buy media better.

**Job Description**

- Develop full-funnel paid social media plans across Meta and TikTok, including channel and budget allocation by funnel stage (awareness, consideration, conversion), flighting, and pacing, translating brand and business goals into an actionable media strategy before execution begins.
- Own day to day paid social buying, budget pacing, and optimization across Meta (primary) and TikTok for a portfolio of DTC accounts.
- Build and manage campaign structures, bidding strategy, audience segmentation, and budget allocation to hit CPA, CAC and ROAS targets across the funnel.
- Serve as the account's Meta subject matter expert, staying ahead of platform updates, algorithm shifts, and new ad formats, and translating them into action before competitors catch on.
- Partner with creative and content teams to develop ad briefs grounded in what's actually working in the account, closing the loop between performance data and creative production.
- Design and run a disciplined creative testing roadmap (concepts, hooks, formats, angles), setting up tests correctly, reading results rigorously, and turning findings into next round briefs.
- Diagnose account and creative fatigue early, and prescribe specific fixes (new creative, audience refresh, structural changes) rather than just flagging the problem.

# **COMPANY**

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

# **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

We’re hiring a Senior Media Buyer to lead Meta buying for RYZE. Meta is our largest acquisition channel and one of the larger DTC accounts on the platform — we are adding a dedicated testing budget on top of an account that is already scaling quickly. We need a senior operator who has run spend at this level before and can come in ready to own it.

This is a cross-functional role. The biggest levers in our account sit outside the ad manager: the creative we test and the landing pages we send traffic to. You’ll work every day with our in-house Performance Creative and CRO teams to decide what gets tested, read the results, and scale what works.

**Responsibilities will include:**

**Meta Account Strategy & Daily Management**

- Own campaign structure, budgets, bidding, and pacing across a high-spend account, including scaling structures and pre-launch ramp-up ahead of key moments.
- Grow spend on top of the existing baseline while holding first-time CAC and new-customer guardrails. Know when to push, when to hold, and how to tell the difference between noise and a real trend.

**Testing at Scale**

- Run a high-velocity testing program for creative and landing pages with a dedicated testing budget.
- Design clean tests, call them on clear rules, and move winners into scale.
- Partner with CRO on landing pages, listicles, advertorials, quiz funnels, and new page formats — including pages built for specific audiences, age groups, and stages of awareness.

**Creative Direction from the Buying Seat**

- Turn account data into clear briefs and feedback for the Performance Creative team: which angles, hooks, and formats to make more of, which to retire, and why.
- Own the feedback loop between buying performance and creative output — not just passing data, but driving decisions.

**Measurement & Attribution**

- Run the account on our attribution stack (Northbeam), reconcile it with platform reporting, and use incrementality testing to confirm that growth is real.
- Build repeatable buying processes and apply automation and the Meta API to reporting, rules, and launch workflows.

**Leadership & Team Development**

- Set the standard for the account — how it’s structured, how tests are run, and how decisions are made.
- Mentor and develop the buyers who work in the account.
- Help shape how RYZE staffs paid media as we expand to more channels.

**Professional Qualifications**

- 10+ years in paid social, with most of that time spent hands-on in Meta.
- Experience managing $100K+ per day (or $36.5M+ per year) in Meta spend for a DTC or subscription brand.
- Deep knowledge of Meta campaign structure, bidding, budget scaling, and creative testing at volume.
- Fluency with third-party attribution tools such as Northbeam, and experience designing and reading incrementality tests.
- A track record of working closely with creative and CRO teams, with a clear understanding of how landing pages and funnels drive account performance.
- Experience leading, mentoring, or setting direction for other media buyers.

- Create training documentation and internal playbooks to establish a library of best practices
- Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions
- Support onboarding of additional media buyers as the team grows

- Serve as senior strategist on key accounts
- Lead or support monthly and quarterly client calls
- Translate complex performance data into clear, executive-level insights
- Identify opportunities to expand scope and grow client investment
- Maintain strong, proactive communication to drive long-term retention

- Build scalable campaign launch frameworks
- Improve reporting workflows and dashboard standards
- Standardize naming conventions, tracking audits, and account hygiene processes
- Partner with creative and landing page teams to align paid media strategy with CRO efforts
- Work directly with department lead to refine internal systems as the agency scales
- Partner with creative team on ad testing roadmaps

- 5 or more years managing Google Ads accounts

- Agency experience managing multiple clients simultaneously
- Experience managing monthly budgets between $10,000 and $250,000+ plus per client
- Strong familiarity with ecommerce and lead generation models

- Experience with Google Ads, Microsoft Ads & other Paid Search Ad Channels

- Fluency in keyword research, match type strategy, search query mining and negative keyword management
- Fluency in Google Tag Manager, GA4 and the conversion tag installation process
- Experience with enhanced conversions, offline conversion tracking, and third party trigger based automation systems like Zapier
- Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets including forecasting and margin modeling

- Strong client communication and presentation skills
- Experience building trust with senior stakeholders
- Ability to mentor junior team members and elevate their technical ability
- Organized and process-oriented
- Comfortable building documentation and repeatable frameworks
- Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on technical review
- High level of accountability and follow-through
- Exhibit a passion for growth marketing by leveraging available resources to stay on the cutting edge of strategies and technology

EB5Visa.io is a digital-first company focused on helping investors, families, advisors, and partners better understand the EB-5 visa process and related investment opportunities in the United States.

We create clear, trustworthy, and accessible content for a global audience interested in U.S. immigration, investment, real estate development, job creation, and long-term planning. Our work sits at the intersection of immigration, finance, real estate, and technology.

**EB5Visa.io** is growing and looking for creative, detail-oriented people who can help build a strong digital brand, produce high-quality content, and communicate complex topics in a simple, polished, and engaging way.

We are looking for a qualified Digital Marketing Director to take the lead in developing successful, long-term digital marketing strategies for our company.

As a Digital marketing director, you should have in-depth marketing experience and a passion for digital technologies.

You will work closely with different teams to ensure consistency through all digital marketing channels. You should also provide forward-thinking ideas to build and maintain a strong company web presence.

You should be able to drive all digital marketing efforts to achieve our business objectives.

**Responsibilities**

- Build our digital marketing roadmap
- Manage all digital marketing channels (e.g. website, blogs, emails and social media) to ensure brand consistency
- Measure ROI and KPIs and prepare a budget
- Develop specific campaigns to create and maintain high levels of customer interaction
- Oversee our social media accounts
- Manage and improve online content, considering SEO and Google Analytics
- Forecast sales performance trends and act proactively to increase our market segment
- Liaise with Product, Design and Sales directors to increase client satisfaction through cohesive strategies
- Motivate digital marketing team to achieve goals
- Monitor competition and provide ideas to stand out
- Stay up-to-date with digital technology developments

**Requirements**

- Proven work experience as a Digital marketing director
- Demonstrable experience in designing and implementing successful digital marketing campaigns
- Strong understanding of how all current digital marketing channels function
- Solid knowledge of online marketing tools and best practices
- Hands on experience with SEO/SEM, Google Analytics and CRM software
- Familiarity with web design
- Excellent analytical and project management skills
- Strong team management and communication (written and verbal) skills
- BSc degree in Marketing, Digital technologies or relevant field
- Assess relevant skills and qualifications with our Marketing Director interview questions.

Description
Position Summary
The Digital Marketing Director will lead the execution of digital marketing campaigns across artist releases, bringing a structured, performance-driven approach to campaign planning and delivery. This role is both strategic and hands‑on. The ideal candidate comes from a digital or creative agency environment and has experience building and executing campaigns from concept through delivery. This person will work closely with the Senior Director of Marketing, artists, and internal teams to drive campaign performance across platforms. This role requires a high level of ownership and the ability to operate independently, bringing organization, clarity, and consistency to campaign execution in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
The Digital Marketing Director is responsible for developing and executing digital marketing campaigns across releases, including planning, timelines, asset coordination, and rollout.

This role translates marketing objectives into structured, executable campaign plans and manages campaigns from start to finish, ensuring timely delivery and alignment among stakeholders. The role leads execution across digital platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging channels. It requires developing strategies for content distribution, audience engagement, and growth, while monitoring campaign performance and optimizing in real time using data and platform insights.

This role works directly with artists, managers, and internal teams to align on campaign direction and execution. The role requires managing expectations, maintaining clear communication, and balancing creative input with structured execution. The position coordinates with external agencies, vendors, and creative partners, managing deliverables, timelines, and accountability, and ensuring a high standard of execution across all campaign components.

The Director develops and oversees creator strategies across platforms, identifies and activates opportunities across digital communities and networks, and ensures execution across multiple channels to maximize reach and engagement. This role contributes to establishing clear workflows, improving cross-team coordination, and bringing consistency and efficiency to digital marketing efforts.

Requirements
Qualifications

Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably within a digital, creative, or media agency.

Demonstrated experience in executing end-to-end campaigns across digital platforms and possess a strong understanding of social media, content distribution, and digital performance metrics.

Experience managing multiple campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment and is comfortable working directly with clients, talent, or high‑profile stakeholders.

Strong organizational, communication, and problem‑solving skills.

Preferred Qualities

The ideal candidate brings an agency mindset, with a structured, deadline‑driven, and execution‑focused approach to their work. They are comfortable operating both strategically and hands‑on, with a proactive and resourceful attitude and a strong sense of ownership. They are able to bring order and process to a fast‑moving environment and have a strong understanding of digital culture and content trends.

Full time

JR102775

Director of Digital Marketing to build a strategic, result driven, hands-on, and scale the overall digital marketing efforts across digital channels including web, mobile, SEO, SEM, paid media, social media, and email for Seneca Gaming Corporation and its subsidiary brands.

The role has the opportunity to help shape SGC’s overall digital strategy to help drive measurable growth. Success of this role will require strong collaboration and coordination with the broader marketing organization, internal stakeholders, senior leadership team, and external partners to ensure a cohesive brand presence and holistic success. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in creating and implementing consistent digital presence, driving web traffic and online revenue, establishing and improving customer engagement. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of various digital channels, strong analytical skills to measure campaign performance, manage departmental budgets, lead and motivate their team, and align digital strategy with company’s objective. All duties are to be performed within the guidelines of the Seneca Gaming Corporation’s policies and procedures, Internal Control Standards and objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:1. Develop and execute comprehensive digital marketing strategies for SGC and its brands that align with the overall business goals including driving online revenue, increase website traffic, enhance brand awareness, improve the usage of mobile app, generate leads, and build strong engagement with customers. 2. Help establish SGC’s digital marketing foundation including resources, tools, processes, workflows and playbooks. 3. Guide the execution across digital channels including website, mobile app, email, social media, SEO, SEM, paid media to ensure brand consistency and campaign effectiveness. 4. Implement and analyze data from digital marketing tools including but not limited to Google Analytics to measure campaign effectiveness and identify areas for improvement. Leverage findings to drive continuous improvement and ROI. 5. Oversee A/B testing and apply learnings to refine content and spend. 6. Work closely with the rest of the marketing team to ensure the digital strategies align with corporate and each brand’s unique goals and identity. 7. Manage budget effectively to allocate resources across various channels to maximize ROI. 8. Hire, train, and coach a digital marketing team to provide guidance and feedback9. Partner with external digital agencies to execute high-impact campaigns 10. Collaborate with internal stakeholders including hotels, IT, Operations ensuring seamless integration of digital marketing strategies with broader business initiatives11. Stay up to date with the evolving digital marketing landscape by monitoring market trends, competitors, and new developments in algorithms, platforms, and strategies to ensure relevance and effectiveness

STANDARD REQUIREMENTS:1. Develops, mentors and trains enrolled Seneca Nation members for future senior management positions within the company.2. Oversees departmental administrative matters and ensures HR is consulted as appropriate. Meets with staff on a regular basis and with entire department no less than three (3) times per year.3. Ensures effective recruitment, hiring, training, recognition, evaluation, coaching and discipline, terminations and other personnel related issues.4. Responsible for ensuring the department adheres to all company policies and internal controls, including but not limited to Compact, Human Resources, TERO compliance guidelines and purchasing.5. Prepares the annual budget and monitors to ensure attainment of goals. Manages labor and scheduling to ensure adequate coverage at all times while minimizing overtime.6. Liaise with other department/company management to ensure consistency and smooth flow of information, policies and procedures. 7. Maintains a strong network of contacts throughout the industry to facilitate both formal and informal gathering of information.8. Runs the department and design policies and training that result in exceptional customer service to all patrons. Maintains a professional work environment with supervisors, managers and staff.9. Keeps abreast of industry trends, new technology and practices as they relate to his/her area(s) of responsibility.10. Must complete all required SGC Training programs within nine (9) months from commencement of employment.11. Attends all necessary meetings to stay informed; including company and community meetings.12. Oversees an operation that is 24/7 and requires hours that can extend up to sixty (60) hours per week or more, and be inclusive of work weeks that consist of six (6) or seven (7) days. This individual is on-call and requires accessibility 24/7.13. Perform any other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:

Education/Experience:1. Must be 18 years of age or older upon employment.2. Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Advertising or relevant Marketing degree is required. 3. Minimum ten (10) years of progressive experience in digital marketing with a strong track record in SEO, SEM, Paid Media, Email marketing.4. Minimum five (5) years in a leadership role.5. Proven experience in leveraging digital marketing channels to promote brands, products, and services. 6. Deep understanding of web and mobile development and implementation.7. Experience in A/B testing.8. Experience in managing external digital agencies.9. Strong analytical skills and can analyze reports, find trends, and leverage findings to optimize strategies, revenue and grow brand presence.10. Demonstrated passion for digital marketing, social media, consumer trends, and online consumer behavior.11. Ability to thrive in fast-paced, constantly evolving work environments.12. Proficient in key digital platforms such as Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, and Salesforce.13. Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.14. Strong project management capabilities with attention to detail and deadlines.15. Prior experience in the hospitality industry strongly preferred.16. Experience in the gaming industry is highly desirable.17. Background in agency environments is strongly preferred.

Language Skills and Reasoning Ability:1. Ability to write routine correspondence and to speak effectively to the public, employees and customers.2. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.3. Must have the ability to deal effectively and interact well with the customers and employees.4. Must have the ability to resolve problems/conflicts in a diplomatic and tactful manner.

# VP of Marketing Communications

Vortex Companies

[Houston, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Houston%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3415916240153883530?p=1&pos=0&rgn=46481&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3672834737765691904&crId=US_0US_0)

Want to be part of one of the country's fastest growing infrastructure businesses? The Vortex Companies, LLC delivers cutting edge trenchless technologies and turnkey services to make the worlds water cleaner and we're growing every day!

We think BIG about solving the world's toughest challenges in failing water, sewer and industrial infrastructure.

At Vortex, you will be surrounded with a culture that puts your safety first in all we do. If you like a fast-paced environment, a team structure that provides support, training, and development, then apply today!

The VP, Marketing Communications is responsible for developing and executing corporate marketing initiatives, brand strategies, and go-to-market programs across Vortex. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this role partners across departments and divisions to strengthen the Vortex brand and support business growth.

The ideal candidate is a high-energy B2B marketing leader and self-starter who can quickly immerse themselves in the Vortex business. This individual brings broad marketing expertise, strong digital capabilities, and the ability to take initiatives from concept through completion.

### Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute corporate marketing initiatives and brand strategies.
- Build marketing plans aligned with company objectives and business priorities.
- Lead marketing and communications initiatives across Vortex departments and divisions.
- Develop go-to-market strategies for product and equipment launches
- Lead content, branding, and visual communications with creative teams.
- Write, present, and pitch marketing concepts to internal and external audiences.
- Lead digital marketing strategies across relevant channels and platforms.
- Leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve marketing effectiveness.
- Maintain consistent brand positioning, messaging, and visual identity.
- Partner with Sales to support lead generation and business development.
- Manage multiple marketing initiatives from concept through completion.

### Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
- 10-15 years of progressive marketing experience with a strong B2B background.
- Experience executing corporate marketing initiatives and brand strategies.
- Proven experience building and executing comprehensive marketing plans.
- Experience developing go-to-market strategies for product or equipment launches.
- Strong digital marketing experience, including exposure to AI applications.
- Experience developing content and visual communications with creative teams.
- Strong experience presenting and pitching concepts to executive and external audiences.
- Industrial, infrastructure, manufacturing, or related B2B experience preferred.
- Agency experience and trenchless or water/wastewater industry experience are a plus.
- Strong strategic marketing, branding, and communications expertise.
- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing, AI, and emerging technologies.
- Ability to translate business objectives into effective marketing strategies.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building skills.
- Excellent project management and organizational skills.
- Strategic thinker with a hands-on, self-starter mentality.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Vortex Companies, LLC and all of its subsidiaries, considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, age, national origin, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, or sexual orientation. All applicants will be considered solely on the basis of their qualifications.

MGA Entertainment, a consumer entertainment Products Company headquartered in Chatsworth, California, manufactures innovative lines of proprietary products for the toy and consumer electronics market. The MGA family includes award-winning brands such as LOL Surprise, Little Tikes®, Rainbow High and Zapf Creation®. For more information, please visit

LOL Surprise is the #1 toy in the world and our success is based on our commitment to innovation and creativity. We are looking for a VP of Franchise Development to help us extend our success by developing and executing a best-in-class, long term business strategy to ensure that the brand will remain timeless today, tomorrow and for generations to come.

We need a strong owner operator who understands our fans, can help deliver a strong and consistent story across every touchpoint and can highlight what sets our products apart for both buyers and consumers.

This role requires strategic, innovative, and creative thinking across product development, financial planning, and global marketing.

Work with Business Units and Territories to build long-term franchise value through consistent execution worldwide including adherence to brand guidelines and approvals.

Ensure that all franchise plans and marketing activations are designed and implemented to meet specific measurable goals (short-term and long-term)

Develop strategies to drive core brand and develop a franchised focus on manufactured and licensed goods

Create brand visual elements that translate to all franchise partners and are memorable and cohesive

Develop strategies that broaden the brand’s target audience

Communicate and interact regularly with constituents on the development of the
Franchise Strategy, Interactive Franchise Plans, Business Unit and Territory activation plans and general franchise updates

Share best practices with partners

BA/ BS required, MBA a plus

Minimum of 7-10 years’ experience with Brand and/or Franchise Development

Proven success in cross-divisional, synergistic roles with multiple stakeholders required

Experience with consumer research and financial analysis preferred

Experience with a movie studio and/or entertainment field highly preferred

Experience with consumer demand creation

Proven ability to lead and foster a highly collaborative team

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Proven track-record in communicating and building consensus with all levels of staff, internal divisions, and external stakeholders

Proven ability creating consumer & retailer demand

Experience with e-commerce and digital marketing as levers for growth

Experience driving marketing and advertising strategies

Strong interpersonal skills, maturity, and excellent judgment. Able to work effectively with senior level executives.

Must have the ability to exercise discretion and maintain strict confidentiality in handling sensitive information and materials.

Exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving skills

Excellent project management, prioritization, and planning skills

# Vice President Digital Marketing

Corporate J. Crew Group, LLC

[Liberty, OH](https://jooble.org/jobs/Liberty%2C-OH)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-148642382503697111?p=1&pos=0&rgn=36744&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8194530919559469729&crId=US_0US_0)

### Our Story

J.Crew gets you dressed every day, for every occasion. Since 1983, we’ve been creating classics that feel familiar and refreshingly new, crafted with unbeatable quality and distinctive point of view—it’s no wonder we’ve been in your closet for four decades and counting. Today, we continue to do the classics our way, inspiring not only how you shop but how you define your personal style. Our commitment runs deeper than just making great clothes—we’re proud of our role in getting you dressed with confidence, character, and celebrating a distinctly American sensibility that makes us who we are. Our dedication to Diversity, Equity, Belonging & Sustainability has been celebrated with industry recognition, reflecting our commitment to fostering an inclusive and sustainable workplace. J.Crew is seeking a visionary and results-oriented Vice President of Digital Marketing to lead our performance-driven marketing organization. This senior leadership role is responsible for developing and executing an integrated digital marketing strategy that accelerates customer acquisition, retention, and lifetime value across all owned and paid channels. Reporting directly to the Head of Ecommerce, the VP of Digital Marketing will own Performance Marketing (paid search, paid social, affiliate) alongside our owned channels including Email, SMS, and Push Notifications. This leader will bring creative ambition and analytical rigor in equal measure - championing innovation while building a high-performing team and agency ecosystem.

### Strategy & Vision

- Define and drive an integrated digital marketing vision that spans Performance, Email, SMS, and Push - aligned to J.Crew’s brand identity and ecommerce growth goals
- Develop channel roadmaps, investment frameworks, and testing strategies to maximize customer acquisition, retention, engagement, revenue, and margin generation
- Stay ahead of emerging trends in digital marketing, consumer behavior, and technology to bring bold, innovative ideas to the business
- Partner closely with the Head of Ecommerce and cross-functional leaders (Brand Marketing, Creative, Merchandising, Technology, Finance, Strategy, and Analytics) to ensure marketing is deeply integrated with the broader customer experience and Brand strategy

### Performance Marketing

- Oversee strategy and execution across Paid Search (SEM), Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, etc.), Programmatic Display, Affiliate
- Manage and optimize a significant media budget, ensuring strong ROAS, CAC efficiency, and measurable incrementality to Brand revenue and the bottom-line, alongside cross-functional partners
- Lead agency relationships, holding partners accountable to performance benchmarks, innovation targets, and brand standards
- Champion a rigorous A/B and multivariate testing culture to continuously improve campaign performance, alongside cross-functional partners

### Email, SMS & Push

- Own the strategy, calendar, segmentation, and performance of Email, SMS, and Push Notification programs across acquisition, retention, and lifecycle marketing
- Ensure channel health through disciplined list management, deliverability best practices
- Partner with creative and content teams to develop compelling, on‑brand messaging to drive engagement and conversion.

### Team & Agency Leadership

- Build, mentor, and inspire a high‑performing team of digital marketing professionals across digital marketing functions
- Foster a culture of curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
- Manage and evaluate external agencies and technology vendors; lead RFPs, onboarding, and ongoing performance reviews, supported by cross-functional partners
- Develop talent through coaching, feedback, and clear career development pathways

### Analytics & Reporting

- Align and own KPIs for all digital marketing channels; establish reporting cadences and executive dashboards
- Use data and insights to inform budget allocation, channel mix optimization, and strategic pivots
- Partner with Finance, Strategy and Analytics to develop robust attribution models and measure true marketing contribution to P&L

### Qualifications

- 10+ years of progressive digital marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role managing multi‑channel teams
- Proven track record of scaling performance marketing programs and owned channel strategies in a direct‑to‑consumer, retail, or ecommerce environment
- Deep expertise across Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, Affiliate, and SEO — combined with hands‑on knowledge of Email, SMS, and Push platforms (e.g. Klaviyo, Attentive, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud)
- Strong agency management experience; ability to hold partners to high standards while building collaborative, productive relationships
- Exceptional analytical skills with fluency in performance metrics, attribution modeling, and media mix optimization
- Experience managing substantial media budgets with demonstrated ability to drive efficiency and accretive growth simultaneously
- Track record of building and developing high‑performing teams in a fast‑paced, matrixed organization
- Strong executive presence with the ability to partner with and influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization
- Passion for fashion, brand, and culture — with an appreciation for J.Crew’s unique aesthetic and customer
- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree a plus

### Benefits + Perks

- Health & Well‑being – Eligible associates and family members receive medical, dental, prescription and vision insurance, family planning (fertility, adoption & surrogacy support), fitness discounts, medical travel and more.
- Associate Discount – We love our products just as much as you do! That’s why we offer a great associate discount across all of our brands (J.Crew, J.Crew Factory, and Madewell).
- Summer Fridays – In addition to our hybrid work model, we also close our office at 1:00 PM every Friday during the Summer months.
- Community Impact – We support the communities where we live and work through our philanthropic efforts and the J.Crew Cares Program.
- Winter Break – In addition to our PTO package, J.Crew Group offers a winter break at the end of December to eligible full‑time associates at the Home Office to provide time to refresh and recharge.
- Note: Availability of these benefits and perks may be subject to work location & employment type and may have certain eligibility requirements.

# Director of Growth Marketing - Performance

EARNEST

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/4593535980454689320?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2556857389231426569&crId=US_0US_0)

**Earnest empowers ambitious professionals to make confident financial decisions and build the life they envision.**

Earnies are committed to helping borrowers move forward with confidence by offering smarter borrowing options with a clearer path to taking control of their debt. If you’re as passionate as we are about our mission, read more below, and let’s build something great together.

**The Director of Growth Marketing - Performance will report to our VP of Performance Marketing.**

**As a Director of Growth Marketing - Performance, you will:**

- **Own Core Channel Performance:** Start by evaluating current strategy, execution, and performance then set the plan to accelerate results (SEM, Paid Social, SEO/AEO).
- **Aggressively Expand into New High-ROI Channels:** Own the channel expansion strategy–prioritization, testing, and the call to scale (Programmatic, OTT, OOH, Streaming Audio, etc.). Build the measurement frameworks with the analytics/attribution team so each scale decision is backed by data.
- **Build the paid channel strategy for Personal Loans:** As the company shifts from single-product to multi-product lending in 2027. Set how budget, channel mix, and testing priorities shift as PL scales alongside new products.
- **Transform how the team works into an AI-first marketing organization:** identify which workflows AI can take over or accelerate, and drive adoption within the first 90 days.
- **Develop Team Structure and Strategy:** define the ideal mix of FTE, contract, agency and AI capacity to drive the most impact.
- **Act as player-coach to a team of Growth Marketing Managers:** Setting strategy and staying hands-on with campaign builds, testing, and analysis.

**About You:**

- Energized by the pace of change in paid marketing–always looking for the next way to win.
- Data drives everything you do–but you're not afraid to trust your intuition or run an experiment when data is incomplete or slow to arrive.
- You want to have a massive impact within the company and are energized by ambiguity rather than needing a fully defined playbook.
- Cross-functional leadership: you can develop a vision, get buy-in from stakeholders who don't report to you (product, data science, compliance, advanced analytics), and see it through to completion.
- Comfortable operating at both altitudes–setting long term strategy in one meeting and analyzing SEM performance in the next.
- A builder's mindset: energized by creating something from scratch, not just optimizing an existing machine.

**Even Better:**

- Experience in fintech, lending, or another regulated B2C category.
- Experience at a high-growth startup or growth-stage company.
- Strong SQL–you don’t have to wait for an analyst, you get your own answers and can coach your team to do the same.
- Piloted and scaled advanced measurement approaches (incrementality testing, geo holdouts, MMM, MTA).

### **Heads Up:**

- You will be accountable for being on the cutting edge of new channels, and moving them into testing quickly.
- You will be building the data-driven machine–this is not a defined playbook or "operate an existing machine" type of role.
- This is a player/coach role with meaningful hands-on-keyboard time.
- The expectation is that AI will transform how the team operates and impact every critical workflow within the first 90 days.
- This role requires navigating a regulated environment–every new channel and personalization tactic needs to clear compliance before it ships, which will shape your pace and process.

**Where:**

- This role will be based in the US.

**Compensation:**

A little about our pay philosophy: We take pride in compensating our employees fairly and equitably. We are showcasing a range of your potential base salary based on the roles location. The successful candidate’s starting pay will also be determined based on job-related qualifications, internal compensation, candidate location and budget. This range may be modified in the future.

**Salary Range:** $186,000 - $232,000 USD.Employees are also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus and equity.

**Earnest believes in enabling our employees to live their best lives. We offer a variety of perks and competitive benefits, including:**

- **Health, Dental, & Vision benefits plus savings plans**
- **Mac computers + work-from-home stipend to set up your home office**
- **Monthly internet and phone reimbursement**
- **Employee Stock Purchase Plan**
- **Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)**
- **401(k) plan to help you save for retirement plus a company match**
- **Robust tuition reimbursement program**
- **$1,000 travel perk on each Earnie-versary to anywhere in the world**
- **Competitive days of annual PTO**
- **Competitive parental leave**

**What Makes an Earnie:**

At Earnest, our people bring our cultural principles to life. These principles define how we work, how we win, and what we expect of ourselves and each other:

- **Every Second Counts** : Speed is our competitive advantage. Our customers need better solutions, and the faster we execute, the greater our chance of success.
- **Choose To Do Hard Things** : We win by tackling the hard things that others avoid, fueled by grit and resilience.
- **Pursue Excellence** : Great companies, teams, and individuals never settle and are proud of the work that they do. What’s good enough today won’t be good enough tomorrow. Excellence isn’t a destination; it’s a mindset of continuous improvement.
- **Lead Together** : Our success comes from how we work together. Leadership is not about titles—it is about action. We take ownership, drive results, and move forward as a team.
- **Don’t Take Yourself Too Seriously** : We take our work seriously, not ourselves. The stakes are high, but a sense of humor keeps us grounded, creative, and resilient.

**At Earnest, we are committed to building an environment where our employees feel included, valued, and heard. Our belief is that a strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, equity, and belonging enables us to move forward with our mission. We are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encourage anyone to apply if your experience is close to what we are looking for.**

Earnest provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or genetics. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for the position in a manner consistent with the Fair Chance Ordinance.

You’ll own revenue growth on drinknello.com across all paid advertising mediums, with a primary focus on paid across Meta, TikTok Ads, TikTok Shop, and any other paid channels. This role will require extensive expertise in paid advertising, CRO, performance creative, affiliate & more.

You’ll work alongside media buyers, creative strategist(s), video editors, and work closely with our entire marketing team to achieve your vision and to drive results. You'll be reporting directly into our EVP of Marketing.

**What you'll own**• The growth of the Nello subscription business on drinknello.com

• Manage and scale paid media across Meta, Google, Tiktok, Youtube etc

• Drive CRO, landing page experiments, and website optimization

**About Nello**

• Nello is the fastest growing emotional wellness brand today that makes functional superpowders & beverages that help people feel like themselves, but better.

• We're focused on efficacious products that are also delicious, crave-able & flavor forward. We use transparent labels, no proprietary blends, & always opt for patented ingredients at the right dosages with clinical studies so we know you're getting something that works.

• We’re growing fast across TikTok Shop, Amazon, & currently nationwide in Target, Walmart, Costco, Kroger & many other retailers. **Requirements**

**Who we're looking for**

• 5+ years in performance marketing, with emphasis on paid media, CRO, landing pages, creative etc — with at least 2 years in DTC consumer products (food & beverage or wellness a plus).

• Fluent in the paid social metrics that matter — thumb stop, watch time, CTR, CPA/ROAS — and comfortable letting data overrule your taste.

• Experienced managing UGC creators, influencers, or affiliate content programs end to end.

• Scrappy and hands-on: comfortable making things yourself when speed matters, not just delegating.

• Familiarity with creative analytics platforms (e.g., Motion/Atria) and TikTok Shop’s affiliate ecosystem.

• Strong project management experience on platforms like ClickUp (ClickUp-specific preferred).

• Experience with AI creative tooling (image/video generation, AI voiceover, avatar video

**Benefits**

We aim to pay competitively for our size, stage, and market. For this role, in addition to base salary, there is bonus, equity, & a benefits package covering medical, dental, vision, & PTO available. Plus a lifetime supply of product!

Jump 450 is widely recognized as one of the most elite agencies in customer acquisition and performance media buying. We are seeking experienced Paid Social operators who can step into accounts immediately and drive measurable business impact.

As a Paid Social Associate, you bring strong hands‑on experience managing paid social campaigns focused on ecommerce and direct response performance. You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating directly in platform to identify optimization opportunities and improve performance. You take ownership of campaign results and thrive in fast‑paced environments where speed, experimentation, and data‑driven decision making are critical.

In this role, you will work directly with Jump clients and Acquisition Directors to develop and execute testing roadmaps designed to meet aggressive growth and efficiency targets. You will analyze historical performance data, identify trends and optimization opportunities, and proactively implement improvements to ensure campaigns consistently meet or exceed client KPIs.

This role requires someone who is comfortable operating independently within platforms such as Meta Ads Manager and other paid social channels while collaborating closely with internal teams and clients.

Core Responsibilities

Own day-to-day management and optimization of paid social campaigns across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Snapchat

Build and manage campaign structures across prospecting and retargeting audiences aligned with ecommerce and direct response goals

Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve ROAS, CPA, CVR, and revenue

Manage audience segmentation strategies including lookalikes, broad targeting, and first-party retargeting audiences

Monitor spend, pacing, and budget allocation across campaigns to ensure efficient growth

Identify creative fatigue and proactively launch new testing initiatives to maintain performance

Create performance reports and present insights and recommendations to internal teams and client stakeholders

2–4+ years of hands‑on paid social campaign management experience

Experience managing ecommerce or DTC campaigns with revenue and ROAS targets

Strong platform experience with Meta Ads Manager and familiarity with TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, or similar platforms

Experience managing prospecting and retargeting strategies across the marketing funnel

Strong analytical skills and comfort working with performance metrics and large datasets

About Zinda Operating Group Zinda Operating Group is building an AI-first marketing platform and managed-services operation for law firms. We combine performance marketing discipline with modern AI and automation to run acquisition at a level most legal marketing teams can't match.Zinda Law Group is our first major client, a real business with real marketing spend and real data. It's where we build and prove the model: better economics, faster iteration, and a system that actually works under live budget pressure.Once proven, this system expands, to other law firms, new practice areas, acquired companies, and partners. This is a foundational hire for that expansion, not a caretaker role for a single account.The RoleWe're hiring a Director of Performance Marketing & Growth to personally own paid acquisition performance for our flagship client, using AI and automation as the primary lever for scale, not headcount.This is a hands-on role. You will be in the accounts, in the data, and in the numbers — not just reviewing dashboards or managing an agency relationship. You'll be accountable for the results, and for building the playbook that lets this model expand beyond one client.What you'll doOwn paid digital performance end-to-end, with primary focus on Google Search/PPC, across a significant and growing budgetDrive core performance metrics: CPA, ROAS, acquisition cost, revenue, and own the outcomes, not just the reportingScale paid acquisition volume while holding or improving unit economics, growth without degrading efficiency is the mandateUse AI and automation as your first additional resource before requesting additional headcount, agencies, or contractorsTake accountability for SEO strategy and results in partnership with technical specialists, you don't need to be a technical SEO expert, but you own the outcomeBuild the operating model and playbook that lets this performance system extend to new practice areas, acquired companies, and partner firmsWork directly with leadership to translate one proven account into a repeatable, expandable platformWhat you bringRoughly 6–12 years of total experience, ideally at the Senior Manager or Director level, we're looking for someone still close to the work, not a career executive several steps removed from itA track record of personally managing $3M+ per year in paid digital spendHands-on ownership of Google Search/PPC, not just agency oversightDirect, personal accountability for CPA, ROAS, acquisition cost, revenue, or similar performance metrics in past rolesDemonstrated ability to scale paid acquisition while maintaining or improving economicsReal, applied experience using AI or automation to improve marketing performance, not just familiarity with the conceptActive, hands-on PPC work within the last 3 yearsA stable track record, we look closely at tenure patterns and want to understand the story behind any short stintsBackground in high-spend, direct-response environments is a strong plus: personal injury/legal marketing, home services, insurance, consumer finance, marketplaces, or performance agenciesWhat Success Looks LikeConnects advertising spend directly to qualified cases and business outcomes.Moves quickly, tests continuously, and makes decisions
