# Marketing Analytics Director \| United States \| Remote

$178.5k - $214.2k

Grafana

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5095624861386013995?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6036308395716392754&crId=US_0US_0)

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We're scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that's okay. If this role excites you, we'd love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a **Marketing Analytics Director** to lead the evolution of our marketing data stack and raise the analytical rigor of the entire marketing organization. This is a critical role for a builder-practitioner who works at the intersection of Data Science, Marketing Strategy, GTM, and AI Operations. You won't just report on the funnel. You will build the systems that make every analyst on this team sharper, including the AI agents themselves.

As the **Marketing Analytics Director** , you will be the lead architect of our data-driven growth engine, connecting high-level strategy with advanced technical execution. You will move beyond traditional reporting to build a self-sustaining marketing ecosystem, leveraging Google BigQuery, Grafana, and agentic AI to create a unified source of truth and a culture of analytical rigor. Your mandate is to move the needle on demand generation across the entire marketing funnel, while raising the standard for how analytical work gets produced, challenged, and shipped across the org.

You will architect a dual-track target-setting framework that balances high-velocity top-of-funnel growth with deep-funnel quality, ensuring GTM resources are directed toward high-converting user cohorts optimized for Grafana adoption and long-term retention.

You will be expected to engineer the underlying data schemas, design predictive models, and implement the BI frameworks that shape our global GTM strategy. We are looking for a technical expert who can translate complex data into clear executive-level direction and who proactively builds systems that prevent AI-generated noise from drowning out actual signals.

**What You'll Be Doing**

- Strategic GTM Partnership: Serve as the primary strategic partner to the GTM Leadership team (VP of Demand Gen, VP of Regional and Events, Head of Marketing Ops, CMO, Revenue Operations, Sales leadership and more), translating complex data into a clear roadmap for demand generation and revenue growth.
- Dual-Track Target Setting: Architect and own a sophisticated forecasting framework that balances top-of-funnel volume with high-intent lead quality, optimized for Grafana Cloud conversion and retention.
- Predictive Modeling and ROI: Develop and maintain machine learning models (Attribution, MMM, LTV) to predict campaign impact and steer budget allocation toward the highest-ROI channels.
- Data Warehouse Architecture: Oversee the structure of marketing data within Google BigQuery, ensuring a scalable single source of truth that connects product usage data with marketing touchpoints.
- Causal Inference and Inflection Hunting: Move beyond descriptive analytics to perform causal inference and predictive trend analysis. When the data shows an anomaly, whether a 3-month spike, a regional dip, or a campaign that overperformed, isolate the window and dig in.
- Executive Storytelling: Transform technical data outputs into clear, compelling narratives for the executive team and board. Deliver a succinct read and go deep where pushed.

**Utilizing AI and Automation**

- Agentic Insights: Deploy LLM-powered agents (Claude Code, MCP-based tooling, or comparable) to monitor BigQuery datasets and automatically flag quality shifts in the funnel before they impact revenue.
- Autonomous Workflows: Implement orchestration patterns (N8N, custom MCP servers, or equivalent) to build self-healing data pipelines and automated responses to market signals, such as automated spend shifts based on conversion anomalies.
- Predictive Quality Scoring: Build and deploy AI-driven scoring models that separate high-value potential users from low-signal volume, helping Sales and Marketing prioritize effectively.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

- 8+ years in Marketing Analytics, GTM Strategy, or Data Science, with at least 2 years in a lead architect capacity (IC track or player-coach; people management not required) within a high-growth SaaS or PLG environment.
- Demonstrated history as a force multiplier. You can point to specific tooling, rituals, evaluator systems, or frameworks you built that made other analysts or the broader org measurably better. A portfolio of dashboards you personally produced is not sufficient.
- Data Science and Engineering: Mastery of SQL and Python required. Deep experience architecting data environments in Google BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar warehouses.
- Hands-on AI fluency as a builder, not a user. You have built and shipped agentic systems with Claude Code, MCP, or comparable tools. You understand where LLMs fail and how to design around those limitations. You have built evaluator agents, prompt-grading systems, or analytical quality tooling in production.
- Automation Proficiency: Hands-on experience building complex logic and integrations using N8N, custom API orchestration, or MCP-based tooling.
- Visualization and BI: Advanced proficiency in modern data stack visualization tools (Grafana, Looker, Tableau) to build executive-grade dashboards.
- Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to create structure in highly ambiguous environments and build target-setting frameworks from scratch.
- MarTech Ecosystem: Deep familiarity with connectivity between Salesforce, marketing automation, and product-led data streams.
- Executive presence with experience presenting to executive and board audiences, including sound judgment about what data is and isn't ready to share up the chain.

**Bonus Points For**

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Data Science, CS, Statistics, Business Analytics). MBA or MS in Data Science is a significant plus.

In the US, the OTE compensation range for this role is $178,503 - $214,203. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes-RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

\*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market's defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

**Why You'll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**

- **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
- **Scaling Organization** \- Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
- **Transparent Communication** \- Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
- **Innovation-Driven** \- Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
- **Open Source Roots** \- Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
- **Empowered Teams** \- High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
- **Career Growth Pathways** \- Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
- **Approachable Leadership** \- Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
- **Passionate People** \- Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
- **In-Person onboarding**\- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new 'Grafanistas' to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
- **Balance is Key** \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

# Vice President, Global Partner Marketing, Mastercard Services Mastercard Job listing

Financial Narrative

[New York, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/New-York%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7380717800010407567?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33025&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7096279718271348524&crId=US_0US_0)

Vice President, Global Partner Marketing, Mastercard Services

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build asustainableeconomy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactionssecure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

### Title and Summary

Vice President, Global Partner Marketing, Mastercard ServicesOverview

Mastercard Services is seeking a strategic and commercially driven Vice President, Global Partner Marketing to lead the evolution of Partner Marketing into a scalable growth engine that accelerates partner revenue across our B2B portfolio.

The Vice President, Global Partner Marketing will own the global partner marketing strategy, inter-operability with the Global Services B2B integrated marketing team, partner lifecycle, and co-marketing investments with strategic partnerships, supporting regional activation, partner communications, and performance measurement for our newly launched Mastercard Partner Advantage Program. The role will partner closely with Channel Partnerships, Sales, Product, Enablement, Finance, and our broader MarCom leaders and teams across regions to drive partner recruitment, activation, pipeline generation, and revenue growth.

The ideal candidate has successfully not only helped build but as proven success scaling a world-class channel and partner marketing function in both high-growth technology businesses and large global enterprises, creating repeatable go-to-market motions that drive measurable commercial outcomes.

- Develop and lead the global partner marketing strategy aligned to Services growth objectives and channel revenue targets.
- Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through integrated partner marketing programs, co-marketing investments, enablement initiatives, and demand generation activities.
- Build scalable partner growth frameworks across recruitment, onboarding, activation, retention, and expansion.
- Partner with teammates on the Integrated B2B Global Services Marketing team, Channel Partnerships and Sales leadership to accelerate partner productivity, co-sell effectiveness, and revenue contribution.
- Establish investment strategies that balance growth, scale, partner experience, and commercial return.

### Partner Program & Lifecycle Leadership

- Lead the marketing strategy and execution for the Mastercard Partner Advantage Program across partner types, tiers, and specializations.
- Create best-in-class onboarding, engagement, certification, enablement, and partner communications programs that improve activation and long-term partner success.
- Own partner-facing marketing experiences including communications, campaigns, webinars, summits, awards, advisory councils, and community engagement programs.
- Build repeatable campaigns-in-a-box, toolkits, playbooks, and lifecycle programs that can scale globally while supporting regional market needs.

### Global & Regional Marketing Execution

- Lead a global partner marketing organization operating through a with strong alignment between global strategy and regional activation.
- Establish consistent planning, prioritization, governance, and execution processes across regions.
- Develop scalable approaches to partner recruitment, onboarding, co-marketing, account-based marketing, events, digital campaigns, and demand generation.
- Ensure global consistency while enabling regional flexibility and market-specific execution.

### Partner Investment & Program Governance

- Oversee partner marketing investments including co-marketing funds, demand generation programs, and partner activation initiatives.
- Establish governance, measurement, and ROI frameworks for marketing investments and partner growth programs.
- Partner with Finance, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Systems teams to simplify program execution and improve scalability.
- Drive continuous improvement of partner-facing systems, tools, workflows, and digital experiences.

### Measurement, Analytics & Optimization

- Establish a comprehensive partner marketing measurement framework linking investments to pipeline, revenue, engagement, activation, adoption, and retention outcomes.
- Define and monitor partner marketing KPIs, dashboards, and executive reporting.
- Leverage insights and analytics to improve partner segmentation, resource allocation, investment decisions, and program performance.
- Create a culture of accountability rooted in business impact and measurable outcomes.

### The Vice President will be expected to:

- Serve as a leader and primary advocate for Partner Marketing across Mastercard Services.
- Build and lead a high-performing global team focused on growth, operational excellence, partner experience and commercial impact.
- Navigate complex matrixed organizations and align stakeholders across Sales, Partnerships, Product, Finance, Enablement, Operations, and Marketing.
- Transform fragmented programs into scalable, repeatable growth engines.
- Drive organizational clarity through well-defined ownership, decision rights, operating rhythms, and accountability frameworks.
- Balance strategic vision with operational discipline and execution excellence.
- Foster a culture of innovation, customer-centricity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
- Develop future leaders and build organizational capability to support long-term ecosystem growth.

### All About You

- 15+ years of B2B marketing, channel marketing, partner marketing, alliance marketing, or ecosystem marketing experience.
- Proven experience building and scaling partner or channel marketing organizations that drive measurable revenue growth.
- Demonstrated success developing partner programs, partner lifecycle strategies, co-marketing motions, demand generation programs, and partner enablement initiatives.
- Experience managing global teams and leading through highly matrixed organizations.
- Strong understanding of channel, reseller, referral, technology partner, alliance, ecosystem, and co-sell business models.
- Deep expertise in pipeline generation, revenue attribution, investment management, performance measurement, and ROI analysis.
- Strong executive presence, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

### Preferred

- Experience leading channel or partner marketing in both:
- o High-growth startup or scale-up environments where programs, processes, and capabilities were built from the ground up.
- o Large global enterprises where programs were scaled across multiple geographies, business units, and partner ecosystems.
- Experience supporting SaaS, cybersecurity, fintech, payments, data, analytics, AI, cloud, consulting, or enterprise technology businesses.
- Experience with partner ecosystem platforms, PRM systems, Salesforce, account mapping solutions, partner portals, MDF/CMF programs, and digital partner engagement models.

# Senior Director of Paid Media

$269k - $369k

Okta

[Ontario, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Ontario%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1818572809528551533?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7327&pageType=7&jobAge=22&jdpSource=101&jdpid=888343200227263173&crId=US_0US_0)

**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. Senior Director of Paid Media

### About the Role

We are looking for a visionary, results-driven Senior Director of Paid Media to lead our Global Paid Media and Performance Marketing organization within Okta’s fast-paced marketing ecosystem. This leader will define how we use paid investment across the full buyer journey—from audience development and demand capture through pipeline creation and progression—while building the operating model, measurement capabilities, and team required to scale globally.

The ideal leader operates at the intersection of technology, data science, and creative storytelling. You are AI-first, commercially minded, and possess the technical depth to navigate dual go-to-market motions (high-touch enterprise ABM and high-velocity developer/product-led growth). As a trusted cross-functional partner, you possess the executive gravitas to align digital investments with corporate financial targets while maintaining the analytical rigor to interrogate unit economics alongside data science teams.

### What You Will Do:

- Global Vision & Growth Strategy: Define and execute the multi-year global paid media strategy across Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, ABM, and emerging channels to accelerate enterprise pipeline for the Okta and Auth0 product portfolios.
- Executive Leadership & Org Building: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing, multi-tiered global organization of media leaders, functional specialists, and regional teams (AMER, EMEA, APJ), cultivating a culture of operational excellence and continuous innovation.
- Performance Strategy & Decision-Making: Establish a disciplined operating model for evaluating channel performance, translating complex media and funnel signals into clear investment recommendations, optimization priorities, and executive-level decisions.
- Executive & GTM Alignment: Act as an essential strategic partner to the CMO, CRO, Finance, Product Marketing, and Sales leadership, translating paid media outcomes into commercial business impact, revenue predictability, and CAC/LTV efficiency.
- AI-First Transformation: Champion the adoption of cutting-edge AI methodologies—from predictive audience modeling and autonomous bid management to generative creative workflows—to establish Okta as an industry benchmark in modern B2B demand generation.
- Global Capital Allocation & Agency Governance: Direct a multi-million-dollar global media investment portfolio, optimizing ROI through rigorous governance, scenario modeling, and managing tier-one global agency and platform partnerships.
- Next-Gen Measurement & Attribution: Partner with Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Data Engineering to advance MMM, MTA, incrementality testing, and closed-loop conversion signals that connect media investment to qualified demand, pipeline, and revenue.
- Integrated Buyer Journey: Partner across Campaigns, Product Marketing, Web, Lifecycle, ABX, and Sales to ensure paid media is connected to the broader buyer journey — from audience creation and demand capture through retargeting, conversion, and pipeline progression.
- Dual-Motion ABM & Developer Acquisition: Scale bespoke Account-Based Marketing (ABM) media programs targeting Global 2000 enterprise accounts while optimizing high-volume self-serve developer acquisition funnels.

### What You Will Bring:

- Experience: 12–15+ years of progressive experience in Paid Media and Digital Growth Marketing, with 8+ years of people management including a proven track record of managing managers and leading distributed global teams.
- B2B SaaS Mastery: Deep expertise in enterprise B2B SaaS with a clear understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder buyer journeys, long sales cycles, and multi-product portfolio positioning.
- Strategic Judgment & Executive Communication: Proven ability to move from data and platform complexity to a clear point of view — identifying what matters, what action should be taken, and communicating recommendations simply to senior leaders.
- Commercial & Portfolio Stewardship: Demonstrated success owning and scaling tens of millions in annual media budgets with full accountability for pipeline contribution, revenue attainment, and unit economics.
- Executive Presence & Influence: Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to distill complex digital mechanics into compelling strategic narratives for C-level stakeholders and board-level presentations.
- Architectural & Technical Depth: Deep understanding of modern ad tech/martech architectures, audience graphs, CRM integrations (Salesforce), BI tools (Looker, Tableau), and conversion rate optimization (CRO) engines.
- Builder Mindset & Resilience: High degree of comfort operating in high-growth, ambiguous environments, with a track record of independently driving ambiguous, cross-functional work to closure.
- Innovation & Continuous Learning: Passion for staying ahead of macroeconomic shifts, digital privacy regulations, and emerging AI technologies, with the agility to pivot strategies proactively.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Director, Paid Social to lead full-funnel paid social strategy, execution, optimization, and measurement for a portfolio of high-growth clients. As a senior leader on the team, you’ll drive strategic client partnerships, solve complex performance challenges, and collaborate closely with experts across paid search, client strategy, creative, analytics, and programmatic to deliver integrated marketing solutions that drive measurable business results.

This role is ideal for an experienced paid social leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can confidently balance strategic leadership with hands-on expertise. You’ll identify growth opportunities, connect paid social initiatives to broader business outcomes, mentor and develop team members, and help shape the future of the discipline by leveraging AI, automation, and scalable workflows to elevate performance and efficiency.

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options\*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $120,000 – $135,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above) and an annual performance bonus.

This role has an associated annual target bonus component which is paid out based on a number of factors which include Company performance, department performance, and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed and you must be an active employee in good standing and not on a Performance Improvement Plan to be eligible for the annual bonus.

\*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

\*\*While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles, Chicago, and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

\*\*\*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

### You Will Be

- Leading paid social strategy across a portfolio of client accounts, with responsibility for planning, execution, optimization, testing, measurement, and performance storytelling
- Serving as a senior paid social partner to clients, including leading strategic conversations, performance readouts, growth planning discussions, and escalation recommendations
- Developing full-funnel paid social strategies across brand awareness, consideration, ecommerce conversion, retention, creative testing, incrementality, lift studies, MMM inputs, and MER/CAC/LTV analysis
- Managing six- to seven-figure monthly media budgets across fast-moving ecommerce, CPG, retail, lead generation, and/or consumer brand accounts with aggressive performance targets
- Overseeing paid social execution across platforms including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Reddit, and X
- Staying hands-on in advertising platforms and stepping in “on the keys” when needed to audit, troubleshoot, launch, optimize, or stabilize campaigns
- Partnering with paid search, client strategy, creative, analytics, and programmatic teams to identify cross-platform growth opportunities and ensure paid social strategy is integrated into broader media planning
- Translating client business goals into paid social recommendations that connect channel performance to revenue, acquisition, efficiency, retention, and long-term growth
- Managing, coaching, and developing 4–6 direct reports who are individual contributors, including regular 1:1s, performance management, career development, hiring support, and client-work coaching
- Providing account-specific guidance to junior team members on strategy, platform execution, analysis, communication, prioritization, and executive-ready storytelling
- Helping evolve paid social best practices, QA processes, campaign workflows, reporting automation, creative testing frameworks, and AI-enabled operating models
- Driving adoption of AI-enabled workflows and ad operations improvements that improve quality, consistency, speed, and scalability
- Supporting new business pitches, audits, and account growth opportunities when aligned to business needs

### You Must Have

- 7+ years of experience in paid media, with deep expertise in paid social strategy, buying, optimization, measurement, and client leadership
- Strong hands-on experience across Meta and TikTok, with additional experience across platforms such as
- Pinterest, Snapchat, LinkedIn, Reddit, and/or X

Experience managing six- to seven-figure monthly paid media budgets
- A background in supporting ecommerce and/or CPG brands, ideally in fast-moving environments with aggressive acquisition, revenue, efficiency, or growth goals
- Full-funnel paid social experience across awareness, consideration, conversion, retention, creative testing, and measurement
- Working knowledge with advanced measurement approaches such as incrementality testing, geo testing, brand lift, conversion lift, media mix modeling, and creative experimentation frameworks
- Ability to lead strategic client conversations, build trusted relationships, navigate ambiguity, and make clear recommendations under pressure
- History of managing and developing direct reports, including coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to partner effectively with paid search, client strategy, creative, analytics, programmatic, and other media teams
- Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution, including stepping into platform work when the account or team needs it
- Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and storytelling skills
- Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to turn data into actionable strategy

### Nice to Have

- Experience with Smartly, Sprinklr, or other AI-enabled advertising, automation, reporting, QA, or ad operations tools
- Working knowledge of paid search and how paid social fits within broader cross-channel media planning
- Proficiency in helping teams adopt AI-enabled workflows, automation, or process improvements
- Familiarity across additional media channels such as programmatic, retail media, influencer, lifecycle/email, SEO, or broader media strategy
- Experience contributing to new business pitches, strategic audits, or account growth planning

Prior agency experience in an AOR-style model or with integrated, cross-functional client teams

# Marketing Director IN PERSON

Location:Dimondale, MICompany:Mitten Extracts

## Description:

**Marketing Director – Brand Growth & Market Leadership**

_Are you a marketing leader who thrives on building brands, driving customer engagement, and creating campaigns that deliver measurable results? Do you have the ability to develop innovative marketing strategies while navigating the complexities of a highly regulated cannabis market? If you're driven by creativity, accountability, and growth, this role is for you._

Mitten Extracts is seeking a strategic and results-driven Marketing Director to lead the company's marketing, brand development, product marketing, and digital marketing initiatives across the organization, including wholesale brands, retail dispensaries, product launches, and consumer-facing campaigns.

This role is responsible for driving brand awareness, customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth while ensuring all marketing activities align with business objectives, compliance requirements, and evolving consumer trends. The Marketing Director will work closely with the Community Director to ensure alignment between marketing strategies, community engagement efforts, partnerships, and brand messaging. This position will play a critical role in strengthening Mitten Extracts' market position and building scalable marketing strategies to support continued growth throughout Michigan and future markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Marketing Strategy & Brand Leadership**

• Develop and execute the company's overall marketing strategy across retail, wholesale, and product categories

• Establish annual marketing plans, budgets, KPIs, and growth initiatives

• Identify opportunities to increase market share, brand awareness, and customer loyalty

• Lead long-term brand strategy while maintaining consistency across all channels

**2\. Brand Management & Consumer Engagement**

• Oversee all brand positioning, messaging, and visual identity initiatives across the organization.

• Develop and manage the annual marketing budget, ensuring alignment with company growth objectives and approved spending parameters.

• Monitor budget utilization monthly and reallocate resources as needed to maximize marketing effectiveness and ROI.

• Ensure marketing investments deliver measurable business outcomes and remain within approved budget thresholds.

• Ensure consistency across packaging, retail environments, digital channels, social media, and promotional materials.

• Develop consumer engagement programs and loyalty initiatives that strengthen brand awarenes, customer retention, and long-term loyalty.

• Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and consumer insights evaluations to inform brand strategy and business decisions.

• Collaborate closely with the Community Director to align marketing campaigns, community engagement efforts, events, partnerships, and outreach initiatives with the company's vision, values, and strategic objectives.

**3\. Product Marketing & Launch Execution**

• Partner with Sales, Production, Compliance, and Product Development teams to execute successful product launches

• Develop go-to-market strategies for new products and categories

• Lead product positioning, messaging, pricing support, and promotional planning

• Analyze product performance and recommend portfolio optimization opportunities

**4\. Digital Marketing & Customer Acquisition**

• Oversee digital marketing strategy, including website, SEO, email, SMS, social media, and paid advertising

• Ensure compliance with all cannabis advertising regulations and platform requirements

• Optimize customer acquisition costs and return on marketing investment

• Leverage analytics and performance data to continuously improve campaign effectiveness

**5\. Data, Analytics & Performance Measurement**

• Implement data-driven decision-making across all marketing functions

• Build dashboards and reporting tools to track marketing performance

• Monitor KPIs including:

- Brand awareness
- Customer acquisition
- Customer retention
- Retail traffic
- Campaign ROI
- Revenue contribution
- Market share growth
- Marketing spend versus budget
- Customer acquisition cost (CAC)
- Return on advertising spend (ROAS)
- Cost per lead and cost per conversion
- Budget efficiency and campaign profitability

• Present performance results and recommendations to executive leadership

**6\. Cross-Functional Leadership**

• Partner with:

- Sales (trade marketing, wholesale growth, customer engagement)
- Operations & Production (product launches, inventory planning)
- Finance (budget management, ROI analysis)
- HR (employer branding and recruiting support)

• Ensure alignment between marketing strategy and business objectives

**7\. Team Leadership & Culture**

• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing marketing organization

• Manage internal marketing personnel, agencies, designers, and external partners

• Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, innovation, and continuous improvement

• Promote company values: #Vision #Iron #Build

**Qualifications**

**Required**

• 7+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience

• 3+ years of marketing leadership experience within the cannabis industry

• Proven success building and growing consumer brands

• Experience managing multi-channel marketing campaigns and budgets

• Strong understanding of retail marketing, product launches, customer acquisition, and brand strategy

• Experience analyzing marketing performance and translating data into actionable business decisions

• Executive presence with the ability to influence leadership and cross-functional teams

**Preferred (Highly Desired)**

• Experience in cannabis, CPG, beverage, alcohol, or other highly regulated industries

• Deep understanding of:

- Cannabis compliance and advertising restrictions
- Retail dispensary operations
- Wholesale cannabis sales channels
- Consumer packaged goods (CPG) marketing

• Experience with loyalty platforms, CRM systems, digital advertising, SEO, and marketing automation tools

• Experience launching and scaling multiple cannabis brands

**Key Competencies**

• Strategic Thinking & Execution

• Brand Building & Consumer Engagement

• Marketing Analytics & ROI Management

• Digital Marketing Expertise

• Product & Market Insight

• Leadership & Team Development

• Cross-Functional Influence

• Adaptability in a Regulated Environment

**Success Metrics (First 12 Months)**

• Increase brand awareness and customer engagement across all channels.

• Improve customer acquisition and retention metrics.

• Successfully launch and scale new product initiatives.

• Increase retail traffic and loyalty program participation.

• Improve marketing ROI and campaign effectiveness.

• Strengthen wholesale and retail brand presence throughout Michigan.

• Build a scalable and accountable marketing organization.

• Maintain annual marketing spend within ±5% of approved budget.

• Achieve target ROAS and customer acquisition cost goals established by executive leadership.

• Deliver quarterly marketing ROI and budget performance reviews to executive leadership.

• Demonstrate measurable revenue impact from major marketing campaigns and product launches.

**Reports to: CRO**

**Location: In Person – Dimondale, MI (Greater Lansing Area)**

**Compensation: Salary/Exempt: $145k - $160k**

**Note: Upper end of the salary range reserved for candidates with national or large-scale single-state experience in cannabis industry.**

**\*\*\*Willing to pay for relocation**

**About Us:**

Piermont Bank is a boutique specialty commercial bank focused on serving modern businesses with a digital first approach. As the first cloud native bank launched in the United States, Piermont was built on modern infrastructure that allows us to operate with greater flexibility, efficiency, and scalability than traditional banks.

We combine disciplined commercial banking with innovative technology to deliver value added solutions for small and medium-sized businesses and our fintech partners. Our team is dedicated to thoughtful risk management, strong client relationships, and building a bank designed for the future of financial services.

**The Role:**

The Marketing Director will lead the development and execution of Piermont Bank's integrated marketing strategy across brand, demand generation, digital marketing, product marketing, content, partnerships, and events.

Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, this highly visible role will partner closely with executive leadership and business line leaders to drive awareness, client acquisition, and growth across Piermont's commercial banking, fintech, embedded banking, and treasury management businesses.

The ideal candidate is an experienced B2B marketing leader who can balance strategic thinking with strong execution. They will be responsible for enhancing an established marketing function, optimizing performance across channels, elevating the Piermont brand, and delivering measurable business results. This individual is equally comfortable developing strategy, collaborating across teams, and rolling up their sleeves to execute high-impact initiatives.

**Why This Opportunity?**

- Play a key role in the growth strategy of one of the nation's first cloud-native banks.
- Partner directly with the Chief Growth Officer and senior business leaders.
- Shape the market presence of a bank operating at the intersection of commercial banking, fintech, and embedded finance.
- Lead marketing initiatives that have a direct and measurable impact on business growth.
- Join a collaborative, entrepreneurial organization where ideas can quickly turn into action.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop and execute integrated marketing programs that drive brand awareness, lead generation, and client acquisition across Piermont's target markets.
- Partner with business leaders to support growth objectives across commercial banking, treasury management, lending, deposits, and embedded banking solutions.
- Strengthen and evolve Piermont's brand positioning as a leading technology-enabled commercial bank and trusted fintech partner.
- Lead digital marketing initiatives across email, social media, webinars, search, content marketing, and other growth channels.
- Develop compelling content, thought leadership, client success stories, and executive visibility programs that enhance Piermont's market presence.
- Measure campaign performance, marketing effectiveness, and ROI, using data and insights to continuously optimize results.
- Manage external agencies, vendors, and marketing budgets to maximize impact and efficiency.
- Collaborate with compliance, business units, and external partners to ensure effective and compliant marketing execution.
- Lead the strategy and execution for events, sponsorships, partnerships, conferences, and client engagement initiatives.
- Identify emerging market opportunities, industry trends, and innovative marketing approaches that support growth objectives.

**Qualifications**:

- 8-12+ years of marketing leadership experience in financial services, fintech, B2B SaaS, or commercial banking.
- Proven experience building integrated marketing programs that drive measurable revenue growth.
- Strong understanding of digital acquisition, CRM, content strategy, and performance marketing.
- Experience managing agencies, budgets, and cross-functional teams.
- Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive presentation skills.

**REPORT TO:** Chief Ecommerce Officer

**LOCATION:** New York, NY

**SCHEDULE:** 3 days/week on-site & 2 days/week remote

**Company Overview:**

Apparel that comes from the Japanese values of simplicity, quality and longevity. Designed to be of the time and for the time, LifeWear is made with such modern elegance that it becomes the building blocks of each individual’s style. **Position Overview:**

UNIQLO USA is looking for a leader to develop, execute and optimize full-funnel digital marketing strategies with the mission of driving brand awareness and revenue for Uniqlo E-Commerce and stores. As the head of the digital marketing team, the Director of Digital Marketing will need to develop a holistic digital marketing strategy to accomplish business objectives, optimize marketing mix for highest efficiency, and help integrate the latest marketing technology into the business. **Responsibilities are, but not limited to:**

- Oversee full-funnel marketing strategy to drive brand awareness and revenue growth through expansion into new marketing channels and improvement of existing marketing efforts.

- Lead and grow the digital marketing teams, and provide structure, process, and standards for these teams to ensure success.
- Own all agency and vendor relationships related to Digital Marketing.
- Partner cross-functionally with Site, Creative, Merchandising, Operations, and Finance to inform marketing strategy.
- Develop reporting and insights to be shared at the Board and Executive team level.
- Own headcount planning for the Digital Marketing team and identify any gaps and opportunities to fill them.
- Coordinate with key internal stakeholders including global headquarters and local brand/product/retail marketing teams, merchandising team, store operation teams to get program buy in and align on key acquisition & revenue goals.
- Other related duties to be assigned by direct supervisor
- Frequent in person collaboration

**Qualifications:**

- 8-12 years digital marketing experience in the retail industry, with demonstrated success delivering multi-channel campaigns. Expertise leading in-house performance marketing, with a focus on both profitability and growth.
- Proven track record of owning large marketing budgets with experience optimizing the marketing mix for efficiency.
- Deep understanding of the U.S. consumer’s media behavior, industry benchmarks and best practices.
- Experience building both scalable acquisition strategies and retention strategies.
- Proven ability to communicate and influence executive management and partners, inclusive of Google, Meta, Tiktok and agency partners.
- An effective communicator, collaborator, and problem solver.

**ABOUT SAVILLS**

Savills is an organization full of extraordinary individuals. Brilliant people who are driven to succeed, hungry to remain at the forefront of their specialties, and eager to propel themselves, our clients, and our business forward. We are one of the preeminent commercial real estate firms with services ranging from tenant representation and project management to workplace strategy and occupant experience - showcasing the breadth and depth of our expertise.

**3\. Marketing Programs, Budget & Vendor Management**

- Own the branded merchandise program and merchandise store, including vendor management, product and inventory strategy, pricing, approvals, service levels, store improvements, communications, and adoption.
- Own the corporate stationery and printing program, including vendor management, pricing, inventory strategy, ordering processes, service delivery, and program improvements.

- Develop and maintain FAQs, guides, training materials, templates, and self-service resources that increase adoption and reduce recurring support needs.
- Own governance and program management for North American brand and marketing-enablement tools, including Canva, Appspace/digital signage, survey platforms, GPTs, Claude-based brand resources, and other evolving self-service tools, directing routine administration and content maintenance through the Marketing Coordinator where appropriate.
- Lead identification, evaluation, and implementation of AI tools and workflow automations that improve marketing-team efficiency, expand broker and CSC self-service capabilities, and reduce manual work.
- Identify opportunities to automate recurring internal marketing processes such as invoice processing, project workflows, content updates, asset creation, reporting, and other administrative activities.
- Evaluate adoption and user feedback and continuously refine tools, training, and support models to increase business value.

**5\. Measurement, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

- Establish operational measures for major programs and strategic initiatives and provide reporting on budget, roadmap delivery, vendors, program adoption, workload, and execution health.
- Use operational data, stakeholder feedback, project outcomes, and post-project reviews to identify recurring issues and improve processes, programs, tools, and vendor performance.
- Partner with Digital Marketing on campaign and channel performance insights and ensure agreed optimization recommendations are translated into actionable workplans where appropriate.
- Support annual and ongoing planning with operational insights related to resources, capacity, budgets, vendors, tools, and organizational needs.

# Assistant Director, Paid Search (United States)

Location:USCompany:Carnegie

## Description:

**Carnegie \| A Career That Helps Higher Education Thrive**

We partner with colleges and universities to create lasting impact—for institutions, students, and the world they’ll shape. At Carnegie, your work contributes to something bigger: advancing opportunity through higher education. We invest in people, not just positions, and build careers that grow with you.

Carnegie Life \| Our People & Culture \| Benefits

**About the Role**

The Assistant Director, Paid Search leads paid search strategy and day-to-day work across Google Search, Performance Max, and ChatGPT Ads for a group of complex Carnegie clients. You’ll also manage and coach 1–3 paid search team members. You’ll work closely with the Directors and Senior Director of Paid Search to support high-stakes client work, grow the team, and shape how Carnegie approaches AI-driven search.

**What You’ll Own**

**Paid Search Strategy & Execution**

- Run paid search strategy and execution from start to finish for a portfolio of complex, high-spend clients.
- Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns, using paid search best practices to drive results. Troubleshoot complex PPC issues on your own before escalating.
- Track account performance using down-funnel goals and CRM data where available, and use what you find to shape recommendations. Use Google Analytics, Carnegie Clarity, Profound, and other reporting tools to spot opportunities.
- Build and review client-facing campaign build-outs, recommendations, and other materials that turn strategy into clear next steps. Partner with Digital Strategists and other teams on the paid search pieces of proposals, RFPs, and strategic initiatives.

**Client Leadership**

- Serve as the trusted paid search advisor and main point of contact for your clients. Lead client conversations with confidence and build strong relationships.
- Present strategy, performance insights, recommendations, and campaign changes to clients, including on larger and more complex accounts.
- Learn each client’s goals and turn them into paid search strategies that support their broader objectives.

**Team Leadership & Development**

- Manage and develop 1–3 paid search team members with ongoing coaching, feedback, and support.
- Lead training and onboarding, and help build team resources and best practices.
- Give regular performance feedback and contribute to formal performance reviews.
- Act as a senior resource for the team, helping others sharpen their technical PPC and client management skills.

**AI Search & Innovation**

- Guide campaign strategy through the shifting AI-driven search landscape, using automation and new capabilities to improve performance.
- Stay current on Google Ads and AI search developments, and find ways to put new capabilities to work for clients.
- Help shape Carnegie’s paid search approach to AI search by testing new ideas, sharing what you learn, and building best practices for the team.

**Team Knowledge & Thought Leadership**

- Share knowledge and best practices with teammates and cross-functional partners.
- Contribute to paid search training, process improvements, and team initiatives. Stay on top of industry trends and bring new ideas to the team.

**What You Bring**

- 3–6 years of hands-on paid search experience, with strong Google Ads expertise and experience managing complex, high-spend campaigns.
- Strong technical grasp of Google Ads strategy, optimization, and performance management.
- Experience directly managing at least one team member, including coaching, feedback, and day-to-day leadership.
- Strong client-facing communication skills, and the confidence to lead meetings, present recommendations, and build relationships.
- Experience creating detailed client-facing campaign build-outs, strategic recommendations, and presentations.
- Strong attention to detail, and the ability to turn strategy into clear, workable campaign execution.
- Experience analyzing digital campaign metrics to measure success.
- Strong problem-solving skills, plus the ability to troubleshoot issues and pick up new tools and technologies quickly.
- A forward-thinking approach to paid search, and openness to testing and adopting new Google Ads and AI search capabilities.
- Professional presence, and the ability to communicate well with clients, colleagues, and senior stakeholders.
- Strong team player with excellent time management, able to juggle multiple priorities in a remote environment.
- A plus: experience with Enhanced Conversions for Leads (ECL), Google Tag Gateway (GTG), AI Max, ChatGPT Ads, or other emerging ad capabilities.
- A plus: lead generation experience.
- A plus: experience with Asana or similar project management tools, and Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides.

**Why This Role**

Paid search is changing fast, and this role puts you at the center of it. You’ll run strategy for clients that matter, grow the people on your team, and help decide how Carnegie uses AI-driven search. You’ll see your impact in client results and in the skills of the people you coach.

**Compensation**

The salary range for this role is $85,000–$95,000. Your offer will reflect the experience, skills, and qualifications you bring.

# Associate Director of Performance Marketing (United States)

Location:USCompany:Brightside Marketing

## Description:

Associate Director of Performance Marketing

**Location:** Remote, U.S.-based only

**Type:** Full-time

**Starting Salary:** $100,000 per year

About Brightside

Brightside is a performance marketing agency specializing in fitness, wellness, franchise, lead generation, and e-commerce brands.

We build high-performing customer acquisition systems across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging digital channels, combining paid media with audience intelligence, creative strategy, conversion optimization, attribution, and analytics.

We're a collaborative, supportive team that cares deeply about excellent work and helping each other grow. We move quickly, communicate openly, and believe talented people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and empowered to contribute.

The Role

We're hiring an **Associate Director of Performance Marketing** to work closely with our Marketing Director and take significant ownership of paid media strategy, execution, and performance across a portfolio of client accounts.

This is a senior, hands-on position for someone who has spent years inside advertising platforms, understands what drives results, and has developed the judgment to know not just how to optimize campaigns, but where to focus, what to prioritize, and when a different strategy is needed.

**We're not looking for someone who has moved away from the platforms into a purely managerial role.**

We want someone who enjoys investigating performance, building campaigns, analyzing data, identifying opportunities, solving complicated problems, and helping others become better marketers.

You'll independently lead performance across assigned accounts, contribute to broader acquisition strategy, and serve as a trusted technical resource for the team.

We value initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to turn insights into action. If performance changes, you investigate. If something isn't working, you develop a plan. If you see an opportunity, you bring it forward. And when a decision is made, you're comfortable getting into the platforms and executing.

What You'll Own

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

- Lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid media campaigns across **Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads**, and other relevant platforms
- Remain deeply hands-on with campaign creation, management, testing, and optimization
- Build and optimize campaign structures across Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Meta, and other acquisition channels
- Develop full-funnel acquisition strategies aligned with client objectives, budgets, and conversion goals
- Independently manage multiple brands, markets, locations, and advertising budgets
- Make informed decisions around bidding, budget allocation, audience targeting, conversion objectives, and creative testing
- Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns while maintaining acquisition efficiency
- Collaborate with our Marketing Director on strategic planning and account performance

Performance Analysis & Optimization

We don't just need someone who can explain **what happened**. We need someone who understands **why it happened, what it means for the business, and what we should do next.**

- Take ownership of performance across assigned client accounts
- Analyze CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion quality, acquisition costs, and revenue outcomes
- Diagnose performance challenges across platforms, audiences, bidding strategies, creative, landing pages, and conversion funnels
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, increase conversion volume, and scale results
- Develop testing strategies with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and actionable conclusions
- Translate performance data into recommendations and execute approved optimizations
- Proactively identify risks and opportunities before they become urgent

**We want someone who takes responsibility for improving results, not simply reporting them.**

Tracking, Attribution & Measurement

Strong technical knowledge is essential.

- Demonstrate advanced working knowledge of **GA4, GTM, Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, UTMs, and attribution**
- Troubleshoot conversion discrepancies, tracking issues, and data-flow problems
- Evaluate conversion quality and downstream business outcomes rather than relying exclusively on platform-reported metrics
- Identify measurement gaps and recommend improvements
- Collaborate with technical resources when complex implementation support is needed

You don't need to be a developer, but you should be technically confident, resourceful, and capable of diagnosing problems before escalating them.

Creative Strategy & Conversion Optimization

Great performance marketing requires more than managing media.

- Analyze creative performance to identify winning concepts, messaging, offers, and audience responses
- Recognize creative fatigue, audience saturation, and testing opportunities
- Provide data-backed creative recommendations to our creative and account teams
- Identify friction within landing pages, lead forms, and conversion funnels
- Recommend improvements that increase lead quality, conversion rates, and acquisition efficiency

You won't be expected to design advertisements, but you should know what effective creative looks like and be able to explain why something is or isn't working.

Technical Leadership & Team Development

You'll serve as a senior technical resource and trusted partner to our Marketing Director, helping elevate the quality and consistency of work across the team.

- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to performance marketing specialists and managers
- Help troubleshoot challenging account and campaign issues
- Review campaign structures, optimization approaches, and tracking configurations when needed
- Share best practices, platform updates, and emerging opportunities
- Help strengthen internal processes, quality assurance, and campaign management standards
- Lead by example through expertise, accountability, curiosity, and collaboration

We believe leadership is demonstrated through actions, not titles. You don't need to have all the answers, but you should have the experience to ask the right questions, the confidence to make recommendations, and the humility to collaborate with others.

Client Strategy, Communication & Ownership

Agency life moves quickly. Successful leaders know how to balance competing priorities without sacrificing quality.

- Contribute to client strategy discussions, performance reviews, forecasting, and budget recommendations
- Explain complex advertising performance in clear, actionable terms
- Manage multiple client accounts, deadlines, budgets, and performance objectives simultaneously
- Prioritize work based on urgency, impact, and client needs
- Maintain excellent organizational and quality assurance practices
- Communicate proactively when results change, priorities shift, or additional resources are needed
- Identify opportunities to improve workflows and operational efficiency
- Take initiative without waiting to be told what needs attention

Sometimes a client request that arrives at 10:00 AM really does need to be executed that afternoon. We value people who can assess the situation, communicate clearly, make decisions, and move.

What You Bring

- **6+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience**, preferably in an agency or multi-brand environment
- Deep expertise in **both Google Ads and Meta Ads**, including campaign architecture, bidding, optimization, audience development, and troubleshooting
- Advanced Google Ads experience across Search and Performance Max; YouTube and/or Demand Gen experience preferred
- Proven experience developing and executing acquisition strategies across multiple accounts or brands
- Demonstrated success improving campaign performance, scaling acquisition, and managing meaningful advertising budgets
- Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to independently diagnose complicated performance challenges
- Advanced working knowledge of **GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, pixels, attribution, and CRM data integration**
- Experience building campaigns and account structures from scratch
- Ability to connect media performance with lead quality, customer acquisition costs, revenue, and business outcomes
- Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to other marketers
- Excellent communication, organization, prioritization, and QA habits
- A demonstrated track record of initiative, independent judgment, and accountability
- A genuine interest in remaining hands-on with campaign execution and optimization

Strongly Preferred

- Significant agency experience managing multiple client accounts
- Multi-location, franchise, or geographically targeted advertising experience
- Fitness, wellness, healthcare, or membership-based business experience
- TikTok Ads experience
- Looker Studio, dashboard development, or advanced reporting experience
- CRM integrations and offline conversion

Full-time

JAZZ HOUSE KiDS

**Details at a glance**

- On-site location, Montclair, NJ
- Full Time

**About JAZZ HOUSE KiDS**

Now celebrating its 25th anniversary, JAZZ HOUSE **KiDS** has built one of the country’s most influential ecosystems for jazz education, youth development, and community building. The organization stands at a pivotal moment of growth, expanding impact, and new opportunities.

From launching JAZZ HOUSE NYC in Lower Manhattan in partnership with Trinity Church NYC five years ago, to record-breaking growth in music education programs at our Montclair headquarters, to producing the region’s largest outdoor jazz festival, the MONTCLAIR **JAZZ** FESTIVAL, and advancing student success through our JAZZ HOUSE Music Scholars program in public schools across New Jersey and New York City, our reach and impact continue to grow.

As we prepare to open our new JAZZ HOUSE Arts + Education Center, we are creating a permanent home for artistic excellence, education, performance, and community engagement, expanding opportunities for the next generation.

Every day, we fulfill our mission of developing the next generation of community leaders and global citizens through jazz.

**Our Mission:**

JAZZ HOUSE **KiDS** brings together young artists, world-class instruction, and vibrant communities under one roof—creating a home where collaboration, leadership, and community thrive. We guarantee access regardless of background or circumstance, nurture learning from first note to advanced artistry, support career development from classroom to professional stage, and build communities where jazz connects generations. We are an instrument for change.

**Position Summary:**

The Digital Marketing Manager plays a key role in building JAZZ HOUSE **KiDS**’ visibility, expanding awareness, engaging audiences, and inspiring meaningful action—from student enrollment and ticket sales to event participation, charitable giving, and long-term community support.

Working under the direction of the Director of Marketing + Communications, this hands-on role executes integrated digital campaigns and creates compelling content across social media, websites, email, and YouTube to advance the mission, programs, performances, and events of JAZZ HOUSE **KiDS** and the MONTCLAIR **JAZZ** FESTIVAL. Collaborating across departments, the ideal candidate is a skilled copywriter, creative storyteller, and organized project manager who brings strong digital marketing expertise, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a passion for jazz, music education, and the arts.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Social Media + Community Engagement**

- **Social Media Management:** Create and publish daily, platform-specific content across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn to promote JAZZ HOUSE programs, concerts, the MONTCLAIR **JAZZ** FESTIVAL, and organizational priorities.
- **Community Engagement:** Respond to comments, DMs, mentions, and reviews in a timely, on-brand voice; re-share student, family, alumni, and audience content and celebrate their milestones.
- **Content Capture:** Capture quality photo and video content at concerts, programs, and events as needed, including occasional evenings and weekends.
- **Social Partnerships:** Build relationships with social media, community, and media partners to expand JAZZ HOUSE’s reach and visibility.

**Digital Content + Audience Development**

- **Website Management:** Maintain timely, engaging content across jazzhousekids.org and montclairjazzfestival.org , including news, events, bios, banners, and links.
- **YouTube Growth:** Manage and optimize the YouTube channel with compelling titles, descriptions, thumbnails, playlists, and SEO, prioritizing a growing library of individual performance clips.
- **Email Marketing:** Build, proofread, schedule, and report on email campaigns while maintaining and segmenting mailing lists.
- **Content Calendar:** Maintain social media and digital content calendars, coordinating timelines and approvals with program leads and the Director of Marketing + Communications.

**Marketing Collaboration + Campaign Execution**

- **Cross-Department Collaboration:** Partner with arts, development, and events teams, visiting artists, and community partners to execute integrated marketing campaigns.
- **Campaign Coordination:** Track marketing projects, timelines, approvals, and deliverables in Asana to keep cross-department campaigns organized and on schedule.
- **Event Promotion:** Promote concerts, events, programs, enrollment, and organizational priorities across relevant digital platforms.
- **Emerging Trends + Technology:** Monitor social media trends, digital tools, and emerging technologies, sharing relevant insights and recommendations with the team.

**Analytics + Content Management**

- **Storytelling + Copywriting:** Craft compelling short- and medium-form written content that brings the JAZZ HOUSE **KiDS** mission, programs, students, teaching artists, and community to life. Write engaging social media captions, program descriptions, promotional copy, and other digital content that communicates the organization’s impact, celebrates its people, and inspires audiences to connect, participate, and give.
- **Analytics + Reporting:** Track digital performance across social media, email, YouTube, and other platforms to inform strategy and improve engagement.
- **Competitive Analysis:** Monitor peer organizations, campaigns, and digital trends to identify opportunities and strengthen JAZZ HOUSE marketing.
- **Photo + Video Library:** Organize and maintain server-based media libraries, cataloguing and tagging assets and tracking student and performer media releases.
- **Brand + Content Accuracy:** Keep digital content accurate, current, and aligned with JAZZ HOUSE’s brand, messaging, and promotional priorities.

**Qualifications:**

**Education and Experience:**

- **Education:** Bachelor's Degree required; Master's Degree preferred
- **Work Experience:** 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing, social media, communications, or a related field, preferably within an arts, education, cultural, or nonprofit organization. Experience promoting programs, performances, events, or community-based initiatives is highly valued, as is familiarity with the mission, audiences, and communications needs of an arts education organization.
- **Availability:** Evenings, weekends, and travel required during performance and event seasons.

**Knowledge, Skills and Expertise:**

- **Social Media + Digital Marketing:** Knowledge of major social platforms, features, best practices, and digital advertising encouraged; familiarity with Constant Contact or other email marketing tools preferred.
- **Writing + Content Creation:** Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to adapt voice and style; proficiency in Photoshop or Canva and Premiere, CapCut, or similar video editing software required.
- **Organization + Project Management:** Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage data, communications, reporting, and content accurately, balance competing priorities, and meet tight deadlines. Familiarity with Asana or similar tools encouraged.
- **Collaboration + Initiative:** Proactive, flexible self-starter who works independently and collaboratively in a small, fast-paced team while maintaining high standards of quality.

**Personal Characteristics:**

- Passionate advocate for the value of arts education and youth development, with genuine concern for people and community, and interest in working with diverse communities
- A relationship builder, working hard with the ability to juggle and prioritize issues and multiple tasks without jeopardizing communications with students and student families
- Passion for the mission of the JAZZ HOUSE
- Appreciation of jazz and live music goer
- Ability to lift up to 25 lbs
- Successful completion of a national background check

**Reporting:** This position will report to the Director of Communications + Marketing.

Spartan Race Company

DescriptionWorking for Spartan Race means working to better the lives of millions of people around the globe.Every day we come to work, and have the ability to entertain, empower, and excite consumers about the Spartan brand.Spartan Race is a high-performance organization, and successful team members must therefore possess a strong work ethic and hands-on approach to business. We are innovative, create inventive solutions, and are exceptionally service minded. Team members at Spartan change lives, and have a passion for the organization.RESPONSIBILITIESPlan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies to increase visibility, recognition, and drive new user acquisition via Google Search, DV360, GDN and YouTube.Continuously monitor, identify and improve all three components of the AdWords Quality Score: Ad Relevance, Expected CTR, and Landing Page ExperienceAssure keyword targets, landing page content and ad copy are all in close alignment and optimized for generating action, interest and engagement from the targeted audienceAssure conversion tracking is QA’ed within AdWords to track all pertinent events within the sales funnelUtilize Google Analytics to develop insights and action items intended to increase revenues. Manage relationships with multiple external vendors/agencies and track progress on execution across all channels.Check daily reports and provide troubleshooting support for issues relating to campaign spend, creative, tagging or partner implementation and escalating to third party vendors when necessary. Collaborate with team members by providing guidance on how to continually improve operational processes, supporting systems and communication channels where needed.Provide regular insights on performance, campaign optimizations, and new opportunities. Assure landing page content and ad copy are all in close alignment and optimized for generating action, interest and engagement from the targeted audience Work closely with the tech team to own tracking and pixel implementation of digital campaigns.EXPERIENCE 2-4 years of paid search experience managing operational processes in online advertising industry for a publisher, advertiser or agency; having both sell and buy-side experience with budgets exceeding $5mm annually is a plus A comprehensive understanding of the google ad auction, general advertising ecosystem, best practices, bid and optimization strategies, and campaign objectives Proficient with MS Office Suite and deep working knowledge of Google Ads and AnalyticsExperience in Google Tag Manager, DV360 and GDN is a plus.Basic knowledge of UTM trackingExperience with testing new ad product solutions and managing new ad technology platform integrations/migrations Strong aptitude for identifying problems, troubleshooting issues and problem solving Ability to work in self-directed, results-oriented work environments and multitask in a fast-paced environment with strong written/verbal communication and relationship management skills
